c0786a02.title: Technical Program Manager
c0786a02.description:
Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of cross-functional technical programs, coordinating dependencies across engineering, product, and business teams

Serve as Scrum Master for one or more agile teams, facilitating sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives

Coordinate and facilitate Program Increment (PI) Planning sessions, including logistics, agenda, and pre-read materials

Remove blockers and coach teams on agile best practices

Track program timelines, risks, and budgets; communicate status clearly to stakeholders and leadership

Partner with engineering leads to translate business requirements into actionable epics, user stories, and technical roadmaps

Manage and maintain program artifacts (roadmaps, RAID logs, burndown charts) in tools like Jira and Confluence

Support cloud-based initiatives by coordinating with engineering teams on basic AWS infrastructure needs (e.g., EC2, S3, IAM)

Bridge technical and non-technical conversations across teams

Drive continuous improvement of agile processes and program management practices

Identify and mitigate program risks proactively, escalating issues as needed

  

**ABOUT US** :

Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency – to thrive on change.

Our transformative solutions in Digital Logistics, Cognitive Manufacturing, Autonomous Planning, Smart Procurement and Digitalization are positioned around key industry pillars and delivered through a comprehensive portfolio of services spanning digital strategy, design and build, and implementation across a range of technology platforms.

Bristlecone is ranked among the top ten leaders in supply chain services by Gartner. We are headquartered in San Jose, California, with locations across North America, Europe and Asia, and over 2,500 consultants. Bristlecone is part of the $19.4 billion Mahindra Group.

  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:**

Bristlecone is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status .

  

**INFORMATION SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Understand and adhere to Information Security policies, guidelines and procedure, practice them for protection of organizational data and Information System.
* Take part in information security training and act while handling information.
* Report all suspected security and policy breach to InfoSec team or appropriate authority (CISO).
* Understand and adhere to the additional information security responsibilities as part of the assigned job role.

19ab78f6.title: AI Technical Program Manager
19ab78f6.description:
AI Technical Program Manager

**Description -**

  

**About the role**

  

HP Applied AI helps the enterprise use AI safely and at scale while improving performance, experience and cost. As an AI Technical Program Manager, you will be the primary Applied AI partner for one or more value streams, flexing across priorities as business demand evolves.

You will connect business leaders, Global Process Owners, product and platform teams, delivery managers, engineering, machine learning, data, operations and controls. You will translate business problems into buildable requirements, steer execution, challenge legacy ways of working and ensure solutions reach production with measurable outcomes.

  

**What you will do**

  

* **Own end-to-end program outcomes.** Lead AI and automation initiatives from intake and feasibility through planning, execution, testing, release, adoption, operational handover and benefits realization.

* **Plan and drive delivery.** Maintain integrated plans, milestones, capacity, estimates, budgets and release schedules using agile or hybrid approaches. Manage critical paths, dependencies, scope changes and recovery actions.

* **Lead sprint and backlog readiness.** Facilitate prioritization, backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, reviews and retrospectives. Remove impediments and ensure requirements are ready for engineering.

* **Translate business needs into buildable requirements.** Map current and future processes; define epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, nonfunctional requirements, data needs, exceptions, integrations and controls.

* **Prioritize for value.** Build business cases and ROI assumptions with value-stream leaders and Global Process Owners. Prioritize opportunities by value, feasibility, effort, cost, risk, dependencies and organizational readiness.

* **Manage risk and governance.** Maintain an actionable RAID log, stakeholder map, RACI, decision records and governance cadence. Escalate early, communicate trade-offs and secure accountable decisions.

* **Guide AI and enterprise technology delivery.** Lead the lifecycle from use-case definition and data readiness through AI evaluation, deployment and monitoring. Work with engineers on LLMs, agents, RPA, APIs, cloud services, environments, pipelines and the SDLC.

* **Safeguard quality and production readiness.** Align engineering, QA and business teams on test coverage, environments, data, entry and exit criteria, sign-offs and traceability. Coordinate functional, integration, regression, UAT, AI evaluation, performance and security testing as applicable.

* **Ensure controls and operational readiness.** Maintain required SOX/ITGC change evidence, release approvals, cutover and rollback plans, support readiness and explicit acceptance of residual risks.

* **Drive adoption and realized value.** Coordinate communications, training and support handover. Track adoption and benefits against agreed baselines, identify outcome gaps and drive corrective action.

* **Identify opportunities to Improve the process, not only the technology.** Perform root-cause analysis and operational data verification and validation to remove waste, reduce rework, reduce manual handoffs and control weaknesses before or alongside automation. Identify opportunities for process standardization, align with business process SMEs and execute process improvements.

  

**Education and Experience Required**

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

* Typically, 8+ years of experience leading technology projects or programs across agile and hybrid delivery, including ownership of schedules, budgets, scope, resources, releases and operational handover.

* Proven experience personally delivering AI initiatives through requirements, technical execution, evaluation and testing, deployment, adoption and post-release outcomes.

* Prior hands-on software, data, automation or AI engineering experience. Training, certification or coordination exposure alone is not sufficient for this role.

* Demonstrated experience building business cases, assessing ROI, prioritizing investments and tracking realized benefits.

* Experience working in a complex enterprise environment across business, engineering, data, platform, security, compliance and operations teams.

  

**Knowledge and skills**

  

* Strong technology program management discipline covering planning, estimation, capacity, budgeting, change control, critical-path analysis, RAID and dependency management.

* Practical business analysis capability, including requirements elicitation, process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria and requirements-to-test traceability.

* Working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, agentic systems, RPA, APIs, cloud platforms, enterprise integrations, CI/CD and the software development lifecycle.

* Practical experience using Azure DevOps or comparable tools for backlog, sprint, dependency, release and traceability management.

* Ability to define and coordinate test strategies across functional, integration, regression, UAT and AI evaluation, including defect disposition and release acceptance.

* Strong executive communication and stakeholder influence, with the judgment to challenge constructively, explain uncertainty and make trade-offs visible.

* Analytical problem solving using operational data, process baselines and root-cause methods.

* Ability to work through ambiguity and shifting priorities while maintaining clear ownership and delivery discipline.

  

**Preferred qualifications**

  

* PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe or comparable program or agile certification.

* AI certification such as Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable applied AI training.

* Lean, Six Sigma or related process-improvement training with demonstrated practical application.

Data & Information Technology

Full time

No shift premium (India)

**Relocation -**

9d8c4254.title: Business Solutions & Application Portfolio Manager
9d8c4254.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

### **Your Role**

As a Business Solutions & Application Portfolio Manager, you will be responsible for governing the regional business application portfolio and managing relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams, and external service providers. You will oversee application lifecycle management, vendor performance, service enhancements, and technology transformation initiatives, including application archiving, decommissioning, migrations, and platform upgrades. Working closely with Finance, Platform IT, and regional stakeholders, you will ensure effective service delivery, cost transparency, operational continuity, and compliance with business and regulatory requirements. You will also drive service improvements, coordinate disaster recovery readiness, manage risks and dependencies, and support strategic decisions on application modernization and technology roadmaps.

  

### **What will you do:**

* Manage the regional business application portfolio, including archiving, migration, decommissioning, and lifecycle planning.
* Govern third-party vendors and managed service providers, monitoring service performance, risks, and improvement actions.
* Review enhancement requests, delivery estimates, upgrade proposals, costs, and business requirements.
* Coordinate application transformation, cloud migration, platform upgrades, and supplier transitions.
* Build relationships with Finance, IT, application owners, and regional stakeholders.
Oversee disaster recovery readiness, compliance requirements, risk escalation, and operational continuity.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others

### **Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

* Experience in enterprise application management, IT service delivery, or business relationship management.
* Hands-on experience in vendor governance, managed services, and service performance management.
* Knowledge of ERP, Finance platforms, application lifecycle management, and migration programmes.
* Experience reviewing enhancement requests, project estimates, upgrades, and delivery proposals.
* Understanding of disaster recovery, compliance, risk management, and application governance.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication, and cross-regional coordination skills.

### **Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

* Exposure to cloud migration, data-centre exit, and legacy application rationalization.
* Knowledge of application archiving, data retention, and restoration strategies.
* Experience with ServiceNow, AMS governance, and IT service management frameworks.
* Understanding of SOX controls, disaster recovery frameworks, and audit requirements.
Ability to influence stakeholders and communicate effectively with senior leadership.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**Description**
The Value Added Services Tech (VASTech) team accelerates WW Heavy Bulky (HB) and High Consideration Technical Product (HCTP) categories by providing hyperlocal pre and post-purchase services across the product lifecycle. VASTech supports business teams across 12 marketplaces serve Customers across B2C and B2B use cases. Leveraging the expertise in offering regionally constrained selection, VASTech partners with eCF platform teams to also launch other regional product use cases such as MFN stores selling regionally constrained selection and Regional Fulfilment Offer (RFO) as a hard regionalization solution to define regional boundaries on AFN shipments. This document describes how VASTech leverages and augments the broader Stores architecture, key initiatives towards generalization and consolidation, and future opportunities for 2025 and beyond.
  
  
We are on the mission to build a eco system at Amazon which becomes as a one stop for Service Providers to sell services, be able to associate it with products / regions, an experience which delight the customer to use Amazon as a platform to get end to end hassle free experience while buying a product with a Service & a platform that set benchmark in the industry for standards, customer satisfaction, safety and flexibility while fulfilling a service.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced, customer obsessed Technical Program Manager who is able to collaborate effectively with a technical team and be responsible for key aspects of the software customer experience on a new consumer service. In this role you, will lead the definition, and shepherd the development, of new features as well as important optimizations to the service. The role is inherently cross-functional: you will work closely with a high-energy team of software engineers, product managers, user experience designers, marketers, customer service leads as well as internal & external product stakeholders across the company. This role is a good fit for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, is both creative and technical, and who is sensitive to and understands the diverse perspectives of stakeholders and works with them to resolve differences.

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

b2d36042.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Last Mile Transporter Experience, Last Mile Transporter Experience
b2d36042.description:
**Description**
Come build the next generation of technology and driver experiences for Amazon’s Last Mile delivery business. We build services and apps that drivers use to deliver most Amazon customer packages, with a reach of millions of customers and packages. The Driver Experience team is responsible for how drivers know where to go, what packages to deliver, where and how to pickup packages, and how to communicate with customers. This TPM role not only helps define the driver experience, it also defines the technology platform used to build Amazon's delivery app.
  
  
We're seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to manage large, cross functional programs and projects that support Last Mile delivery. In this role you will be responsible for delivering complex projects end-to-end keeping Amazon’s scale and quality in mind. You will help deliver mobile apps on multiple platforms, and the backend services needed to provide delivery and task guidance to on-road drivers. Amazon Last Mile is a large, service-oriented architecture with thousands of components that work together to provide a single app experience. As a Senior TPM, you will drive the scalable architecture of our next-generation platform, design for technical operational excellence and package delivery operational cost efficiency. You will also optimize for driver productivity and quality. You will anticipate project bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. There are very few opportunities to design a system that operates at Amazon scale and throughput, so this is a highly visible position that will have a material impact on Amazon transportation for decades to come.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon's Last Mile Transporter Experience team is directly responsible for the driver experience. We work with technologies ranging from mobile devices, to in-dash screens, to backend supporting services, to hardware devices in warehouse pickup points, to enable deliveries worldwide and scale, with region-specific support. We think not only about mobile apps, we also think about driver safety, how drivers get paid, how delivery partners support their drivers, and more. We regularly partner with Amazon business teams to deliver end to end business programs that surface to drivers through the driver experience screens and systems. We also define and deliver the technical platform for building driver experiences, ranging from data architectures to mobile frameworks.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem-solve, scope technical requirements and prioritize tasks

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

3c01d699.title: Program Manager 4
3c01d699.description:
**Job Description**
This role will lead complex technical programs, establishes scope and milestones, improves cross-team processes, automates reporting, and acts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Lead one or more major GPU Cluster Health domains such as strategic customer availability, partner repair execution, RMA/spares governance, data/reporting framework, repair workflow improvement, or engineering platform tooling.
* Translate availability gaps into structured programs with scope, owners, milestones, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive-ready status.
* Drive weekly operating rhythm for assigned domains, including KPI review, blockers, escalations, decisions, and follow-through.

**Customer and Horizontal Leadership**

* Support the vertical/horizontal TPM model by owning either a customer vertical or a horizontal functional area.
* For vertical ownership, lead availability and repair strategy for assigned strategic customers and customer clusters.
* For horizontal ownership, lead cross-cutting programs such as NVIDIA/AMD partner tracking, SDE/SRE tooling, RMA/spares feedback loop, SOP tracking, or metrics/reporting framework.

**KPI Definition and Governance**

* Define KPI measurement methods for repair health, including cluster availability, unavailable-host backlog, repair cycle time, repair success rate, reopen rate, spare availability, RMA loop performance, partner responsiveness, and SLA/SLO adherence.
* Drive consistent reporting standards across TPMs and support teams.
* Identify trends across multiple workstreams and convert them into prioritized corrective actions.

**Cross-Functional Execution**

* Partner with India, Morocco, and Mexico SDE/SRE teams to identify tooling and first-level support needs.
* Prioritize tooling requirements that reduce manual repair coordination, improve triage, automate reporting, or accelerate repair handoffs.
* Work with GSL, CHS, CPV, TRS, Warminator , and data center operations to remove repair blockers.
* Support incident-style escalation for clusters at availability risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead post-program retrospectives and drive process updates.
* Standardize repeatable playbooks, intake processes, escalation paths, and repair governance artifacts.
* Identify automation opportunities and advocate for prioritization.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Major repair programs have clear objectives, metrics, owners, and measurable improvement .
* Leadership has reliable visibility into customer cluster health and repair risk.
* Repair blockers are resolved through structured governance instead of ad hoc escalation.
* Tooling and reporting requirements are translated into actionable SDE/SRE work.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

bf82b4a5.title: Technical Program Manager III
bf82b4a5.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and the implementation of GenAI-driven moderation frameworks to enhance operational scalability.
* Proven track record in planning, organizing, and risk management for high-stakes, cross-functional programs.
* Ability to utilize data analysis tools and drive focused insights and performance improvements.
* Strong capability to influence without authority across peer PgMs, Engineering leads, and executive leadership.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect and build operational solutions using Generative AI to enhance moderation, scalability and efficiency. Design and set up assertion based expert workflows for newer FMR vectors.
* Serve as the primary point of contact (POC) for global regulatory workflows, ensuring compliance with mandates like the DSA and CMA.
* Oversee end-to-end project life cycles from concept to launch, coordinating closely with cross-functional Engineering and Product teams.
* Monitor program metrics and risks, communicating progress and performance effectively to executive leadership.
* Establish and manage in-house and extended workforce project execution teams while leveraging internal Google products and tools to drive automation and enhance operational efficiency.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

57d64fe9.title: Senior Public Transportation Architect
57d64fe9.description:
**Overall Summary**

  

The Senior Public Transportation Architect serves as a senior technical delivery professional responsible for the planning, design, and multidisciplinary coordination of complex transit infrastructure and public transportation facility projects. The role is intended for an experienced engineer-architect who can lead technical workstreams, coordinate across disciplines, support client and stakeholder discussions, and deliver practical, sustainable, and operationally effective transit facilities.

  

The role supports projects such as transit stations, bus rapid transit facilities, multimodal transportation hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, park-and-ride facilities, passenger transfer facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure. The position is focused on technical excellence, project delivery, design integration, quality, and mentoring within multidisciplinary transit infrastructure teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead planning, programming, architectural design, and construction support for transit stations, multimodal hubs, maintenance facilities, BRT facilities, operations centers, and other transportation infrastructure projects.
* Serve as Lead Architect, Design Lead, or Discipline Lead for complex transit infrastructure assignments, ensuring that architectural deliverables are coordinated, technically sound, and aligned with project requirements.
* Coordinate and integrate architectural solutions with civil, structural, geotechnical, MEP, rail systems, communications, traction power, transportation planning, operations, safety, security, sustainability, and digital delivery disciplines.
* Develop facility concepts that balance passenger experience, operational efficiency, accessibility, safety, maintainability, resiliency, sustainability, lifecycle performance, and future expansion needs.
* Prepare, review, and coordinate design criteria, reports, technical memoranda, drawings, specifications, BIM models, and contract documents across project phases.
* Support project managers with scope management, schedule coordination, budget awareness, resource planning, risk reviews, and quality assurance for architectural and facility-related tasks.
* Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews, constructability reviews, value engineering sessions, and technical quality reviews to improve project outcomes.
* Interface with client teams to present design concepts, resolve technical issues, and support approvals.
* Support construction-phase services including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and coordinating design clarifications.
* Promote BIM coordination, digital delivery workflows, and innovative approaches to improve quality, coordination, and delivery efficiency.
* Mentor architects, engineers, designers, and BIM/modeling staff.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Bachelors degree in Architecture or related engineering field from an accredited institution.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in architecture, transportation facilities, transit infrastructure, or complex public infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 8 years of experience delivering rail, metro, BRT, bus, or multimodal transportation facility projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and coordinating with civil, structural, MEP, systems, operations, safety, and sustainability disciplines.
* Experience supporting project delivery through multiple phases, including planning, feasibility, conceptual design, detailed design, procurement support, and construction support.
* Strong working knowledge of accessibility requirements, sustainable design principles, and public infrastructure design requirements.
* Strong communication, coordination, and technical leadership skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Masters degree in Architecture, Urban Design, Transportation Planning, or a related field.
* Experience with transit stations, rail/metro facilities, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and storage facilities, operations centers, passenger facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure.
* Experience integrating architecture with rail systems, transit operations, maintenance requirements, transportation engineering, and public realm design.
* Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, CM/GC, or other alternative delivery methods.
* Proficiency with BIM, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and digital delivery workflows.
* Experience delivering large-scale transit infrastructure projects for North American, Middle East, or other international clients.

  

**Primary Focus**

  

Transit stations, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, and fleet electrification infrastructure.

  
  

**Delivery Role**

  

Leads and coordinates with civil, structural, MEP, rail systems, operations, safety, sustainability, and digital delivery teams

**To be a successful Solution Architect, you should have experience with:**

* Excellent experience of delivering complex end-to-end solution designs as a Solution Architect.
* A specialist understanding of architectural principles, best practices, and modern design methods.
* Previous ability to simplify complex challenges, delivering clear and effective solution designs.
* Past hands-on experience on Private and public cloud, API development, Microservices, Various Integration patterns and protocols is Must

* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and guide strategic thinking through technology innovation.
* Expertise in complex systems integration, with sound knowledge of implementation and integration challenges and their architectural implications.
* Knowledge of corporate banking is an additional advantage

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Vice President Expectations**

* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. a307ae9b.title: Solution Architect I - Enterprise Solutions - ServiceNow Solution Architect
a307ae9b.description:
**Role description**

Key Responsibilities 1. ServiceNow Platform Strategy & Roadmap • Own and maintain the ServiceNow platform strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with business and technology objectives. • Assess the current ServiceNow landscape, existing ITSM ecosystem, business processes, integrations, customizations, and technology dependencies. • Work with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, pain points, demand, and future requirements. • Define the target-state ServiceNow platform vision and solution architecture. • Identify capabilities to implement, enhance, migrate, consolidate, standardize, or retire. • Prioritize initiatives based on business value, dependencies, organizational readiness, user impact, cost, licensing, and implementation complexity. • Translate the roadmap into implementation waves, releases, work packages, and POD-level delivery opportunities. • Continuously evolve the roadmap as business priorities and ServiceNow capabilities change. 2. Business Engagement & Advisory • Build strong relationships with business functions, technology leadership, platform owners, enterprise architects, and operational stakeholders. • Conduct discovery sessions and workshops to understand business challenges and identify opportunities where ServiceNow can deliver value. • Translate business requirements into ServiceNow capabilities and viable solution options. • Develop business-focused use cases rather than presenting generic platform functionality. • Facilitate prioritization and communicate solution benefits, dependencies, risks, and implementation considerations to business and technical audiences. 3. 29eef91e.title: Technical Program Manager III
29eef91e.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and the implementation of GenAI-driven moderation frameworks to enhance operational scalability.
* Proven track record in planning, organizing, and risk management for high-stakes, cross-functional programs.
* Ability to utilize data analysis tools and drive focused insights and performance improvements.
* Strong capability to influence without authority across peer PgMs, Engineering leads, and executive leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Architect and build operational solutions using Generative AI to enhance moderation, scalability and efficiency. Design and set up assertion based expert workflows for newer FMR vectors.
* Serve as the primary point of contact (POC) for global regulatory workflows, ensuring compliance with mandates like the DSA and CMA.
* Oversee end-to-end project life cycles from concept to launch, coordinating closely with cross-functional Engineering and Product teams.
* Monitor program metrics and risks, communicating progress and performance effectively to executive leadership.
* Establish and manage in-house and extended workforce project execution teams while leveraging internal Google products and tools to drive automation and enhance operational efficiency.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. 75112d8b.title: Lead Cloud & Data Engineer
75112d8b.description:
Join us as a Lead Cloud and Data Engineer where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be successful as a Lead Cloud and Data Engineer, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Strong experience architecture and designing end-to-end technology solutions across complex enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of AWS cloud services, cloud-native architecture, data engineering, and engineering principles.
* Experience designing and implementing data transformation, integration, and data movement solutions.
* Hands-on engineering experience using Python or comparable programming technologies.
* Practical experience with data technologies such as S3, AWS Glue, Lambda, Athena and relational or NoSQL data stores, where appropriate to the workload.
* Experience with containerized workloads and modern application deployment approaches.
* Experience with modern software engineering and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version control, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong understanding of security, resilience, scalability, performance, and operational requirements when designing cloud solutions.
* Ability to translate architecture into implementable engineering designs and reusable technical patterns.
* Experience working across architecture and engineering teams to take solutions from concept and design through implementation and production readiness.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Experience working in financial services or other highly regulated environments, with awareness of security, risk, control and governance expectations.
* Practical experience with modern AWS data and analytics services, and designing cloud-native data platforms.
* Exposure to modern data-engineering technologies such as Databricks, dbt, Apache Airflow/Astronomer and Apache Iceberg.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration, including Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.
* Experience in legacy/data-platform modernization, including migration of on-premises or traditional analytical workloads to AWS.
* Exposure to AI/ML and GenAI technologies, particularly AWS-native services, where applicable to modern data and analytics solutions.
* Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Data Engineer or equivalent cloud/data certifications.

**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build and maintenance of data architectures pipelines that enable the transfer and processing of durable, complete and consistent data.
* Design and implementation of data warehoused and data lakes that manage the appropriate data volumes and velocity and adhere to the required security measures.
* Development of processing and analysis algorithms fit for the intended data complexity and volumes.
* Collaboration with data scientist to build and deploy machine learning models.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Location: Whitefield, Bangalore
  
  
Job Type: Full Time
  
  
Work Type: Onsite
  
  
Experience: 13+ years**
**Job Description**

* The Deputy Manager - India Staffing will be responsible for managing recruitment delivery across assigned accounts, leading high-performing teams, ensuring client commitments are consistently achieved, and driving operational excellence.
* The role requires ownership of delivery performance, team productivity, client relationships, governance, and business outcomes while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

**Client Delivery, Performance & Stakeholder Management**

* Own end-to-end recruitment delivery for assigned accounts and ensure all staffing requirements are fulfilled within agreed turnaround times and client expectations.
* Partner with clients, MSP/VMS partners, hiring managers, and internal stakeholders to understand hiring priorities and develop effective delivery strategies.
* Drive key delivery metrics including requirement coverage, submission quality, interview conversion, offer closures, joining ratios, and placement share.
* Participate in client governance calls, scorecard reviews, spotlight calls, and business review meetings, providing regular updates on delivery performance and action plans.
* Proactively manage client escalations and implement corrective actions to ensure high levels of client satisfaction.

* Manage and develop high performing teams, ensuring alignment to business objectives, performance expectations, and organizational values.
* Monitor team productivity, KPI achievement, hiring effectiveness, and overall account performance through regular reviews and data-driven decision-making.
* Conduct performance evaluations, coaching discussions, and development planning to enhance individual and team capability.
* Drive accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the team.
* Ensure effective resource allocation, capacity planning, and workload balancing to maximize productivity and delivery outcomes.
* Support employee engagement, retention, succession planning, and career development initiatives.

**Financial & Business Performance**

* Drive team productivity, profitability, and ROI in line with organizational and account-level targets.
* Monitor delivery trends, placement contribution, resource utilization, and business performance metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve placement share, expand account penetration, and strengthen existing client relationships.
* Prepare and present performance dashboards, business reviews, and operational reports to management.

* Minimum 6+ years of experience in people management and leading recruitment delivery teams of 10+ members in a fast-paced staffing environment.
* Hands-on experience working with MSP/VMS clients, ATS platforms (Ceipal or equivalent), recruitment analytics, and delivery governance.
* Strong stakeholder management, client engagement, team leadership, and operational management skills.

You will act as a strategic bridge between executive business leaders, product management, and engineering teams, driving robust Agile delivery frameworks while maintaining high standards of code quality, architecture scalability, and cloud governance.

The ideal candidate has transitioned from a solid technical background (originally as a Software Developer, Tech Lead, or Architect in Java/.NET) into a seasoned delivery leader capable of managing multi-million-dollar portfolios, driving engineering transformations, and mentoring next-generation tech leaders.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Direct and govern the end-to-end delivery of a multi-million-dollar portfolio of enterprise applications built on modern Java and .NET stacks
* Champion and scale Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across multiple distributed product engineering teams, optimizing velocity, cycle time, and release predictability
* Manage and optimize the portfolio budget, forecasting resource needs, controlling operational expenses (OpEx/CapEx), and ensuring high ROI
* Establish robust delivery governance, identify systemic delivery risks early, and implement proactive mitigation plans to protect critical business timelines and SLAs

* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects to guide development teams migrating legacy monolithic codebases into modern cloud-native (AWS, Azure, or GCP) microservices
* Provide high-level technical oversight for teams delivering in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate) or .NET (.NET Core, .NET 8+, C#, ASP.NET Web API)

* Partner with VP/C-level executives, Product Owners, and Business Units to translate long-term business strategy into actionable technical delivery roadmaps, while overseeing offshore/nearshore partners, SOWs, and vendor contracts

* 10-14 years of overall IT industry experience, including at least 1-2 years in an IT Delivery Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager role managing multiple concurrent software development teams
* Proven track record of successfully managing enterprise portfolios with budgets exceeding $5M+ and teams of 50+ engineers
* Background in software engineering with hands-on experience in Java (Spring frameworks, Spring Boot, J2EE legacy) and/or .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core)
* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), cloud-native design patterns, and serverless architectures
* Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker
* Knowledge of distributed database environments (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, NoSQL)
* Expertise in modern integration technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, API Gateways)
* Proficiency in scaling Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across distributed engineering teams
* Competency in CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and automated testing practices
* Capability to manage project scopes, timelines, resource allocation, and multi-million dollar budgets
* Skills in stakeholder management, vendor negotiation, and executive-level communication
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

b0631790.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Sr. TPM in the Payables Tech org, you will drive cross-functional programs that are aimed at keeping Amazon's financial compliance high while making it seamless for vendors to partner with Amazon. You'll manage world-wide e-invoicing and compliance projects in this role by working closely with Engineering, Tax, Compliance, Program Management and other partner orgs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and manage the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs, including setting the mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria while driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver.
* Partner with engineering teams and stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, question assumptions using your technical judgment, and make informed trade-offs between time, effort, and features to keep programs on track.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively by overseeing gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, reducing exposure to failure modes such as unclear requirements, insufficient testing, or ineffective cross-team collaboration.
* Leverage data to regularly review program metrics, drive improvements, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives while clearly communicating progress and outcomes to Directors and VPs through well-crafted narratives.
* Evaluate opportunities to integrate generative AI tools and other emerging technologies into program workflows, refining outputs and applying responsible practices to improve productivity and solution quality.

  
A day in the life  
You will start your day reviewing program metrics and aligning priorities with engineering leads across multiple teams. Much of your time will be spent facilitating technical discussions, clarifying requirements, and removing blockers that slow delivery. You will draft and refine program documents, prepare updates for senior leadership, and work with Principal Engineers to validate that system architectures meet scaling needs. Between meetings, you will dig into data to spot emerging risks and adjust plans accordingly, always keeping your stakeholders informed and aligned.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 59103e62.title: Program Manager, Cybersecurity, Metrics and Reporting
59103e62.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As the **Program Manager, Cybersecurity, Metrics and Reporting**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

**Cybersecurity Metrics and Reporting Strategy**
------------------------------------------------

* Defining, implementing, and continuously evolving the cybersecurity metrics, reporting, and analytics strategy in alignment with organizational objectives and cyber risk priorities.
* Serving as the cybersecurity strategy owner for metrics and reporting, translating data-driven analysis into strategic insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Advancing cybersecurity measurement from operational activity metrics to risk-based and outcome-focused measures of control effectiveness, program performance, and resilience.
* Influencing cybersecurity strategy, risk prioritization, and enterprise risk management decisions through analytics and performance reporting.
* Establishing reporting maturity roadmaps and continuous improvement programs that advance cybersecurity measurement capabilities.

**Metrics Governance and Standards**
------------------------------------

* Establishing and governing cybersecurity KPIs, KRIs, performance measures, scorecards, and reporting standards.
* Defining and maintaining metric definitions, methodologies, thresholds, ownership, and reporting requirements aligned with cybersecurity measurement priorities.
* Maintaining a cybersecurity metrics inventory and reporting catalog that document approved measures, data sources, and intended audiences.
* Ensuring consistent interpretation and use of cybersecurity metrics across dashboards, executive reporting, and materials used for board reporting.
* Establishing lifecycle management and reporting controls for the introduction, review, change, and retirement of metrics and reporting artifacts.

**Data Quality and Reporting Integrity**
----------------------------------------

* Defining data quality standards and overseeing controls that ensure the consistency, completeness, accuracy, and reliability of cybersecurity reporting data.
* Holding data and implementation owners accountable for investigating and resolving data quality issues affecting cybersecurity metrics and reporting.
* Partnering with data owners, system owners, and cybersecurity teams to validate data sources, reporting assumptions, and implementation accuracy.
* Establishing validation, reconciliation, and quality review processes for cybersecurity reporting, including materials used for executive and board reporting.
* Requiring traceability and transparency of metric calculations, data lineage, and reporting methodologies to support reliable interpretation and review.

**Executive Reporting and Analytics**
-------------------------------------

* Leading the development and delivery of executive dashboards, scorecards, and cybersecurity reporting packages, including metrics and reporting used for the board.
* Synthesizing complex cybersecurity, risk, and performance information into concise business insights and leadership communications.
* Analyzing performance trends, risk indicators, and control effectiveness to identify emerging concerns, improvement opportunities, and recommended mitigation priorities.
* Partnering with cybersecurity leadership to communicate cyber risk, program effectiveness, operational performance, and resilience to executive stakeholders and support board reporting.
* Prioritizing concurrent reporting, analytics, and strategic initiatives while meeting established deadlines and enabling informed decision-making.

**Technical Solutions, Automation, and Data Engineering**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Setting the technical direction and requirements for cybersecurity reporting, analytics, and data integration solutions; overseeing implementation by delivery teams and platform owners.
* Evaluating proposed queries, datasets, data models, and reporting logic to assess feasibility, accuracy, scalability, and alignment with approved metric definitions.
* Leading initiatives to automate reporting and improve dashboards, scorecards, data visualization, and data pipelines without requiring hands-on development.
* Assessing API, system integration, and automation approaches, challenging unsupported claims and requiring evidence that implementation meets reporting requirements.
* Guiding the integration and governance of cybersecurity telemetry from security platforms, cloud environments, and identity systems to support reliable reporting and analytics.
* Establishing implementation acceptance criteria and reviewing technical designs, validation results, and delivery evidence with development and platform teams.
* Directing resolution of reporting discrepancies and integration challenges, ensuring technical explanations are accurate and corrective actions address underlying issues.
* Evaluating opportunities for predictive analytics, risk forecasting, telemetry-driven automation, and AI-enabled analytics, and prioritizing adoption based on reporting needs and data readiness.

**Cross-Functional Leadership and Partnership**
-----------------------------------------------

* Serving as the strategic advisor and accountable owner for cybersecurity measurement, reporting, and analytics priorities.
* Aligning Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk Management, Audit, Compliance, and business stakeholders around cybersecurity measurement priorities.
* Leading cross-functional programs and initiatives to define reporting requirements, resolve competing priorities, and advance the measurement roadmap.
* Supporting audit and compliance activities with consistent cybersecurity reporting and traceable measurement evidence.
* Representing the Metrics & Reporting function in governance forums, working groups, and strategic initiatives.

**Leadership and Functional Support**
-------------------------------------

* Leading the Metrics & Reporting function through strategic ownership, program leadership, and influence, initially without direct reports.
* Owning strategic planning and continuous improvement initiatives for cybersecurity metrics, analytics, and reporting.
* Providing functional guidance and mentoring contributors on reporting practices, measurement methodologies, and data-driven decision-making.
* Assuming people management responsibilities if and when the organizational structure evolves to support a team; timing will depend on organizational needs and other dependencies.

**Your Skills and Expertise**
-----------------------------

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires, at a minimum, the following qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in information technology, cybersecurity, or product security.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, business intelligence, data analytics, or performance reporting.

**AND**
-------

**In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Experience developing and governing cybersecurity metrics, KPIs, KRIs, and performance measurement frameworks.
* Experience delivering executive reporting or reporting used by boards to support strategic decision-making.
* Leadership experience managing programs or enterprise initiatives and guiding cross-functional stakeholders; prior direct people management is not required.
* Technical fluency in reporting platforms, data models, SQL and query logic, APIs, and data integrations sufficient to assess implementation approaches, identify inaccurate technical claims, and validate delivery quality; hands-on development is not required.
* Strong analytical and quantitative reasoning, with the ability to translate complex cybersecurity and performance data into concise executive communications.
* Experience with cybersecurity technologies, controls, and governance, and the ability to prioritize concurrent reporting, analytics, and strategic initiatives.

**Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, ServiceNow, Archer, or equivalent data visualization and reporting platforms.
* CISSP, CRISC, CISM, Security+, Certified Data Analyst, or equivalent certification.
* Experience overseeing automated reporting, data integrations, or analytics delivery across multiple technology platforms.
* Experience establishing cybersecurity reporting maturity roadmaps and advancing enterprise measurement capabilities.
* Experience evaluating data modeling, dashboard design, and data visualization approaches for executive audiences.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms, cybersecurity telemetry, predictive analytics, or AI-enabled analytics.
* Knowledge of NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, or NIST 800-53.

**Work location: Bangalore -** **Hybrid**

**Travel: May include up to [10%] [domestic/international]**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

**Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.**

**Diversity & Inclusion**

**(\*) We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, civil status, disability, family status, or membership of the travelling community.**

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com**. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.

04228b7c.title: AVP - Process Excellence - Digital Solutions
04228b7c.description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**
Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
  
  
With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
  
  
Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
  
  
**Job Profile**
**Position details**
This role involves leading the development and implementation of comprehensive Digital Solutions that integrate standardization principles and emphasize efficiency aligned to the MUFG strategic objectives. We are looking for an experienced professional to interface with global business and function leaders with accountability for successful delivery of Digital and transformation projects. The individual should be strong to advocate change and pursue organization change. Ensure the improvement projects are connected to business objectives. The individual must have handled Digital transformation projects, be able to provide thought leadership to a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts towards solution delivery and implementation.
  
  
The position will support the Head of Process Excellence team to drive and identify the opportunity, design and activate the solutions for execution through connecting with key stakeholders in MGS/MUFG.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end Digital Solutions projects to bring in process efficiencies. Be able to adopt a consultative approach with stakeholders to help analyse business operations opportunities, develop and design solutions and identify innovative solutions to streamline processes.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their challenges and pain points, identify recommendations and opportunity areas in agreement with business leads and develop tailored solutions to address them.
* Lead a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to help provide thought leadership towards achieving operational efficiencies, streamlining business processes aligned with MGS’s strategic objectives.
* Must have a strong understanding of the different stages of the project lifecycle delivery aspects, including but not limited to, Business Requirements consulting, UI/UX deisign, Digital Solutions Development, Functional Testing, Delivery and implementation
* Drive teams to develop Digital Solutions that will have a positive strategic impact to the business units
* Partner with technology and business process re-engineering teams to identify opportunities for process digitisation, optimization, and productivity enhancement.
* Conduct root cause analysis to identify underlying issues, analyze data to identify trends and areas of improvements and develop data driven solutions.
* Capability to initiate plan, execute, monitor, control and deliver multiple cross-business projects concurrently, working with multiple project teams.
* Communicate progress, success and challenges to senior leadership, providing regular updates on the status of transformation initiatives.
* Ability to multi-task on a variety of different projects, in a high pace environment.

**Job Requirements**

* 14+ years of work experience in similar profile
* Strong expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate and M365 solutions with ~6+ years experience
* Strong expertise in data engineering, data transformation and implementing Digital Solutions leveraging Python, SQL or any other similar tools
* Strong expertise in AI prompt engineering and AI Agent creation (e.g. CoPilot Agent / Studio) to improve business processes
* Significant experience in solution conceptualization and design, based on business problem statements
* Certification in Six Sigma Green Belt and Lean methodologies will be preferred.
* Consistent track record in successfully handling Operational Excellence/process improvement/Lean initiatives and driving business transformation initiatives.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Excellent program management skills to lead multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadline
* Experience with process automation and technology solutions
* Flexibility to work in different shift timings.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to effectively influence and collaborate with stakeholder at all levels of the organization
* Must be a self-starter, can work independently, and adapt in a dynamic environment

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.
