**Job Description**

Position: Pre-Sales Executive

Function: Sales

Company: Bambrew Plant Fiber Technology Private Limited

Location: Bengaluru/Delhi / Pune/ Mumbai

Experience Required: 0–4 Years

Reporting To: CBO

**About the Company**

Bambrew Plant Fiber Technology Private Limited is a sustainable packaging and

material innovation company focused on developing plant-based, eco-friendly

alternatives to conventional plastic packaging.

We are building solutions that combine material science, technology, and sustainability

to create packaging that is functional, scalable, and better for the environment. Our

solutions cater to diverse industries and applications, helping businesses transition

towards more sustainable packaging.

At Bambrew, we foster an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and ownership-driven

culture. We encourage people to take initiative, learn continuously, solve real-world

problems, and work closely with teams across the organisation. As we grow, we are

looking for individuals who are curious, proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working

in a fast-paced environment.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Pre-Sales Executive to support our Sales team in managing

customer requirements, preparing proposals, coordinating product demonstrations,

and ensuring a smooth transition from initial customer interaction to business closure.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication and coordination skills, an

understanding of B2B sales processes, and the ability to understand customer

requirements and translate them into appropriate product or solution

recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Understand customer requirements and work closely with the Sales team to identify suitable Bambrew products and solutions.

• Support the Sales team in preparing presentations, quotations, proposals, product information, and other sales collateral.

Coordinate with internal teams such as Product, R&D, Operations, Quality, and Sales to address customer requirements.

• Understand product specifications, applications, benefits, and sustainability attributes to effectively communicate them to customers.

• Respond to customer queries and coordinate internally to provide accurate and timely information.

• Support the Sales team in preparing technical and commercial responses to customer requirements.

• Track customer requirements, samples, trials, quotations, and follow-ups throughout the sales cycle.

• Coordinate product samples and trials with relevant internal teams and customers.

• Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, requirements, proposals, and opportunities.

• Support preparation of RFP/RFQ responses, presentations, technical documentation, and product comparisons.

• Work with Sales to identify customer pain points and recommend suitable sustainable packaging solutions.

• Follow up on open customer requirements and ensure timely closure of action items.

• Support the Sales team in converting qualified opportunities into business.

• Gather customer feedback and share relevant insights with Product, R&D, and Operations teams.

• Stay updated on Bambrew's product portfolio, industry developments, customer needs, and sustainable packaging trends.

**Required Skills & Experience**

• 0–3 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Sales Support, Business Development, Customer Success, or a related role.

• B2B experience preferred.

• Experience in packaging, manufacturing, sustainability, FMCG, materials, or related industries will be an advantage.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Good presentation and customer-facing skills.

• Ability to understand technical/product information and communicate it in a simple and effective manner.

• Strong coordination and follow-up skills.

• Good working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, and other sales tools.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple customer requirements simultaneously

Customer-focused and solution-oriented approach.

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving startup environment.

**Key Competencies**

Customer Understanding | Pre-Sales Support | Product Knowledge | Presentation Skills | Proposal & Documentation | Cross-functional Coordination | Communication | Follow-up & Execution | Problem Solving | Customer Orientation

**What You Can Expect at Bambrew**

• Opportunity to work in the growing sustainable packaging and climate-tech ecosystem.

• Exposure to innovative materials, products, and real-world sustainability challenges.

• High ownership and direct exposure to business and leadership teams.

• Opportunity to learn across Sales, Product, R&D, Operations, and Sustainability.

• Fast-paced environment with opportunities for learning, growth, and meaningful impact

R Systems

beb0558d.description:
ABOUT VAGUS ENERGY:

Vagus Energy is an emerging Australian renewable energy company and is a proudly 100% Australian owned and operated delivering clean energy solutions across solar PV, battery storage, EV charging infrastructure, heat pump hot water systems at all. We work across residential, commercial, and industrial projects, supporting Australia’s transition to a low-carbon future through high-quality, compliant, and customer-focused energy solutions. Our team has been involved in the energy sector for more than a decade. We aim to create and foster energy solutions that achieve growth, excellence and sustainable development & wellbeing within our communities.

To fulfill our mission to deliver clean energy we are currently expanding our business and as a result we are on the lookout for talented, honest, goal-achieving and creative problem solvers to join our dynamic team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Solution Designer & Technical Support Specialist at Vagus Energy will be responsible for designing tailored renewable energy solutions and providing technical support across residential and commercial projects. The role involves preparing solar PV, battery storage, EV charger, and other new energy system designs, while also supporting customers, sales teams, installers, and technicians with technical queries, troubleshooting, documentation, and project-related support.

Skills and Experience

Essential

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in Electrical Engineering.
* Strong understanding of renewable energy systems
* Ability to read, understand, and translate technical specifications into practical system designs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Ability to work with CRM systems, MS SharePoint, and design tools.

Desirable

* Experience using solar design platforms such as Pylon or similar tools.
* Previous experience in solar, renewable energy, electrical design, or technical support.
* Understanding of Australian solar industry standards, state/national regulatory guidelines, and compliance requirements.
* Experience handling customer or installer technical queries via phone, email, or support systems.

Personal Attributes

* Self-motivated, enthusiastic, and willing to learn.
* Strong interest in sustainable and renewable energy.
* Customer-focused with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative and able to work closely with sales, operations, technical, and field teams.
* Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities while maintaining accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Renewable Energy System Design

4d2ce711.title: Solutions Engineer
4d2ce711.description:
**Meet the Team**
Join Cisco's Mass Scale Networks (MSN) team, a multifaceted group revolutionizing routing, optical, and automation solutions for the next generation of connectivity. We craft and deliver critical infrastructure platforms that power the largest global service providers, hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprise and public sector customers. Our mission: to enable businesses to thrive in a world of exponentially growing data, AI workloads, and seamless digital experiences.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As the Optical (Specialist) Solution Engineering Specialist within the MSN team, you will serve as the primary technical authority for positioning, architecting and driving Cisco's Optical and Routed Optical Networking solutions across Hyperscalers, NeoCloud Providers, Enterprise, Telecom Service Provider and Public Sector.
  
  
You will lead customer engagements, shape end-to-end Optical & RON network architectures, drive strategic technical pursuits and translate customer requirements into scalable, resilient and operationally sustainable solutions. You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering and Services teams to drive technical differentiation, strengthen customer relationships and accelerate adoption of Cisco's Optical portfolio.
  
  
You will provide deep technical expertise, solution architecture and pre-sales leadership across Cisco's portfolio, including:
  
  

* Optical Networking: Cisco NCS 1000 series DWDM line systems (NCS 1014, NCS 1001), amplifiers, protection switching and mux/demux, Routed Optical Networking, Acacia coherent optics, 400G/800G ZR/ZR+ pluggables
* Service Provider Routing: Cisco 8000 Series Routers, Cisco ASR 9000 Series, Cisco NCS Series
* Network Automation & Controllers: Cisco Optical Network Controller, Optical Site Manager, Optical Network Planner, Crosswork, Cisco NSO
* AI Networking Solutions: scalable scale-out and scale-across interconnect for GPU-powered infrastructure

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Pre-Sales:**

* Customer Engagement & Technical Leadership
* Engage with customer CTO organizations, Network Architects and Engineering teams.
* Understand customer network evolution, capacity requirements and technology roadmaps.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions and solution presentations.
* Establish Cisco's technology positioning against competing OEMs.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers.
* Solution Architecture & Design
* Design end-to-end optical transport solutions covering Metro, Long-Haul and Submarine networks.
* Develop DWDM, OTN, ROADM, Coherent Optical Architecture
* Architect Data Center Interconnect (DCI) solutions for hyperscalers and cloud providers.
* Develop converged IP + Optical network architectures.
* Perform optical link engineering, capacity planning and network optimization.
* Define network resiliency, protection and restoration strategies.
* Technical Sales & Opportunity Support
* Lead technical responses to RFI/RFP/RFQ requirements.
* Develop High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD) and Bill of Quantities (BoQ).
* Conduct technical feasibility assessments and proof-of-concept demonstrations.
* Support technical negotiations and commercial solution validation.
* Identify technology gaps and communicate customer requirements to Product Management.
* Product & Technology Expertise
* Drive technical positioning of Cisco's optical and IP portfolio.
* Demonstrate coherent technologies including 400G, 800G and next-generation optics.
* Position Coherent solutions and Optical line systems.
* Support network automation, software-defined networking and control-plane capabilities.
* Track industry technology developments and competitive positioning.

**Experience**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Optical Transport, DWDM or DCI design, engineering or operations, including ROADM, amplifier, protection and open or disaggregated line systems
* Proven experience as a Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect or equivalent in the telecommunications, cloud or networking industry
* Experience with hyperscale, cloud, wholesale or large service provider networks, ideally at multi-site or regional scale
* Experience engaging with key customers, understanding their needs, and applying industry best practices

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep knowledge of Coherent optics: DCO and ZR/ZR+ pluggables, modulation and probabilistic shaping, FEC, baud rate, and reach and capacity trade-offs
* Hands-on optical design experience for Layer 0 and Layer 1 DWDM networks across DCI, metro, core and subsea
* Strong IP-over-DWDM and routed optical networking fundamentals, with working knowledge of IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, SDN and NMS
* Experience with network automation and observability: NETCONF/YANG, gNMI streaming telemetry, APIs, and an optical controller or SDN platform
* Familiarity with managed service concepts: SLAs, change and incident processes, lifecycle management and acceptance testing

**Industry & Third-Party Vendor Knowledge**

* Working knowledge of competing and adjacent optical platforms and line systems from vendors such as Ciena, Nokia (including the former Infinera portfolio), Adtran/ADVA, Huawei and ZTE, and of router and switch vendors that support coherent pluggables, such as Juniper/HPE and Arista
* Understanding of the coherent optics and component ecosystem (DSP and module suppliers) and interoperability considerations across vendors
* Familiarity with standards and multi-vendor initiatives: OIF 400ZR/800ZR, OpenZR+, OpenROADM, ITU-T DWDM grids, IEEE Ethernet, and open line system and alien-wavelength operation
* Experience integrating or operating third-party line systems, transponders or OSS tools alongside your own platform, with clear views on demarcation and fault isolation in mixed-vendor environments
* Awareness of hyperscaler build models: leased vs. owned fiber, private builds, managed bandwidth vs. managed wavelength, and subsea vs. terrestrial strategies
* Understanding of fiber economics and supply, including dark fiber leasing, carrier partnerships, route diversity and regional regulatory or data-residency constraints

**Skills**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills at CXO level and for large audiences
* Ability to explain complex technology benefits in clear business language
* Strong listening skills and ability to extract key customer issues
* Ability to build senior executive relationships and position complex solutions
* Demonstrated awareness of Hyperscaler, Neocloud and SP market trends
* Project management and collaboration skills in multi-functional engineering environments

**Desired Characteristics**

* Viewed as the "go-to" specialist for account teams on Optical, DCI and Routed Optical Networking business opportunities
* Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset
* Ability to work in a highly matrixed, global organization
* Strong technical documentation and solution architecture skills
* Experience with AI/GPU cluster networking, scale-across architectures and power-constrained data center design
* Optical Design working experience with Transponder, DCO 400G/800G, C+L band expansion
* Experience competing against and displacing incumbent optical vendors in hyperscaler or service provider accounts
* Optical or networking certifications such as CCIE (SP), CCDE or vendor optical certifications
* Passion for staying current with emerging technologies and industry trends

**Why Cisco?**
At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. Our MSN portfolio is at the forefront of enabling the next generation of connectivity for AI workloads, massive data growth, and seamless digital experiences.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

4dcda3f9.description:
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Deliver end-to-end DFT solutions for customer designs, from architecture planning and scan insertion through pattern generation, silicon bring-up, and diagnostics analysis
* Implement and validate test solutions including scan, MBIST, and IEEE 1687 architectures for complex SoCs with multiple IP blocks
* Participate in customer design reviews to understand their flows, identify gaps, and propose specific improvements that reduce test time or increase coverage
* Prototype and validate new DFT methodologies in collaboration with Solution Architects, proving out viability before customer deployment
* Provide technical support and training to customers, including hands-on problem resolution, methodology workshops, and account-level engagement
* Conduct product demonstrations, competitive benchmarking, and evaluations to help win new customers and expand adoption of Synopsys test solutions
* Analyze silicon test data, diagnose failures, and present findings to both internal teams and customer stakeholders with clear recommendations

  

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable first-time silicon success for customers by delivering robust, validated DFT solutions that catch issues before tapeout
* Accelerate time-to-market for automotive and consumer electronics customers by optimizing their test flows and reducing pattern generation cycles
* Expand Synopsys' footprint in next-generation test technologies by proving out new methodologies that become standard practice across accounts
* Build long-term customer relationships that turn one-time engagements into strategic partnerships, increasing account value and retention
* Raise the technical capability of customer teams through training and knowledge transfer, creating a multiplier effect beyond individual projects
* Shape the direction of Synopsys test products by feeding real-world customer challenges and use cases back to R&D teams
* Contribute to measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and silicon yield across diverse customer programs

  

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree with 7+ years or Master's degree with 5+ years in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* Hands-on experience with RTL coding, DFT insertion, ATPG pattern generation, and silicon bring-up for digital ICs
* Deep knowledge of scan architectures, fault models, test access networks, and IEEE standards including 1149.1, 1500, and 1687
* Proven ability to handle scan implementation and validation for large, multi-IP SoCs with complex hierarchies and multiple clock domains
* Experience with MBIST concepts, architecture planning, and integration in automotive or safety-critical design environments is a strong plus
* Familiarity with industry-standard DFT tools and flows, exposure to Synopsys TetraMAX, DFT Compiler, or MBIST Architect is valuable
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to translate technical concepts for both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders

  

**Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer design review, absorb their methodology in real time, and walk out with three specific recommendations they can act on next week
* You are comfortable working independently on complex technical problems while knowing when to pull in a Solution Architect or R&D engineer for a second opinion
* You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, keeping track of where each project stands and what needs to happen next
* You prototype quickly and iterate based on feedback, treating customer pushback as useful signal rather than friction
* You explain tradeoffs clearly, whether you are talking to a junior engineer learning DFT or a VP trying to understand why test time matters for their product schedule
* You stay current on emerging test standards and methodologies because you are genuinely curious about where the technology is headed, not just what you need to know today

4335a0b2.title: Dynamics 365 F&O Solution Architect
4335a0b2.description:
About BizApps Studio

BizApps Studio is an independent team of Microsoft specialists. We design and deliver Dynamics 365 (Finance and Operations and Customer Engagement), Power Platform, data and agentic AI for clients in Australia, India and the UAE. We work from Melbourne, Sydney and Chennai, and most of our delivery is remote.

On the ERP side we implement, upgrade and support Finance, Supply Chain and Project Operations. We also build our own software. Comply checks invoices from Dynamics 365 and other ERPs against the UAE e-invoicing rules and sends them to the customer's accredited service provider. Vouch is an expense management app that runs inside the customer's own Dataverse.

Many of us came from the client side, so we know what a bad go-live weekend feels like. We plan to avoid them.

About the role

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations architect who is equally comfortable in a finance workshop and in X++. You will own the solution and technical design on our F&O engagements: new implementations, AX 2012 upgrades and integration-heavy programmes.

A growing part of our F&O work is about bringing AI into finance and supply chain processes safely. Think of an agent that matches bank statement lines, codes vendor invoices or drafts accrual journals, while a finance lead still approves every posting.

What you will work on

- Solution and technical architecture for Finance, Supply Chain Management and Project Operations

- AX 2012 to D365 F&O migrations: code upgrade strategy, data migration approach, cut-over planning and the uncomfortable conversations about customisations that should not come across

- Integrations using DMF and data packages, OData, custom services, business events and Dual-write, with Azure Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus and API Management in between

- Extending F&O with Power Platform and Dataverse instead of adding X++ for every requirement

- E-invoicing designs, including our Comply product for UAE customers

- AI agents and Copilot features in finance processes, with clear audit trails and human approval

- Environment strategy, deployments and release pipelines in Azure DevOps

How we use AI in delivery

Our developers use GitHub Copilot for X++ extensions, Functions, integration code and unit tests. We also use it to draft design documents, data mapping sheets and test scenarios. We expect you to use these tools with good judgement, and to review AI output the way you would review a junior developer's work.

What a typical week looks like

Early in the week you lead a workshop with a client's finance team on their intercompany process across four legal entities, and politely push back on rebuilding a report standard F&O already provides. Next you review a data migration run where open vendor balances do not reconcile, and you trace it to a currency revaluation setting. Midweek you design an integration where sales orders arrive through Service Bus and business events tell a warehouse system when stock is reserved. Later you decide with our AI lead how far an agent should go when proposing accruals.

What we are looking for

- 10+ years with Dynamics AX and D365 F&O, with at least 3 years in an architect or lead role

- Strong functional knowledge of finance (GL, AP, AR, cash and bank, fixed assets, tax) and working knowledge of supply chain

- Solid X++ and extension model experience. You need to know when a design will hurt in production

- Real integration experience with DMF, OData, business events and Dual-write, and with Azure Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus and API Management

- Practical Power Platform experience alongside F&O

- Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or other AI coding tools, and real interest in how AI agents can work inside an ERP with proper controls

- You can explain a design to a finance controller and to a developer, and write both down

Nice to have

- MB-500, MB-700 or MB-310 certifications

- An AX 2012 to D365 upgrade you led from start to finish

- E-invoicing or VAT experience, especially in the UAE or GCC

- Experience with clients in Australia or the UAE, and comfort working across those time zones for a few hours each week

How we work

We are a small, senior team, so you will have real influence from the start. You will work directly with our leadership, including our F&O and AI architect. We work remotely and write things down, and we keep meetings for decisions that need them.

Why join us

- You will set the F&O architecture standards for a growing Microsoft partner

- You will work on AI in finance processes as it moves from pilots into production

- Flexible remote work from anywhere in India

- Time and support to keep learning and to work towards Microsoft certifications

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn on the BizApps Studio page. A few lines about the hardest F&O migration or integration you have worked on, and what you would do differently today, will tell us more than a long cover letter.

Our process is simple: an intro conversation about your experience and what you are looking for, a technical discussion where we work through a realistic scenario together (no take-home assignment), and a final conversation with our leadership team.

By supporting METRO’s sCore strategy, we enable sustainable growth and strengthen business processes. With a solutions-first mindset, we reduce complexity, accelerate transformation, and create measurable value for METRO businesses scaling up globally. It supports businesses that keep the world running, from hotels, restaurants, and cafés to local retailers - offering quality, reliability, and smart solutions that help small and medium-sized businesses succeed.

Headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, METRO AG employs over 85,000 people worldwide and acts as the central management holding company of the group, driving strategic direction, and enabling consistent excellence across all markets. Around the world, METRO has approx. 15 million customers who benefit from the wholesale company’s unique multichannel mix: customers can purchase their goods in one of the large stores in their area as well as by delivery (Food Service Distribution, FSD) – all digitally supported and connected. In parallel, METRO MARKETS is being developed as an international online marketplace for professional customers, which has been growing and expanding continuously since 2019.

Acting sustainably is one of the company principles of METRO, which has been listed in various sustainability indices and rankings, including MSCI, Sustainalytics and CDP.

**Job Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Based at METRO Digital India in Pune, the SAP S/4HANA Solution Architect P2P will own the end-to-end solution architecture for Purchase to Pay within LUCA. The role combines deep functional understanding of procurement, accounts payable and invoice-management processes with the technical judgement required to govern integrations, workflows, extensions and implementation decisions. Working with Process Leads, Process Owners, country teams, technology teams and implementation partners, the architect will ensure that SAP AP, SAP MM, SAP Ariba, OpenText Vendor Invoice Management and connected systems operate as one coherent solution.

**Your responsibilities**

**Solution architecture and design**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the P2P process stream across SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP procurement solutions and connected partner systems, ensuring alignment with the LUCA global template and METRO architecture principles.
* Translate business requirements into coherent functional and technical designs covering procurement-to-invoice integration, supplier invoices, accounts payable, payment preparation, purchasing integration, service and maintenance procurement, SAP Ariba and OpenText Vendor Invoice Management.
* Lead and support Fit-to-Standard workshops, identify gaps and determine whether requirements should be addressed through standard functionality, process change, approved extensions, interfaces or workflow design.
* Advise Process Leads and Process Owners on architectural decisions and their implications for business operations, controls, invoice processing, data, integrations and supportability.
* Review and approve end-to-end designs, configuration concepts, functional specifications, workflow designs and integration solutions within the assigned architecture scope.

**OpenText VIM and integration governance**

* Provide solution-architecture leadership for OpenText Vendor Invoice Management integrated with SAP S/4HANA, including invoice capture and ingestion, validation, business rules, approval workflows, exception handling, posting and status transparency.
* Ensure the VIM solution supports relevant PO-based and non-PO invoice scenarios and is coherently integrated with SAP AP, MM, Ariba and associated document and workflow services.
* Assess VIM enhancements and configuration choices for alignment with business controls, auditability, operational efficiency, clean-core principles and sustainable support.
* Ensure consistent integration across SAP AP, MM, PM, Ariba, OpenText VIM and relevant upstream and downstream partner systems.
* Oversee interfaces, extensions and enhancements, minimising unnecessary deviation from standard solutions and protecting maintainability.
* Identify cross-stream dependencies with Finance, procurement, master data, integration, security, tax, reporting and country rollout teams, and drive them to resolution.

**Testing, deployment and stabilisation**

* Define architecture-relevant acceptance criteria and support integration, end-to-end, workflow, regression and user-acceptance test preparation for P2P and VIM scenarios.
* Support defect analysis and resolution, including review and approval of solution corrections and required transports within the P2P scope.
* Provide architectural input to supplier and transactional data migration, cutover planning, system-readiness assessment and go-live decisions.

* Support post-go-live stabilization, analyze invoice-processing bottlenecks and recurring defects, and identify opportunities for process and system optimization.

**Qualifications**

**Experience and knowledge**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Finance, Procurement or a related discipline.
* At least 10 years of SAP experience with substantial responsibility for P2P or accounts-payable solution design in complex transformation or implementation programmes.
* At least 6 years of strong hands-on experience with OpenText Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) for SAP Solutions, covering solution design, configuration, implementation and rollout in complex SAP environments.
* Strong practical knowledge of VIM configuration, including Document Types, invoice-processing scenarios, approval workflows, business rules, data-capture and validation rules, exception handling and posting logic.
* Deep functional and solution-architecture expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance Accounts Payable and its integration with SAP Materials Management.
* Good knowledge of SAP Ariba integration and procurement processes; knowledge of SAP PM-related procurement scenarios is advantageous.
* Understanding of supplier invoices, PO and non-PO processing, account assignment, tax and posting dependencies, approvals, payment preparation and reconciliation.
* Experience designing SAP and non-SAP interfaces and coordinating dependencies across procurement, Finance, data, workflow, document processing and reporting.
* Experience supporting Fit-to-Standard, testing, migration, cutover and post-go-live stabilisation across at least one full implementation lifecycle.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori and SAP Business Technology Platform is advantageous.
* SAP Finance, procurement or OpenText VIM certification and retail-industry experience are advantageous.

**Ways of working**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate business needs, solution options, risks and architectural trade-offs.
* Clear and articulate communication with business, functional and technical stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
* Ability to facilitate decisions, challenge constructively and build alignment across process teams, technology teams and implementation partners.
* High level of ownership, quality orientation and attention to detail in a complex multinational programme environment.
* Excellent written and spoken English; willingness and ability to travel when required

**Additional Information**

**Measures of success**

* P2P and VIM designs provide an integrated, controlled and supportable solution aligned with the LUCA global template.
* Invoice-processing requirements are translated into clear architecture decisions covering SAP AP, MM, Ariba, VIM, workflows, documents and partner-system dependencies.
* Business controls, approval workflows, exception handling and audit requirements are reflected consistently in the solution design.
* Cross-stream dependencies and design risks are identified early and resolved before they affect testing or rollout milestones.
* Custom developments and interfaces are justified, governed and kept to the minimum necessary.
* The P2P and VIM solution is testable, deployable and stable, with bottlenecks and recurring defects resolved sustainably.

155273a0.title: SAP SD Integration Architect
155273a0.description:
# SAP SD Integration Architect
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 10–17 Years
* Location:\*\* Pune
* Job Type:\*\* Full-Time

## Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced \*\*SAP SD Lead Consultant\*\* with strong expertise in SAP Sales and Distribution, S/4HANA and end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing SAP SD functional activities, understanding business requirements, configuring solutions(916) and coordinating with cross-functional teams to deliver effective business solutions.
  
  
This role requires a combination of hands-on SAP SD expertise, implementation experience, integration knowledge and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams.
  
  
## Key Responsibilities
  
  
### SAP SD Functional Expertise
  
  

* Manage SAP SD functional activities, including configuration and implementation across sales orders, pricing, delivery, billing, returns and credit management.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into suitable SAP SD solutions.
* Conduct requirement-gathering sessions and functional workshops with business stakeholders.
* Prepare functional documentation and ensure solutions follow established SAP standards.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to existing sales and distribution workflows.

### SAP S/4HANA Implementation
  
  

* Participate in end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation, rollout and transformation projects.
* Handle functional activities across requirement analysis, solution design, configuration, testing and go-live.
* Support data migration, cutover planning, deployment and post-implementation activities.
* Coordinate with implementation partners and internal teams to ensure smooth project delivery.

### Cross-Functional Integration
  
  

* Work closely with SAP FI, MM and PP teams to manage integration across business processes.
* Handle integration scenarios involving sales, finance, inventory, procurement and production.
* Identify and resolve issues related to customer master data, material master, stock availability and order fulfilment.
* Coordinate with technical teams for enhancements, interfaces and custom development requirements.

### Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Prepare functional specifications for technical developments and system enhancements.
* Coordinate integration testing and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Troubleshoot complex SAP SD issues and perform root-cause analysis.
* Provide production support and resolve recurring functional issues.
* Maintain functional documentation and support business users through training and knowledge transfer.

### Team & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Work with global business stakeholders, IT teams and external implementation partners.
* Guide functional consultants and provide technical support on SAP SD-related activities.
* Manage project dependencies, identify risks and ensure timely resolution of functional issues.
* Communicate effectively with business and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle.

## Required Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience in \*\*SAP SD configuration and functional implementation\*\*.
* Good understanding of end-to-end \*\*Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes\*\*.
* Experience in \*\*SAP S/4HANA implementation, conversion or rollout projects\*\*.
* Strong knowledge of pricing, sales orders, delivery, billing, returns and intercompany processes.
* Practical integration experience with \*\*SAP FI, MM and PP modules\*\*.
* Experience in functional requirement gathering, solution design and documentation.
* Knowledge of master data management, availability checks and order fulfilment processes.
* Experience in functional testing, UAT, data migration, cutover and hypercare.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues and perform root-cause analysis.

## Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with Variant Configuration and configurable products.
* Knowledge of Make-to-Order (MTO) business processes.
* Experience with intercompany sales and distribution processes.
* Exposure to CRM and CPQ integrations.
* Understanding of Indian GST and e-invoicing integrations.
* SAP certification.
* Knowledge of the German language.

## Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
* 10–17 years of overall professional experience, with strong relevant experience in SAP SD.
* Hands-on SAP SD configuration experience.
* Experience in at least \*\*2 end-to-end SAP implementations or major rollouts\*\*, including S/4HANA implementation, conversion or rollout.
* Strong understanding of SAP FI, MM and PP integration.
* Experience working with international teams and business stakeholders.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills.

## Preferred Candidate Profile
  
  

* Strong functional and technical problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to independently manage SAP SD workstreams.
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Comfortable coordinating with global teams and implementation partners.
* Ability to guide consultants and support business users.
* Strong ownership of implementation and delivery activities.
* Joining Preference:\*\* Candidates who can join within 15–30 days will be preferred.

Skills: order-to-cash (o2c),sap sd configuration,sap s/4hana implementation,conversion,requirement gathering,sap fi

Master's Degree

* Custom Code Enhancements: Experience with designing and developing custom code enhancements for Salesforce.com, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.
* Integration and Data Conversion: Experience in integrating Salesforce.com solutions with other systems and converting data to meet business needs.
* Technical Excellence: Deep expertise in establishing and maintaining technical excellence in Salesforce.com solutions, staying up-to-date with the latest platform features and best practices.
* Solution Testing and Validation: Experience with collaborating with cross-functional teams to test and validate Salesforce.com solutions, ensuring high-quality delivery.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Salesforce.com Platform Features: Deep expertise in staying up-to-date with the latest Salesforce.com platform features and best practices to drive technical excellence in solution design and implementation.

b4c68906.title: Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Lead
b4c68906.description:
**Skills & Responsibilities**

**1.  Sales & Service Cloud Solution Design:**

* Lead endtoend architecture and delivery of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud solutions to support automotive customercare and commercial processes.
* Conduct design workshops for key CRM capabilities including LeadtoOrder, Case Management, Entitlements, SLAs, and Knowledge Management.
* Define scalable data models, record types, page layouts, and sharing rules for multiregion deployments.
* Ensure technical designs comply with Salesforce best practices, governance standards, and platform limits.

**2.  Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC) Development:**

* Develop complex Apex classes, triggers, batch/queueable processes, and automation services for Sales and Service use cases.
* Build **LWC** and Aura components to deliver userfriendly, highperformance interfaces across Service Console and Sales Applications.
* Apply SOQL/SOSL optimization and enforce Salesforce governorlimit best practices in all code deliverables.

**3.  Sales Cloud Capabilities:**

* Configure and extend Sales Cloud features including Opportunity Management, Forecasting, QuotetoCash workflows, and Territory Management.
* Support CPQadjacent automation and approval processes suited to automotive sales lifecycles.
* Integrate Sales Cloud with ERP, DMS, marketing systems, and other enterprise platforms.

**4.  Service Cloud Capabilities:**

* Implement and optimize Service Cloud capabilities including Case Management, OmniChannel routing, Service Console, Entitlements, and Milestones.
* Configure Knowledge Base, CTI integrations, quick actions, and productivity accelerators such as Macros.
* Drive automation using Flows.

**5.  Integration:**

* Design and implement integrations across Salesforce and external systems (ERP, telephony, DMS, OEM platforms) using APIs, Platform Events, and MuleSoft.
* Ensure integration patterns follow best practices for reliability, scalability, and data consistency.

**6.  Collaboration and Documentation:**

* Work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, and business stakeholders to convert functional requirements into robust technical designs.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, data flow diagrams, and deployment runbooks.
* Lead code review processes and ensure adherence to development standards.

**7.  Mentorship, Leadership and Knowledge Sharing:**

* Lead and mentor Salesforce developers across Sales and Service Cloud workstreams, supporting skill development and code quality.
* Manage technical planning, estimation, and sprint activities within designated project tracks.
* Champion continuous improvement, proactively identifying opportunities for platform optimization.
* Oversee and validate all configuration and code changes progressing through environments.
* Stay current with Salesforce releases, new features, and emerging capabilities to guide solution evolution.

**8.  Certifications:**

* Required: Salesforce Platform Developer I.
* Preferred: Salesforce Platform Developer II, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Salesforce Administrator.

406ae4fd.title: Data Information Architect
406ae4fd.description:
About the Role   
Within Jet2 Travel Technologies Data Engineering & Analytics Department, we're improving the way analytical data assets are designed, governed and delivered across the organisation.   
As part of this, our Analytics Design Squads bring together Data Architecture, Data Governance, Business Analysis and domain expertise earlier in the delivery lifecycle. The aim is to shape analytical solutions clearly before development begins, so delivery teams receive well-structured, consistent and practical design artefacts.   
We're looking for a Data Architect to help turn business concepts, source data understanding and analytical requirements into high-quality logical models, dimensional models, data flows, mappings and design documentation.   
Role emphasis   
This is a hands-on role. A significant part of the work will involve logical and dimensional modelling, SQL-based data profiling, source analysis and preparing designs that can be handed into delivery.   
  
What You'll Be Doing   
Data Modelling & Analytical Design   
•    Use agreed conceptual models and business definitions to produce clear, delivery-ready Logical Data Models.   
•    Create dimensional analytical designs using Kimball-style techniques, including facts, dimensions, measures, grain and conformed business concepts.   
•    Create logical models for transformation and dimensional layers, including entities, relationships, attributes and supporting definitions.   
•    Produce source-to-target mappings, transformation notes and supporting design documentation for analytical delivery teams.   
•    Work with first-party and third-party data providers to understand available data, data contracts and the most appropriate sources to support analytics use cases.   
•    Profile and investigate source data using SQL and other analysis techniques to understand quality, completeness, usefulness and design implications.   
•    Identify assumptions, risks, issues and dependencies that need to be understood before work moves into delivery.   
Data Flows, Lineage & Source Understanding   
•    Develop Data Flow Diagrams and lineage views showing how data moves from first-party or third-party sources into the analytics platform and through analytical layers.   
•    Help identify the system of record or master source for key data concepts, so the right data is sourced for analytical products.   
•    Document how data progresses through layered or medallion-style analytics architecture, including where it is transformed, curated and consumed.   
•    Support longer-term reuse of business concepts and ontology-style modelling across analytics, integrations, APIs, AI and application development where appropriate.   
Analytics Design Squads   
•    Work within cross-functional Analytics Design Squads alongside Business Analysts, Data Governance specialists, Data Owners, Data Stewards, Product Owners, engineers and domain experts.   
•    Support squad-aligned domains such as Commercial and Finance, Operations and HR, and Customer.   
•    Work to standards defined by Senior Data Architects / Senior Data Information Architects and collaborate with Solution Architects where estimates, RAID items or delivery impacts need to be understood.   
•    Support handover of designs into delivery planning and help resolve design questions or defects that arise during development.   
Governance & Quality   
•    Ensure analytical designs align with agreed modelling standards, naming conventions, governance expectations and platform patterns.   
•    Contribute to metadata, lineage, ownership and data quality discussions as part of the design process.   
•    Challenge assumptions constructively where source data, definitions or mapping logic are incomplete or unclear.   
•    Help improve reusable modelling patterns and design approaches as the architecture function matures.   
Communication & Collaboration   
•    Explain models, data flows and design decisions clearly to technical and non-technical colleagues.   
•    Work collaboratively within a squad environment, balancing good architectural discipline with practical delivery needs.   
•    Use clear, structured communication to support alignment with Business Analysis, Data Governance, Engineering and product teams.   
Skills & Experience   
Essential skills & experience         Desirable experience   
• Hands-on experience creating logical data models or analytical data designs.     • Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform.   
• Dimensional modelling experience using Kimball-style techniques, including facts, dimensions, measures and grain.     • Alation or other data catalogue, metadata management or lineage tooling.   
• Strong SQL skills, with experience querying data to investigate structure, quality, completeness and suitability.     • Layered or medallion-style analytics architecture.   
• Experience profiling and analysing data to support data model design decisions.     • Data contracts, third-party data feeds, APIs, files or source system extraction patterns.   
• Experience producing data flow diagrams, lineage views, source-to-target mappings or equivalent design artefacts.     • Agile or Scaled Agile delivery environments.   
• Understanding of data warehousing, analytical data products or reporting/insight delivery.     • Interest in AI and how AI can support data, architecture, modelling and delivery practices.   
•    Experience working with a modern analytical platform, data     • Travel, airline or retail industry experience.   
warehouse or large-scale relational database environment.   
•    Ability to translate business requirements and conceptual      designs into practical data structures.   
•    Clear communication skills and the ability to work      effectively within a cross-functional squad.   
Personal Attributes   
•    Practical, structured and detail-oriented.   
•    Curious about how data is created, moved, transformed and used.   
•    Comfortable investigating ambiguity and asking good questions.   
•    Able to challenge assumptions constructively and professionally.   
•    Collaborative and able to work well with business, governance and engineering colleagues.   
•    Pragmatic, with a good balance of delivery focus and architectural discipline.   
•    Interested in continuous improvement, including how AI and automation can improve architecture and modelling practices.   
Success in the Role   
•    Create clear, accurate and useful logical models, dimensional models, mappings, data flows and lineage artefacts.   
•    Improve the quality and completeness of designs before work enters delivery.   
•    Help delivery teams understand what needs to be built and why.   
•    Support better governance, ownership and understanding of analytical data assets.   
•    Build effective

5053b7a7.title: Senior Manager - Solution Architect
5053b7a7.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end design of

scalable, resilient applications while establishing practical technical governance, security

controls, and Business Continuity Planning (BCP).

In this role, you will work directly with engineering teams to architect modern cloud systems,

ensure security best practices are embedded early, and build fail-safe disaster recovery

strategies. Rather than managing abstract enterprise frameworks, your focus will be on

pragmatic architecture, actionable governance, and operational resilience across our core

systems.

  

**Role & responsibilities**

* Experience: 8+ years of experience in software engineering and cloud systems, with 3+years in a Solution Architect or Lead Systems Architect role.
* Hands-on Architecture: Proven experience designing scalable distributed systems on public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Security & Resilience: Demonstrated experience embedding security controls (IAM, encryption, network security) and designing multi-region/HA disaster recovery solutions.
* Modern Stack Knowledge: Hands-on experience with microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), Serverless, APIs, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi).
* Pragmatic Governance: Experience establishing technical guardrails, ADR processes,and dependency management in agile engineering environments.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

* Cloud Architecture: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional), Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or GCP Professional Cloud Architect.
* Security & BCP: Cloud Security certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CCSP) or practical business continuity credentials.

  

**Key Competencies & Soft Skills**

* Pragmatic Mindset: Focus on workable, simple solutions over overly complex or purely theoretical architecture models.
* Collaborative Leadership: Ability to earn respect from engineering teams and influence design decisions without relying on top-down authority.
* Technical Communication: Skill in breaking down architectural tradeoffs, risks, and security decisions for both business stakeholders and developers.
* Risk Management: Good judgment in balancing speed of feature delivery with long-term system stability, security, and recoverability.

f3ecc580.title: Consultant | Automation | Bengaluru | Engineering | Hybrid Cloud Engineering
f3ecc580.description: We are looking for a **Automation Engineer (Consultant)** to support an SRE Lean transformation project by identifying, developing, and implementing automation opportunities across SRE processes. The role will focus on building lightweight **AI-enabled automations** to reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and support data-driven decision-making.

64129437.title: Senior Oracle Cloud Integration Consultant - OIC
64129437.description:
Profiles can be shared with Saloni.shah@Winfosolutions.com

  
  

**Oracle Cloud Integration Specialist (OIC) – ERP + SCM**

Experience: 5 - 8 Years

Location: Hyderabad || Chennai || Bangalore

Availability: Immediate / 30 days

  

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Oracle Cloud Integration professional (5–8 years)** with strong expertise in **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** and functional understanding of **Oracle ERP Cloud** and **Oracle SCM / WMS**. The role involves designing, building and supporting integrations between Oracle Fusion modules (ERP/SCM/WMS) and external enterprise applications using OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, Oracle adapters, and event-driven patterns. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable integrations.

Key Responsibilities

OIC Integration Development & Delivery

* Design and develop integrations using **OIC (Orchestrations/Integrations)**, including synchronous and asynchronous patterns.

* Order Management / Inventory / Shipping / Receiving

* Procurement flows (PO, receipts, invoices), supplier integration

API & Cloud Integration Architecture

* Implement event-driven integrations using **Business Events**, call-backs, and/or scheduled orchestration.

Must-Have

* Solid experience integrating **Oracle ERP Cloud** and **Oracle SCM / WMS** (at least one end-to-end project).
* Strong knowledge of:
* **REST/SOAP web services**
* **OIC integrations, connections, and adapters**
* **Data mapping and transformation** (OIC mapper, XSLT concepts)
* **Error handling, monitoring, and operational support**

Good-to-Have

* Experience with **OCI services** (API Gateway, Streaming, Functions) is a plus.

Education

Soft Skills / Behavioural Competencies

#### **Job Description**

**Title :** Engagement Manager, Life Sciences

**Location :** Warrenville, IL (hybrid) or Bengaluru, India

**Type :** Full-time, base plus variable compensation

**Travel :** Up to 30% for customer QBRs, executive meetings, and industry events

#### **About Cloudbyz**

Cloudbyz builds the unified, Salesforce-native eClinical platform for life sciences. Our suite spans CTMS, eTMF, EDC, Clinical Trial Financial Management (CTFM), and Safety & Pharmacovigilance, extended by a portfolio of AI agents built on Salesforce Agentforce.

We serve pharma, biotech, CROs, SMOs, medical device, diagnostics, and cosmetics organizations. Headquartered in Warrenville, Illinois, with a delivery center in Bengaluru, India, we are a fast-growing challenger to legacy eClinical vendors, winning on one data model, faster deployment, and lower total cost.

#### **About the role**

The Engagement Manager owns Cloudbyz customer engagements end to end, from signed SOW to go-live and handover, delivering on scope, on time and on budget while growing the account.

You will be the senior point of contact for customer sponsors, lead cross-functional delivery teams (implementation consultants, Salesforce developers, validation and QA), and turn customer outcomes into references and expansion revenue.

#### **Key responsibilities**

##### **Engagement delivery**

* Own a portfolio of concurrent implementations (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, Safety/PV, eISF, eSign) from kickoff through hypercare.
* Build and run the project plan, RAID log, resource plan and status reporting; chair weekly customer status and monthly steering committees.
* Manage scope against the SOW, and raise, price and close change orders promptly.
* Track budget, margin and utilization; forecast revenue recognition with Finance.
* Ensure deliverables meet GxP expectations: computer system validation (CSV/CSA), 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH E6(R3) and GDPR where applicable.

##### **Customer relationship**

* Act as the trusted advisor to sponsor, CRO and site stakeholders, from clinical operations leads to VP-level executives.
* Run discovery and requirements workshops; translate clinical and safety workflows into Salesforce-native configuration.
* Manage escalations calmly and transparently, with clear recovery plans.

##### **Team leadership**

* Lead blended onshore/offshore teams of implementation consultants, Salesforce developers, data migration and validation specialists.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering on roadmap gaps, defects and AI agent (Agentforce) deployments.
* Coach consultants and contribute to delivery methodology, templates and playbooks.

##### **Growth**

* Identify expansion opportunities (additional modules, studies, users, AI agents) and partner with Account Management and Sales to convert them.
* Secure references, case studies and renewals from successful go-lives.
* Work with SI and reseller partners on co-delivered engagements where relevant.

#### **Required qualifications**

* 8+ years in professional services or consulting, including 4+ years managing enterprise SaaS engagements with P&L or budget accountability.
* Hands-on delivery experience in life sciences technology: CTMS, eTMF, EDC, Safety/PV or adjacent clinical systems.
* Working knowledge of GxP, CSV/CSA, 21 CFR Part 11 and the clinical trial lifecycle.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with distributed onshore/offshore teams.
* Strong executive presence; clear written and verbal communication with sponsor and CRO leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, computer science or a related field.

#### **Preferred qualifications**

* Salesforce platform experience; Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Consultant or Agentforce Specialist).
* Prior experience at an eClinical systems vendor or a CRO.
* PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile/Scrum certification.
* Experience with data migration from legacy clinical systems.
* Exposure to AI/agentic workflow deployments in regulated environments.

#### **How to apply**

Send your resume and a short note on an engagement you rescued or grew to careers@cloudbyz.com.

*Cloudbyz is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on any basis protected by law.*

As a core member of the Customer Program Management team, you'll work with the world's largest cloud service providers, hyperscalers, and their OEM/ODM partners to bring AI infrastructure to life at unprecedented scale!
  
  
This role lives at the exciting intersection of engineering, operations, and customer engagement. We're looking for someone who brings deep technical program management skills, a strong engineering background, and a love for fast-paced environments where success comes down to tight alignment, sharp judgment, and great partnership. We work together across global teams to turn ambitious plans into successful customer deployments.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define program schedules, deliverables, and key milestones, keeping them tightly aligned with customer and partner requirements.
* Translate customer requirements into clear, actionable plans across engineering, quality, logistics, and sales, and drive issues to resolution before they become roadblocks.
* Lead horizontally across cross-functional teams, navigating high-priority critical issues and rallying globally dispersed teams around a shared set of objectives.
* Serve as the face of NVIDIA to the customer, leading program kick-offs, technical deep dives, design reviews, issue and bug tracking, qualification and validation efforts, and status updates throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive program execution from early design through production deployment, ensuring timely delivery, exceptional quality, and customer acceptance.
* Champion post-deployment sustaining support, acting as case manager for the issues that matter most.
* Monitor factory production schedules, yields, and blockers, partnering closely with ODMs and contract manufacturers to crush issues and hit operational targets.
* Communicate program health, risks, and key issues proactively to customers, internal partners, and leadership across Hardware, Software, Operations, Business, Quality, Sales, and Product teams, keeping everyone aligned while moving at full speed.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of program or project management experience in the IT industry.
* Strong technical background in hardware and/or software engineering, with experience working closely with cloud providers and their OEM/ODMs on AI factory build-outs.
* A proven track record of leading complex, global programs from concept through deployment and production.
* Outstanding program management, communication, and organizational skills, prioritizing the right issues and driving cross-functional alignment.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across global teams and navigate multicultural, multinational business environments with ease.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with a talent for distilling complex technical concepts for any audience, from engineers to executives.
* Willingness to travel as required (up to 10%) and a love for fast-paced, dynamic environments.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* We value deep experience leading technical programs for CSPs and OEMs, along with hands-on expertise in large-scale data center buildouts, deployment, and supply chain coordination. A track record running end-to-end hardware and software product development and data center deployment, including accelerated computing platforms at scale, will help you stand out.
* We also value strong leadership in matrixed collaboration, conflict resolution, and consensus-building, alongside proven expertise managing production schedules, optimizing line yields, and resolving complex field quality challenges.
* Demonstrated success in dynamic, high-growth environments—with adaptability to ambiguity, rapid change, and matrixed team structures—is another way to stand out.

70a18ab9.title: Digital Innovation - Technical Program Manager
70a18ab9.description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Digital Innovation Technical Program Manager (TPM) leads the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex AI and Digital Innovation programs across the enterprise. This role translates strategic business and technology priorities into executable programs, with clear roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, governance, and measurable outcomes. The TPM will play a central role in advancing enterprise AI priority programs and delivering AI platforms and products at scale.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology, product delivery, and program execution, the TPM coordinates across business and technical stakeholders and is accountable for driving execution, enabling timely decisions, resolving risks and dependencies, and ensuring programs deliver intended business value while meeting enterprise governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI expectations.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution of complex AI and Digital Innovation programs, establishing clear program objectives, scope, roadmaps, milestones, releases, dependencies, governance, and success measures.
* Drive enterprise AI priority programs from strategic direction through execution, coordinating multiple workstreams and ensuring alignment to business priorities, technology strategy, and expected outcomes.
* Coordinate delivery of enterprise AI platforms and products, partnering with product, engineering, data, AI, architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business teams. Partner with AI & Data Science on feasibility, solution evaluation, model hand-offs, and performance requirements, while retaining accountability for program delivery rather than AI solution quality or model performance.
* Translate business and technology priorities into executable technical programs by defining delivery plans, sequencing work, clarifying ownership, and establishing the decisions and dependencies required for successful execution.
* Orchestrate cross-functional execution across business, IT, product, engineering, data and AI, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, governance, Centers of Excellence, and external partners to maintain alignment and accelerate delivery.
* Lead program-level governance and delivery reviews, providing visibility into program health, resource needs, dependencies, trade-offs, risks, decisions, and delivery commitments. Contribute program information and recommendations to Operations-led intake, portfolio reviews, governance forums, and leadership reviews without assuming ownership of the portfolio operating system.
* Manage complex cross-program dependencies and resource constraints, identifying conflicts early, evaluating impacts, and driving resolution or escalation to maintain delivery momentum.
* Identify and resolve program risks and execution barriers, bringing the appropriate business and technical leaders together to make timely decisions and address issues before they materially affect outcomes.
* Ensure responsible delivery of AI-enabled capabilities by integrating cybersecurity, data privacy, compliance, responsible AI, architecture, and governance requirements into program planning and execution.
* Maintain current program scope, owners, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and actions in Jira as the single source of program status. Provide concise, decision-ready metrics, dashboards, risk assessments, and recommendations to support Operations-led portfolio reporting and executive reviews.
* Apply Agile and product delivery practices appropriate to each initiative, coordinating releases, testing, deployment, and go-live decisions through defined readiness gates. Partner with AI & Digital Enablement on training, communications, business readiness, adoption, and feedback, while that team leads change management, upskilling, and adoption.
* Partner with external vendors and strategic technology providers to align deliverables, dependencies, performance expectations, and timelines. Track program outcomes and contribute to business value measurement led by AI & Digital Enablement, working with business owners to validate realized value and feed lessons learned into future intake and delivery planning.
* Contribute to and apply a standard delivery playbook with repeatable roadmaps, stage gates, and governance practices, capturing lessons learned to make subsequent AI programs faster and more predictable.
* Lead regular program syncs and track milestones delivered on commitment, program health, and escalation decision cycle time. Surface capacity constraints and cross-team trade-offs to the TPM Team Lead and Operations Manager for leadership decisions.

**Education & Experience - Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technical program management, technology delivery, or related roles leading complex, cross-functional technology initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading programs that span multiple business and technical teams, with accountability for roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, and delivery outcomes.
* Experience delivering programs involving AI, data, cloud, digital products, enterprise platforms, or related technologies. Deep engineering expertise across these disciplines is not required.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and product delivery practices, with the ability to apply the appropriate delivery approach based on program needs.
* Demonstrated ability to translate strategic business priorities and technical objectives into structured, executable programs and drive those programs through delivery.
* Experience operating in complex enterprise technology environments and coordinating across business, IT, engineering, product, architecture, cybersecurity, data, governance, and other technical functions.
* Proven ability to identify and manage complex dependencies, risks, resource constraints, competing priorities, and decisions across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Experience working with senior and executive stakeholders, including communicating program status, framing decisions, escalating risks, and presenting clear recommendations.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive alignment across teams with different priorities and areas of expertise.

**Education & Experience - Preferred**

* Experience leading enterprise AI/ML, generative AI, AI platform, or AI-enabled product programs.
* Experience coordinating delivery of AI capabilities from initial planning and prioritization through development, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing value realization.
* Familiarity with enterprise data and cloud platforms and the technical dependencies involved in delivering scalable digital and AI capabilities.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance considerations associated with enterprise AI delivery.
* Experience working with an AI/ML Center of Excellence, Digital Innovation organization, or similar enterprise technology function.
* Relevant certifications in technical program or project management, Agile delivery, cloud technologies, data, or AI.
* Experience managing external technology vendors or strategic partners as part of complex enterprise programs.
* Experience using Jira or comparable delivery-management tools to maintain reliable program data and support live reporting, and applying standardized delivery playbooks, stage gates, and readiness criteria across AI or digital programs.

Join our Talent Community to stay connected with us!

If you need a reasonable accommodation to search or apply for a position, please visit our Accessibility Page for Contact Information.

* Synthesize customer operational requirements into concrete inputs for new product development and engineering roadmaps.

**Sales Enablement & Process Governance**

* Design and deliver structured technical training modules for internal sales teams and external channel partners.

* Maintain and monitor operational Pre-Sales KPIs, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and weekly trackers.

* Optimize proposal turnaround time (TAT) while maintaining rigor in technical compliance.

**Cross-Functional Coordination & Revenue Accountability**

* Coordinate and guide cross-functional teams across Bid team, Business Development, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, and Customer Support.

* Sole authority to determine solution configurations and formally escalate product gaps.

* Basic techno-commercial costing, margin preservation, and sales training.

* **Experience:** 5+ years of techno-commercial experience in pre-sales, technical bid management, or solution engineering in pre-sales. Experience within defence, aerospace, unmanned systems is preferred.

LeadSquared is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the CRM space — trusted by 2,000+ customers and 2.5 lakh+ users globally. We help organizations automate sales and marketing to run high-velocity revenue operations at scale. With a strong presence across the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa, LeadSquared is expanding its US vertical teams to drive growth in Education and Healthcare — two of our strongest market segments.
  
  
**About The Role**
LeadSquared is expanding its US Education vertical and is looking for a senior PreSales Consultant with deep expertise in the Education sector to drive enterprise deal pursuits across Higher Education institutions, K-12 districts, EdTech platforms, and Workforce Training organizations. You will serve as the technical and solutions authority in the sales process — owning discovery, demo design, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept development — while acting as a trusted advisor to prospects and a strategic partner to the US Sales team.
  
  
***🎓 This is not a generic SE role. We need someone who speaks Education — who understands enrollment funnels, student lifecycle management, and how institutions buy technology.***
**Solution Engineering**
**Product Demonstrations**
**RFP/RFI Response**
**CRM**
**EdTech**
**Higher Education**
**POC Development**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Demonstrations**

* Lead tailored product demonstrations of LeadSquared’s CRM and Student Lifecycle Management platform for Higher Education, K-12, and EdTech prospects.
* Design and deliver discovery-led demos that address specific institutional pain points — enrollment management, student engagement, retention, and alumni relations.
* Develop and present end-to-end solution blueprints aligned to each prospect’s administrative, enrollment, and technology workflows.
* Build and deliver proof-of-concepts (POCs) for complex or competitive enterprise evaluations.
* Showcase integration capabilities with SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool), LMS tools, and other education ecosystem technologies.

**RFP Leadership & Proposal Excellence**

* Own RFI/RFP responses for US Education prospects, including functional requirements, solution architecture, and integration approach.
* Create compelling solution documents, executive summaries, and business case narratives tailored to CIO, VP Enrollment, and Provost-level audiences.
* Develop effort estimation, implementation roadmap, and TCO analysis for enterprise Education deployments.
* Maintain and improve a library of standard RFP responses, demo scripts, and proposal templates for the US Education team.

**Education Domain Authority**

* Serve as LeadSquared’s internal subject-matter expert on US Education: enrollment management, student success, financial aid workflows, and alumni engagement.
* Maintain competitive intelligence across EdTech CRM platforms (Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Ellucian CRM, Element451) and develop battle cards.
* Stay current on FERPA compliance, Title IV regulations, and accreditation-related technology requirements.
* Represent LeadSquared at US Education conferences, events, and industry forums to build brand presence and generate pipeline.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Engage VP Enrollment Management, CIOs, Registrars, Student Success Directors, and Provosts as a trusted advisor, not just a vendor.
* Partner with the US Sales team, Marketing, and Customer Success to build winning deal strategies and seamless customer handoffs.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on US Education market requirements and competitive gaps.
* Mentor and support junior PreSales resources as the Education vertical scales.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Experience & Education**

* 5-10 years of experience in PreSales, Solution Engineering, or Sales Consulting, with significant tenure supporting US Education accounts.
* Deep understanding of US Higher Education and/or K-12 institutional buying processes, IT governance, and technology procurement.
* Prior hands-on experience with EdTech CRM, SIS, or Student Lifecycle Management platforms is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or prior experience working inside a US educational institution is a strong plus.
* Excellent English communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with proven ability to engage C-suite and VP-level academic leaders.

**Technical & Domain Skills**

* Strong understanding of enrollment management, student lifecycle, financial aid, and alumni engagement workflows.
* Familiarity with US Education technology ecosystem: SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool, Infinite Campus), LMS (Canvas, Blackboard, D2L), and communication tools.
* Knowledge of FERPA, data privacy standards, and compliance requirements for US Education technology.
* Proficiency in solution architecture, integration design, and API-based connectivity for enterprise Education environments.
* Experience with competitive platforms: Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Element451, Ellucian CRM, or similar.

**Good to Have**

* Experience presenting at EDUCAUSE, NACAC, or similar US Education conferences.
* Familiarity with Title IV, accreditation body requirements, and financial aid system integrations.
* Experience with data analytics and reporting for student outcome tracking.
