The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is an AI-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market-leading company with double-digit growth and a blue-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
  
  
As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
  
  
In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.

**Company Description**

For more than a decade, 3SC has been helping some of the world’s most recognised brands run smarter, faster and more resilient supply chains. We are an established AI-powered supply chain SaaS company trusted by blue-chip enterprises across FMCG, electronics, pharma and healthcare, industrials, retail and e-commerce. These are organisations where supply chain performance is mission-critical, and they rely on 3SC to get it right, year after year. Our one-stop intelligence platform connects planning and execution on a single AI-native supply chain stack. From demand planning and replenishment to supply management, we help enterprises execute end-to-end supply chain decisions, replacing fragmented systems and guesswork with data-driven decisions at scale. What sets us apart is depth and solution reliability. Our teams of data scientists, engineers and supply chain consultants have built expertise that few can match. We turn complex, messy operational data into decisions that help expand the customer, cut costs, strengthen resilience and reduce emissions, delivering outcomes that are real-time and highly predictable with AI and measurable, evert single day. With delivery centres in India and the Netherlands, we serve clients across geographies with the reach of a global organisation and the agility of a focused specialist. Backed by GEF Capital ($2 Billion fund), we are firmly funded: our SaaS and AI business is expanding rapidly, and we are investing in the people who will take our proven platform to even more of the world’s leading enterprises.

**Role Description**

• Run discovery with planners, operations leaders and IT, arriving with a point of view on their business,

and decide early whether a pursuit is worth our effort, including saying no when it isn’t.

• Build and run tailored demos around the client’s own processes and, wherever possible, their own data.

• Lead proofs of concept with our data science and engineering teams against success criteria the client

agrees to upfront.

• Own the solution side of RFPs and proposals, working with Sales on pricing, and build business cases on

the client’s own numbers that can stand up to their finance team.

• Own the solution design, fit-gap and effort estimate, and flag early when a design would pull our product

off its roadmap.

• Map the integration landscape across ERP, WMS, TMS and planning systems, with a named client-side

owner for each piece.

• Write and get sign-off on the SoW and BRD so nothing promised in the sale gets lost, then hand over

cleanly to Delivery and stay available as their go-to. Large expansions and renewals that need a fresh

solution come back to you.

• Explain our agentic AI platform to CIOs and heads of planning in plain terms, and design solutions where

agents take on real planning and decision work, while being honest about what clients are ready for.

• Use AI tools daily for research, demo prep, RFP drafts and first-cut BRDs, and help your team work faster

with them too.

• Lead and grow a small team of Business Analysts, getting them in front of clients early, and build up our

demo kit and solution library.

• Bring field insights back to Product and Sales, including why we lost the deals we lost.

**Qualifications**

• 8 to 12 years of experience, with at least 6 in supply chain and logistics, most of it in pre-sales, solution

consulting or solution architecture for enterprise software.

• A solid grounding in supply chain planning (demand, supply, S&OP or IBP), and a working feel for

execution systems in warehousing and transport.

• You’ve run discovery, demos and proofs of concept for large enterprises, and won competitive deals.

• You’ve scoped enterprise integrations with ERP, WMS and TMS systems, and you know where they tend

to go wrong.

• You’ve written SoWs, BRDs and RFP responses that held up once delivery started.

• Real AI fluency. You use AI tools every day in your own work, and you understand agentic AI well enough

to explain how agents are trained, governed and monitored without bringing an engineer along.

• You’re comfortable in a room with VPs and CXOs, and you can bring a sceptical stakeholder around.

• Commercial sense. You can build an estimate and a business case that stand up to scrutiny.

• You’ve mentored or led analysts or consultants.

• Enough SQL and Power BI to put together a quick prototype on a client’s data, or sanity-check one.

f87c12e7.title: Solutions Engineer (Security, GSSO) - Mumbai, India
f87c12e7.description:
Meet the Team
  
  
You will be part of Cisco's Global Security Sales Organization (GSSO), a high-performing technical pre-sales team driving the success of Cisco's comprehensive Security Portfolio. The team works at the forefront of cybersecurity, helping customers secure their digital environments across networks, endpoints, applications, workloads, containers, and cloud infrastructures.
  
  
Our mission is to simplify and strengthen security by delivering integrated, intelligent, and outcome-driven solutions that help organizations protect their critical assets, identities, applications, and infrastructure against evolving cyber threats.
  
  
Working closely with account teams, partners, and customers, you will play a pivotal role in shaping security strategies, designing next-generation architectures, and positioning Cisco as a trusted cybersecurity partner.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Security Solutions Engineer within GSSO, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, helping them navigate complex cybersecurity challenges and adopt innovative security solutions across their enterprise environments.
  
  
You will bring deep technical expertise across network security, identity security, workload protection, secure access, and emerging AI security technologies. You will translate complex security requirements into practical, scalable architectures that strengthen customers' security posture across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
  
  
**You will:**  

* Partner with account teams to identify customer security challenges, develop technical strategies, and architect comprehensive security solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Lead technical discovery, solution design, architecture discussions, demonstrations, proof of concepts (POCs), and executive-level presentations to articulate the value of Cisco's Security Portfolio.
* Design and position security architectures covering microsegmentation, identity security, workload protection, container networking and security, and endpoint protection.
* Drive customer conversations around Secure Access technologies, including SSE and SASE, enabling secure connectivity and consistent security enforcement across users, devices, applications, and locations.
* Demonstrate expertise in emerging security domains, including AI Security, AI runtime protection, security guardrails, and protecting AI workloads and applications against evolving threats.
* Position advanced threat detection and protection capabilities, including Secure Network Analytics, Network Detection and Response (NDR), Network Behaviour Anomaly Detection (NBAD), and Email Security.
* Collaborate with Cisco product teams, specialists, partners, and broader technical sales organizations to develop differentiated solutions and drive strategic security opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in technical sales, pre-sales engineering, or a customer-facing cybersecurity architecture role, including at least 4 years of hands-on security specialization.
* Strong technical expertise across cybersecurity and network security domains, including microsegmentation, identity security, workload protection, container networking and security, endpoint security, and network security.
* Demonstrated experience with Secure Access technologies (SSE/SASE), Secure Network Analytics, NDR/NBAD, and Email Security, including the ability to architect and position solutions against complex enterprise security requirements.
* Understanding of AI Security principles, including securing AI workloads and applications, AI runtime security, threat detection, and the implementation of security guardrails to protect AI environments.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with Cisco Security technologies and the ability to articulate integrated security architectures across enterprise networks, endpoints, identities, applications, workloads, and cloud environments.
* Industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or relevant vendor certifications.
* Experience designing and presenting complex security architectures, conducting technical workshops, delivering POCs, and influencing technical and executive stakeholders.
* Understanding of modern cybersecurity frameworks, Zero Trust principles, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and evolving enterprise security challenges.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and influence customer security strategies.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on Enterprise, FSI, IT, ITES customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.
  
  
Sounds interesting? Read on!

* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc

* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship
* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities

**What You’ll Bring:**

* 8+ years of related industry experience
* 4+ years of experience in a similar customer-facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus
* Relevant certifications a plus
* Experience in secure cloud architectures
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets
* Experience with multi-cloud design
* Proficiency with AI Architectures and Security
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages will be an added advantage

**What You’ll Get:**

* Recognitions and Rewards
* Employee Assistance Program
* Competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and cool perks
* Culture of Giving Back

5ba71ebd.title: Principal Solutions Architect
5ba71ebd.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
We are seeking a Principal Solution Architect to provide architecture and hands-on technical leadership across Distribution Technology platforms and strategic initiatives.
  
  
The role is responsible for translating business and technology requirements into secure, scalable, resilient and maintainable solutions spanning Microsoft Azure, data platforms, API and integration architecture, cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, digital platforms and AI-enabled solutions.
  
  
This is not a conceptual architecture position. The architect is expected to be hand on and implement solutions, working across architecture, infrastructure, application development, data engineering, security, production support and business teams to take solutions from design through implementation and operational readiness.
  
  
Major Duties and Responsibilities
  
  
Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership
  
  

* Own end-to-end solution architecture & implementation for complex Distribution Technology initiatives, from discovery and option analysis through detailed design, implementation, deployment and production stabilization.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable application, integration, data and cloud architectures.
* Define architecture patterns and reusable solutions that can be adopted across multiple applications and technology teams.
* Implement complex use cases & provide hands-on technical guidance during implementation and troubleshoot complex cross-platform issues.
* Conduct design reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, resiliency and engineering standards.
* Work across application, data, infrastructure, security, network, DevOps and production-support teams to resolve technical dependencies.

Azure Cloud Architecture and Engineering
  
  

* Architect and implement cloud solutions using Microsoft Azure services.
* Lead application and platform modernization, including cloud migration and environment upgrades.
* Design solutions using Azure Functions, App Services, Databricks, databases, Azure Front Door, Application Gateway and API Management (APIM).
* Define cloud infrastructure, networking, ingress, DNS, API exposure and security integration patterns.
* Partner with infrastructure and cloud engineering teams on provisioning, configuration and operational readiness.
* Drive reusable cloud architecture patterns across Distribution applications.

API and Integration Architecture
  
  

* Design & implement secure API and service integration for internal and externally consumed capabilities.
* Define appropriate use of API gateways, ingress components, DNS, authentication, routing and security controls.
* Design integrations across application, data, SaaS and enterprise technology platforms.
* Support externally exposed APIs through appropriate edge, network and security architecture.
* Diagnose and resolve complex integration issues spanning multiple technology layers.

Data Platform and Data Integration
  
  

* Architect & implement data movement and integration across operational databases, enterprise data platforms and downstream applications.
* Design batch and pipeline-based data ingestion solutions and establish reliable end-to-end data flows.
* Work with Snowflake, Databricks, relational databases and ETL/data pipelines.
* Define data structures, views and interfaces consumed by applications and analytics platforms.
* Partner with enterprise data and application teams on entity, client and product data integrations.
* Support data lineage, data quality and troubleshooting across complex flows.

DevSecOps and Engineering Enablement
  
  

* Define and improve automated CI/CD patterns for cloud applications and services.
* Work with enterprise DevOps teams to automate build, deployment and environment workflows.
* Promote infrastructure automation, repeatable deployments and environment consistency.
* Establish engineering practices that improve deployment reliability and reduce manual operational effort.
* Provide architecture and technical guidance on source control, deployment pipelines, configuration and runtime environments.

Strategic Platforms and Emerging Technology
  
  

* Provide architecture leadership for strategic NTAM Distribution initiatives involving digital, data and AI capabilities.
* Collaborate with enterprise AI and platform teams on infrastructure and integration requirements for GenAI-enabled applications.
* Evaluate emerging technology through prototypes and proof-of-concepts while keeping architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
* Develop reusable architecture approaches for new capabilities rather than creating initiative-specific solutions wherever possible.

Production Reliability and Operational Support
  
  

* Provide senior technical support for complex production incidents and platform issues.
* Identify root causes and coordinate resolution across application, infrastructure, data and upstream/downstream teams.
* Design solutions for operability, monitoring, maintainability and supportability from the outset.
* Improve existing manual operational processes through automation.
* Ensure successful transition from project delivery into sustainable production support.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration
  
  

* Act as a senior technical partner to product owners, project managers, engineers, architects, security teams and business stakeholders.
* Mentor engineers and provide architecture and design guidance through complex implementation challenges.
* Lead technical discussions and help teams move from problem identification to pragmatic implementation.
* Document architecture patterns, decisions and implementation guidance for reuse across teams.
* Influence technology direction without requiring direct authority over all contributing teams.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 15+ years of overall technology experience, with significant experience in enterprise application, solution or cloud architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience architecting and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure.

65a90c12.title: Solutions Architect
65a90c12.description:
**Solutions Architect (SA)**

**Location:**
Bangalore
**Experience:**
8–12 Years

**Work Hours:**
EST Time Zone – 2PM to 10PM IST

**About Lucidity**

Lucidity helps enterprises save up to 40% of their cloud costs. Its AI Action Engine is a set of AI agents that deliver savings, not just recommend them. Most cloud cost tools stop at a dashboard. Our agents find waste that generic FinOps tools miss, work out which changes are safe for each workload, and make them in production with a human in the loop. Every change is monitored, verified and reversible.

We started with the hardest layer, live block storage. Our platform right-sizes disks as workloads grow and shrink, moves them to the right performance tier, and cleans up idle disks, all without downtime, across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. We are now extending the same approach to object storage and compute, so customers can cut up to 40% across their cloud bill.

Today Lucidity works with 100+ enterprises. We have identified more than $500M in savings and taken over 1.5M autonomous actions on production infrastructure.

Why join us

* Build AI agents that safely change live production infrastructure for large enterprises.
* Ranked among LinkedIn Top Startups India three years in a row Linkedin Top Startup 2026 , a Gartner Cool Vendor 2025 Link and a CRN Stellar Startup 2025 Link
* Series A company with $31M raised from WestBridge Capital, Alpha Wave Global and Beenext.
* Work closely with co-founders Vatsal & Nitin.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a
**Solutions Architect**
who can operate as the single technical owner for our most complex, high-value enterprise accounts - someone who needs minimal direction to take a customer from technical evaluation through large-scale production rollout. This is not a role for someone who executes a playbook; it's for someone who can build the playbook, defend it in front of a customer's CTO, and adapt it on the fly when the environment doesn't cooperate.

You'll be the senior-most technical voice in the room for enterprise accounts - trusted to make architectural calls independently, to push back on both customers and internal teams when the easy answer isn't the right one, and to represent Lucidity credibly to VP- and C-level technical stakeholders.

* Independently own end-to-end technical architecture and solution design for Lucidity's largest and most complex enterprise engagements, across multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) environments - with minimal oversight from leadership.
* Act as the primary technical decision-maker for your accounts: designing scalable, secure, production-grade deployments and de-risking rollouts for the world's largest enterprises without needing hand-holding.
* Lead technical discovery and solutioning conversations directly with senior customer stakeholders (VP Engineering, CTO, Head of Infrastructure), translating business and operational challenges into concrete technical architecture and a credible path to value.
* Serve as a trusted advisor - not just answering "how do I deploy this," but shaping how large enterprises think about cloud storage cost, resilience, and operational efficiency as part of their broader cloud strategy.
* Own customer relationships end-to-end for your book of accounts: driving time-to-value, managing technical risk, and being personally accountable for CSAT and renewal health.
* Anticipate and resolve escalations before they become critical - you're the person other team members loop in when a deployment gets hard, not the person who escalates upward.
* Mentor and technically guide junior Solutions Engineers/Consultants, review their architecture decisions, and help raise the technical bar of the broader post-sales team.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering, feeding back field insights from the most demanding customers to influence roadmap and product hardening.
* Represent Lucidity externally - presenting at events, running enterprise workshops, and contributing to whitepapers/blogs that establish technical thought leadership.
* Travel to customer sites as needed to close out critical technical milestones.

**Must Haves**

* **8–12 years**
  of professional experience architecting and operating solutions on cloud infrastructure, with a track record of owning complex technical engagements independently, start to finish.
* Deep, hands-on expertise across AWS and Azure (GCP a plus) - compute, storage, networking, security, IAM, and automation/IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated experience as a senior technical lead in a post-sales, professional services, or solutions consulting capacity for enterprise/Fortune 500 customers.
* Proven ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy - comfortable owning ambiguous, high-stakes technical problems without a playbook, and making the call.
* Strong executive presence - able to run a room with CTOs and VP Engineering stakeholders and hold the technical narrative under pressure.
* Working experience across Windows and Linux environments.
* Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers/architects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing technical documentation, whitepapers, or presenting at events.
* Strong account and project management skills - able to run multiple complex, concurrent enterprise engagements.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites/locations as necessary.
* Public cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
* Prior experience in the storage domain is a strong plus.

**What Do We Promise?**

* A high-growth work environment
* Autonomy to decide & deliver on KPIs
* Hybrid / work-from-home options | Flexible hours | Unlimited leaves

**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.

Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills

* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.

* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

c9b776c8.description:
15+ years overall technology experience

  

We are seeking a Principal Solution Architect to provide architecture and hands-on technical leadership across Distribution Technology platforms and strategic initiatives.

The role is responsible for translating business and technology requirements into secure, scalable, resilient and maintainable solutions spanning Microsoft Azure, data platforms, API and integration architecture, cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, digital platforms and AI-enabled solutions.

This is not a conceptual architecture position. The architect is expected to be hand on and implement solutions, working across architecture, infrastructure, application development, data engineering, security, production support and business teams to take solutions from design through implementation and operational readiness.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership

* Own end-to-end solution architecture & implementation for complex Distribution Technology initiatives, from discovery and option analysis through detailed design, implementation, deployment and production stabilization.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable application, integration, data and cloud architectures.
* Define architecture patterns and reusable solutions that can be adopted across multiple applications and technology teams.
* Implement complex use cases & provide hands-on technical guidance during implementation and troubleshoot complex cross-platform issues.
* Conduct design reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, resiliency and engineering standards.
* Work across application, data, infrastructure, security, network, DevOps and production-support teams to resolve technical dependencies.

Azure Cloud Architecture and Engineering

* Architect and implement cloud solutions using Microsoft Azure services.
* Lead application and platform modernization, including cloud migration and environment upgrades.
* Design solutions using Azure Functions, App Services, Databricks, databases, Azure Front Door, Application Gateway and API Management (APIM).
* Define cloud infrastructure, networking, ingress, DNS, API exposure and security integration patterns.
* Partner with infrastructure and cloud engineering teams on provisioning, configuration and operational readiness.
* Drive reusable cloud architecture patterns across Distribution applications.

API and Integration Architecture

* Design & implement secure API and service integration for internal and externally consumed capabilities.
* Define appropriate use of API gateways, ingress components, DNS, authentication, routing and security controls.
* Design integrations across application, data, SaaS and enterprise technology platforms.
* Support externally exposed APIs through appropriate edge, network and security architecture.

Hi All,

  

Looking for Enterprise Security Architecture for our client in Bangalore location. Interested candidate can share updated resume to **sudebi.basu@orcapod.work**

  

**Experience- 10+ years**

  

**Work Location- Bangalore**

**Role & responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Enterprise Security Architecture Ownership**

  

* Define and maintain the target-state security architecture, reference architectures, and reusable secure design patterns across on-premise, hybrid, and multi-cloud estates.
* Chair the security design review board; every significant platform, product, and integration passes through architecture review with documented control decisions.
* Set hardening and configuration baselines at the operating system level (Windows and Linux), and defend them against engineering pushback with technical argument, not policy citation.

**2. Application Security Architecture**

  

* Own secure-by-design standards across the SDLC: threat modelling, secure design review, cryptographic standards, secrets management, and AppSec tooling architecture (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning).
* Define API security architecture end to end: authentication and authorisation models (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, mTLS, service-to-service trust), gateway patterns, schema and payload validation, rate limiting, and abuse detection.

  

**3. Infrastructure Security Architecture**

  

* Architect network segmentation, zero-trust access, identity and privileged-access architecture, and endpoint security integration across data centres and cloud.
* Own workload security architecture in a multi-cloud environment: landing zones, container and Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code review, and cloud-native control selection (CSPM, DSPM, CNAPP alignment).

  

**4. The Integration Seam Explicit Mandate**

  

* Own security architecture for the layer where application and infrastructure regimes meet: API gateways and service meshes, middleware and message queues, data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines, file-transfer and B2B handoffs, and third-party integrations.
* For every material data flow, establish explicit control ownership at each hop ingestion, staging, transformation, serving, consumption so that no handoff is unowned and no control assumption is implicit.
* Design trust boundaries and data-in-motion protections across environment transitions (on-prem to cloud, cloud to cloud, enterprise to partner).

  

**5. Leadership and Advisory**

  

* Lead and grow a team of security architects; raise the architectural bar across engineering and platform teams through patterns, enablement, and review not gatekeeping.
* Serve as principal technical advisor to the CIO and CISO on architecture-driven risk decisions, vendor and platform architecture evaluations, and security investment trade-offs.
* Partner with SOC and detection engineering so that architecture decisions produce observable, defensible telemetry architecture that cannot be monitored is architecture that cannot be defended.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

**Certifications and Experience**

**Certifications Required**

* At least one current, technically-oriented security architecture or engineering certification: CISSP (ISSAP concentration strongly preferred), SABSA (SCF/SCP), CCSP, or GIAC GDSA/GCSA.
* Offensive or hands-on credentials (OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT) are a strong plus — they evidence the attacker-informed mindset this role demands.

6db8041a.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Technical Architect for the AWS Platform, you will design and architect AWS-based solutions that align with specific business requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. You will possess deep proficiency in AWS services, including EC2, S3, VPC, RDS, and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), along with expertise in Linux and VMware.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design and Implement AWS Solutions: Design and architect AWS-based solutions that meet business requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. This includes setting up and configuring AWS EC2 instances, storage solutions, networking, and databases to support various business applications.
* Deploy and Manage AWS Resources: Deploy and manage essential AWS resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Elastic Load Balancers (ELBs), and Application Load Balancers (ALBs) to ensure smooth operations. Continuously monitor AWS resources, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations.
* Ensure Security and Compliance: Implement and enforce security measures to ensure AWS resources comply with organizational policies and industry regulations. Optimize AWS costs by right-sizing resources, developing cost-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns.
* Collaborate with Development Teams: Work closely with development teams to ensure the successful deployment and integration of AWS-based solutions, utilizing DevOps practices such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Manage Kubernetes Clusters: Set up and manage Kubernetes clusters through Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), enabling container orchestration and scaling as part of the platform's capabilities.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Deep Proficiency in AWS Services: Experience with AWS services, including EC2, S3, VPC, RDS, and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), along with expertise in Linux and VMware.
* Cloud Architecture and Design: Experience with designing and architecting AWS-based solutions that meet business requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
* Cloud Migration and Deployment: Experience with cloud migration projects, including assessment, design, and execution, utilizing DevOps practices such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Cloud Security and Compliance: Experience with implementing and enforcing security measures to ensure AWS resources comply with organizational policies and industry regulations.
* Container Orchestration: Experience with setting up and managing Kubernetes clusters through Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), enabling container orchestration and scaling as part of the platform's capabilities.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Automation Tools Expertise: Experience with automation tools like AWS CloudFormation or Terraform is beneficial for streamlining AWS resource deployment and management. Knowledge of these tools enables efficient infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
* Cloud Cost Optimization: Familiarity with optimizing AWS costs by right-sizing resources, developing cost-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns is advantageous. This skill helps in reducing operational expenses while maintaining high-performance levels.
* CI/CD Pipeline Management: Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices is valuable for ensuring seamless deployment and integration of AWS-based solutions. This expertise facilitates collaboration with development teams and enhances overall efficiency.

**We’re Hiring | Senior QE Architect – AI/GenAI | GraphRAG | Agentic AI | Data Privacy**

We are looking for a **senior, hands-on QE Architect** who can drive enterprise Quality Engineering transformation while bringing strong expertise in **AI/GenAI, RAG/GraphRAG, Agentic AI and PIPL/Data Privacy**.

This is a highly technical, hands-on architecture role for someone who can take complex solutions from **strategy and architecture through PoC, coding and implementation**.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and drive end-to-end QE architecture, enterprise automation frameworks and engineering standards across UI, APIs, microservices, data and cloud-native applications.
* Architect AI-enabled Quality Engineering solutions, leveraging GenAI, RAG/GraphRAG, LLMs and Agentic AI to improve engineering productivity and quality.
* Design and implement RAG/GraphRAG architectures, including data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, retrieval and multi-agent orchestration using technologies such as Python and LangGraph.
* Drive PIPL and privacy-by-design within QE, covering test-data protection, masking/anonymization, sensitive-data handling, consent, retention and regulatory controls.
* Establish CI/CD, DevSecOps, continuous testing and shift-left quality engineering, with automated quality gates and strong observability.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership through solutioning, coding, PoCs, framework development and troubleshooting of complex QE and AI engineering problems.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security and Privacy teams to take solutions end-to-end from architecture to production implementation.

Required Experience & Skills

* 15+ years of overall experience across Quality Engineering, Test Architecture, Automation Architecture and Software Engineering.
* Proven experience as a QE/Test/Automation Architect delivering enterprise-scale solutions.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of GenAI, RAG, GraphRAG, LLMs, vector databases, knowledge graphs and Agentic AI/multi-agent architectures.
* Strong programming capability, preferably Python, with experience building frameworks, prototypes and production-grade solutions.
* Strong understanding of PIPL, data privacy, privacy-by-design and test-data protection.
* Deep experience across UI, API, integration, data, performance and end-to-end automation.
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, cloud, databases and distributed architectures.
* Experience integrating QE into CI/CD, DevOps/DevSecOps and continuous-testing pipelines.
* Ability to engage senior stakeholders while remaining a hands-on architect who can design, code, troubleshoot and implement.

Core Technology Exposure

**QE & Automation:** Selenium, Playwright/Cypress, API automation, performance engineering, test-data management

**AI Engineering:** Python, LLMs, RAG, GraphRAG, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, LangGraph, Agentic AI

**Privacy:** PIPL, privacy-by-design, masking, anonymization, pseudonymization, encryption and access controls

**Engineering:** APIs, microservices, cloud-native architectures, CI/CD, DevSecOps, containers/Kubernetes and observability

A **15+ year hands-on QE Architect** who brings the rare combination of:

**Enterprise QE Architecture + AI/GenAI & GraphRAG + PIPL/Data Privacy + Hands-on Engineering**

**Important:** The expectation is not a governance-only architect. The person should be able to **architect, code, build PoCs, solve complex problems and drive implementation end-to-end.**

99611c84.description:
Visa Commercial Solutions (VCS) focuses on providing B2B solutions to large and mid-market corporates and small businesses. The team has overall responsibility for all aspects of business strategy, development and management of B2B solutions, as well as platform development.

  

The Director , Commercial Solutions, will be responsible for growing the existing B2B portfolio, developing and bringing new solutions to the market, leading initiatives that enhance and/or expand distribution of existing Visa capabilities and executing on the overall business strategy. The role is a core part of the VCS team and will include identifying new opportunities, solutioning and implementing new business models and assisting the functional leads developing partnership opportunities with players that may be highly complex, strategic and cross-functional. In addition to the VCS team, the role will work closely with the client leads, regional and global product teams and stakeholders across the organization. The resource will be responsible for the appended activities.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Lead specific work effort pieces in designing and delivering business cases for new payment / technology especially in account receivables, which requires engaging with key Issuers and Fintech partners.
  
* Work with Key Fintech Partners to expand distribution, enhance the value proposition and develop alternative business models.
  
* Support the team in driving a key set of strategic initiatives including managing marketing engagements and lounge initiatives to provide differentiated B2B solutions to the market.
  
* Work alongside the Hub product team on product initiatives like launch of Signature variant for Corporate Card, Issuer trainings for Visa Spend Clarity and Market launch of Virtual card program (Visa Payables Automation).
  
* Leverage appropriate Visa assets and product management resources to deliver exceptional business/issuer/acquirer value.
  
* Work across key Issuers to launch, manage and ramp up their Large Market programs.
  
* Facilitating the successful deployment of Visas digital payment solutions and B2B platform partnership programs to gain market share and accelerate volume growth and program growth.

* Proven depth of experience in driving client growth and winning new business. Experience selling ideas and solutions to senior management based on client priorities and needs. Proven ability to manage a pipeline, structure a deal, negotiate business agreements and drive commercial results.
  
* Demonstrated experience building and leveraging strong relationships at multiple levels, leading cross-functional teams to promote a shared vision and deliver as a single team.
  
* Ability to influence and collaborate at all levels; ability to articulate strategic concepts through exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

580d857e.title: Engagement Manager
580d857e.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**Brief about Fractal:**

Fractal is one of the most prominent players in the Artificial Intelligence space. Our mission is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and we bring AI, engineering and design to help the world's most admired Fortune 500® companies. Fractal has consistently been rated one of India's best companies to work for by The Great Place to Work® Institute.

  

Cloud, data and AI are driving digital transformation across every enterprise at an unprecedented pace. We help enterprises harness the power of data on the cloud through architecture consulting, data platforms, business-tech platforms, marketplaces, data governance, MDM, DataOps and AI/MLOps, and we apply AI engineering practices to strengthen each of these areas.

  

**About the Role**

The Engagement Manager is accountable for Fractal's analytics and AI delivery on a Healthcare account, and owns outcomes from the first problem statement to the eventual retirement of each solution. The role combines client leadership, delivery management and technical judgement: you will be the primary contact for offshore delivery teams across multiple locations, the partner to the onshore farming team, a trusted advisor to Senior Directors and VPs of Client, and the person who makes sure every solution is built to last, run and, when the time comes, be replaced. The role also carries an implied farming mandate: growing Fractal's business within the managed portfolio, in conjunction with the onsite ideation team.

  

Success is measured by client NPS, the innovative solutions created, impact on the KPIs most critical to Client and revenue growth from the account, as well as by how well the value of each solution holds up after go-live. Expect also to be judged on measurable business outcomes such as forecast accuracy, service levels and cycle time, and on execution consistency, stakeholder confidence and year-on-year gains in delivery productivity.

  

**Experience:** 10+ years.

**Location:** Bengaluru preferred; Chennai and Pune and Mumbai also considered, in that order.

**Team:** 50+ professionals across multiple locations.

**Reports to**: Principal Consultant.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Lead the Consulting delivery**

* Lead and manage high-impact consulting projects for Clients in the health systems space, from problem framing through to measurable business outcomes.
* Lead delivery across a broad range of analytics and AI use cases that span the end-to-end enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement.
* Act as the primary contact for the offshore delivery teams, distributed across multiple locations: align with the client on the delivery plan, give regular status updates and keep the client, the onshore ideation team and the offshore teams working as one. Run an operating model that works across locations and time zones.
* Partner closely with the onshore farming on converting new pursuits and road mapping existing engagements.
* Oversee project extensions, ensuring accurate and comprehensive estimates for the work outlined.
* Own engagement P&L, commercial performance and Statements of Work, keeping delivery financially sustainable. Contribute to account-level business planning (including client annual operating plans), forecasting, budgeting and measurement of results.
* Assess delivery capabilities to anticipate and mitigate risks, and give the client and Fractal leadership clear insight for effective risk management.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of 50+ professionals, including analytics consultants, BI developers, data engineers, data scientists, full-stack developers and GenAI engineers across multiple work streams, standardizing delivery practices and execution quality.
* Establish governance mechanisms, delivery standards and success metrics, and champion Agile and DevOps practices, to improve predictability and stakeholder confidence and to drive year-on-year productivity gains.
* Work with capability teams to keep offshore staffing at the right level across locations and resolve staffing issues that affect client deliverables.
* Provide thought leadership and mentorship to the team, promoting a culture of learning and innovation. Build reusable methods, solution templates and consultative storytelling skills across the team.
* Build forward-looking plans for staffing and upskilling in line with market and client demand, and partner with internal stakeholders to put those plans into action.

  

**Shape and deliver Data & AI Solutions, across their full lifecycle**

* **Ideate:** Work with Client stakeholders within the managed portfolio to identify and prioritize the business problems most worth solving with analytics and AI. Develop strategic frameworks that tie each one to business growth or operational efficiency. Take part in the sales process to scope client needs and frame the solution and delivery approach. Run proofs of concept and proofs of value to establish worth before scaling.
* **Design:** Work with cross-functional teams to design end-to-end solutions that anticipate future needs, scale, and meet health-data privacy, security and regulatory requirements. Translate business requirements into technical designs that engineering, data science, BI, full-stack and GenAI teams can build from. Settle KPIs and success measures, ownership, adoption, data and model lifecycle, and run cost before build starts.
* **Build:** Create and execute analytics-driven solutions. Apply technical fluency across BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI to manage execution and keep technical decisions aligned with the design. Lead by example in analytics delivery, guiding the team from data synthesis and modeling to actionable insights, implications and recommendations.
* **Operate:** Own the handover into operations: monitoring, model and data refresh, support model, and tracking of the value delivered, so solutions keep performing after launch. Validate impact through test-and-control or incrementality measurement, and transition solutions to client teams for sustained use.
* **Sunset:** Define up front when and how a solution will be retired or replaced, and manage the transition, including decommissioning, data retention and handover to successor solutions.

  

**Client relationships establishment, sustenance and strengthening**

* Manage client relationships to ensure satisfaction and build long-term partnerships.
* Advise Senior Directors and VPs across business and technology functions, and occasionally C-suite leaders, with data-driven business relevant insights.
* Act as a trusted advisor inside the client organization and grow Fractal's footprint within the managed portfolio by engaging stakeholders, identifying likely business problems, building points of view (POVs) and converting them into actionable roadmaps for execution. Shape each proposition end to end, from solution architecture and commercial development to delivery roadmap and go to-market.
* Engage with client to institutionalize analytics across the organization, so that solutions are adopted and reused beyond their first use case. Convert proven value into broader, multi-year mandates within the managed portfolio. **Technical Skills**
* Expertise in building, delivering and operationalizing analytics solutions end to end, from problem definition to production.
* Working knowledge of the full scope of work (BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack development and GenAI applications), including cloud data platforms and pipelines, modeling and machine learning, DataOps and MLOps, enough to challenge estimates, spot technical risk and keep delivery aligned with the design.
* Familiarity with the client's native Microsoft technology stack, including Power BI, Azure and related components, enough to guide solution design, technical conversations and delivery on it.
* Fluency in GenAI: how GenAI applications are designed, built, evaluated, governed and run, and where they do and do not fit a business problem.
* Ability to hold credible conversations with technical stakeholders and to translate business requirements into technical language and solution designs that BI, engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI teams can act on.
* Understanding of how analytics solutions are run and retired: monitoring, model and data drift, cost of ownership, support and decommissioning.
* Knowledge of a variety of advanced analytics and machine learning techniques (for example segmentation and forecasting), and the ability to evaluate and bring in new techniques that add value for clients.

• Ability to design and review new solution concepts, with a record of leading the delivery of high-impact analytics solutions and programs for global clients. • Functional familiarity across one or more of the areas our use cases span: the enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement, with the ability to apply domain and analytics knowledge to them. • Experience designing KPI frameworks and executive dashboards that make performance measurable and decisions data-driven.

* Familiarity with Agile and DevOps delivery practices and how to apply them to analytics and BI programs.

  

**Non-Technical Skills**

* Exceptional consulting skills with a proven track record of delivering high-value solutions. Ability to Engages stakeholders, spots likely business problems, builds compelling POVs for execution roadmaps that grow Fractal's business.
* Executive presence, with a track record of engaging at Senior Director and VP level, the ability to influence and engage senior client and internal stakeholders, and the ability to drive senior groups to conclusions.
* Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking: structures ambiguous business problems clearly, innovates where required and looks beyond the build to long term value and cost of ownership.
* 10+ years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in leadership roles, leading teams distributed across multiple locations.
* Excellent project and program management skills, with experience managing multiple work streams and projects at the same time.
* Business acumen to manage revenue profitably and meet financial goals consistently, with the ability to quantify business value for clients and create win-win commercial propositions.

  

**Education Qualification and Certifications Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field.
* Advanced degrees (MBA, MS) or relevant certifications are preferred. Examples include Microsoft Azure and Power BI certifications, other cloud platform and machine learning project certifications, Lean Six Sigma, and Agile or program management credentials.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking *Introduce Yourself* in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

a1957ed7.title: Technical Account Manager
a1957ed7.description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role serves as the customer's trusted technical advisor, ensuring the stability, performance, security, and continuous improvement of IT services. The role bridges customer business requirements and technical delivery teams, providing proactive technical governance, risk management, service optimization, and technology roadmap alignment across the customer environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Account Ownership
* Act as the primary technical interface between the customer and internal technical teams.
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the customer's IT infrastructure, architecture, service dependencies, and business priorities.
* Maintain technical account documentation, service inventories, architecture diagrams, and configuration baselines.
* Ensure technical solutions and services remain aligned with customer requirements and contractual commitments.
* Service Performance and Technical Governance
* Monitor service health, availability, capacity, performance, and SLA/KPI compliance.
* Lead technical service reviews and provide insights into service trends, recurring incidents, and improvement opportunities.
* Review incident, problem, and change management activities from a technical perspective.
* Coordinate technical escalations, major incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and corrective action plans.
* Identify operational risks, technology obsolescence, vulnerabilities, and end-of-life/end-of-support exposure.
* Proactive Problem Management
* Drive proactive identification and resolution of technical risks before they affect business services.
* Analyze incident trends, monitoring alerts, performance data, and recurring faults.
* Coordinate with L2/L3 engineering and OEM/vendor support teams to resolve complex issues.
* Drive permanent fixes, known-error reduction, and preventive maintenance.
* Review and validate technical recovery plans and service resilience measures.
* Technology Roadmap and Service Improvement
* Develop and maintain a technical roadmap aligned with customer strategy and technology lifecycle requirements.
* Identify opportunities for automation, AI-enabled operations, auto-remediation, and proactive monitoring.
* Recommend architecture optimization, performance enhancements, capacity upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives.
* Support service transformation, migration, modernization, and technical debt reduction.
* Track improvement initiatives and demonstrate measurable business and operational benefits.
* Architecture and Technical Solution Support
* Collaborate with solution architects, engineering, presales, and delivery teams on technical designs and solution proposals.
* Review high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, and technical change proposals where appropriate.
* Ensure adherence to architectural standards, security policies, and technical best practices.
* Support RFPs, solution assessments, technology evaluations, and technical due diligence.
* Validate technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, and implementation readiness for new services.
* Change, Transition and Vendor Management
* Provide technical oversight for major changes, upgrades, migrations, and service transitions.
* Review change risks, impact assessments, rollback plans, and implementation outcomes.
* Coordinate with OEMs, carriers, technology partners, and internal engineering teams.
* Ensure technical knowledge transfer, operational readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Track vendor performance and drive resolution of technical dependencies.
* Customer Communication and Reporting
* Present technical service performance, risks, incidents, and improvement plans to customer stakeholders.
* Translate complex technical issues into clear business impact and mitigation options.
* Maintain technical risk registers, action trackers, service improvement plans, and technology roadmaps.
* Provide recommendations supported by service data, trends, and measurable outcomes.

**About You**
**Technical Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and managed services.
* Working knowledge of networking, routing, switching, WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, and connectivity services.
* Knowledge of UCC technologies, including Cisco, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and enterprise voice/video solutions.
* Understanding of cloud, data center, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure services.
* Familiarity with monitoring and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, SolarWinds, and other enterprise monitoring tools.
* Understanding of ITIL incident, problem, change, configuration, and availability management.
* Ability to analyze technical data, identify trends, and drive root-cause elimination.
* Strong stakeholder management, presentation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Design & Collaboration: Figma, Microsoft Visio, Microsoft Whiteboard, Mural
* UX & Service Design Techniques: Journey Mapping, Service Blueprinting, Storyboarding, Lean Six Sigma
* Platforms: ServiceNow, Microsoft Azure, DevOps, ITIL, AI/Generative AI, Data Analytics
* Project & Workflow Management: Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, MS Planner
* Reporting & Data Visualization: Power BI

You bring open mindedness, ability to handle pressure, leading with courage and empathy, assertiveness and communicate effectively.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

42c9418e.title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager
42c9418e.description:
You Will Own Delivery, Client Relationships, and Technical Estimates

MTechZilla is a custom software development company. We build web, mobile, cloud, and AI products for startups and businesses, primarily in the US and Europe. Our team of 30+ has delivered 40+ products.

You will own the technical estimate behind every quotation we send, and the delivery of the projects that come out of those quotations. You will also be the person clients come to with their questions, from the first discovery call through the final release.

You need to be a former engineer who can design and estimate a solution, and organized enough to run several client projects at once without anything slipping.

What You Will Be Responsible For:

Delivering every project on time, on budget, and at margin

* Own end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent client projects, from kickoff to release and handover.
* Set priorities for your project teams. Changes to who works on your projects go through you.
* Keep plans, milestones, budgets, and timelines current as priorities shift.
* Track risks, blockers, and dependencies every week, and act on them before they reach the client.
* Compare time spent against the estimate every week, and raise overruns early.
* Manage scope and turn change requests into approved, billable change orders.
* Coordinate with QA on test plans and release checklists so every release is ready before a client sees it.
* Escalate in writing, before the deadline, when something outside your control puts a milestone at risk.

Manage client relationships

* Act as the main delivery contact for clients across time zones.
* Answer your clients’ questions, technical and non-technical: architecture, feasibility, timelines, costs, scope, and how we work.
* When you do not have the answer, find it and reply within one working day.
* Run status reviews and sprint demos, and tell clients about risks before dates are missed.
* Present delivery status, risks, and roadmaps to client founders and executives.
* Understand each client’s business and propose technical solutions to their problems.
* Spot follow-on work in existing projects, propose it to the client, and bring it to the growth team to close.

Turning client briefs into requirements developers can build from

* Run discovery and requirements sessions with clients.
* Write PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
* Prioritize features and maintain roadmaps based on business value, effort, and risk.

Design solutions and own estimates for new leads

Every quotation we send depends on this part of the role.

* Join discovery and pre-sales calls as the technical lead.
* Answer a lead’s technical questions on calls and in writing, so the growth team does not have to wait for a developer.
* Design the solution: architecture, tech stack, integrations, and hosting approach.
* Break requirements into features and tasks, and estimate effort and timelines.
* Complete the technical sections of our quotation template: scope, assumptions, exclusions, team composition, milestones, and timeline.
* Know what each role on a project costs in the market, so the team you propose in a quotation is priced correctly. Margins are already set; you make sure the inputs are right.
* Estimate AWS and third-party costs where relevant.
* Split a product into phases that fit the client’s budget.
* Review SOWs for technical and delivery feasibility before they are signed.

Build delivery processes and documentation that scale

* Run projects in Jira and keep documentation in Confluence: requirements, architecture decisions, release notes, and handover notes.
* Set the documentation standard that every project follows.
* Build a reusable estimation model from past projects, so quotes get faster and more accurate.
* Define and improve our processes for sprints, QA gates, releases, and client reporting.
* Send a one-page weekly report to leadership for each project: status, budget, top risk, and decisions needed.

Leading and growing the engineering team

* Lead the developers, team leads, and contractors on your projects, and keep them aligned on priorities.
* Run stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, and follow through on action items.
* Review architecture and code on critical projects.
* Collaborate with business, marketing, sales, QA, HR, and client teams.
* Take part in hiring, interviews, and decisions on team structure.

Technical Skills You Need

You do not need to write production code every day. You do need to design a system, judge whether a developer’s estimate is realistic, and hold your own with a client’s CTO.

* At least 4 years as a hands-on software engineer before moving into lead or delivery roles.
* Working knowledge of our stack, deep enough to design and review solutions: React and Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and AWS.
* System design: APIs, databases, authentication, scaling, and third-party integrations such as payments, maps, and notifications.
* Working knowledge of security and data protection basics, including GDPR for European clients.
* Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab workflows, CI/CD, and architecture diagrams.

Experience and Qualifications:

Required

* 5 to 6 years of total experience, including at least 4 years as a hands-on software engineer.
* A track record of estimating software projects, with examples of estimates compared to actual delivery.
* Experience leading delivery, projects, or an engineering team.
* Experience running more than one software project at the same time.
* Experience working directly with US or European clients.
* A track record of owning end-to-end delivery and independently driving process improvements.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum, release planning, and QA coordination.
* Daily, hands-on use of Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of market salaries and rates for engineering roles in India.
* Clear written English for estimates, PRDs, and status reports.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

* Experience in a software services company, agency, or consulting firm, especially on fixed-price projects.
* Experience building or integrating AI and LLM features.
* Exposure to IoT or connected products in e-mobility, energy, industrial equipment, or logistics.
* Ability to create wireframes, workflow diagrams, and POC briefs.
* Experience with Claude and other AI tools.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Sophos, and other IT tools for setting up the right security configurations.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 6 Months

* You produce quotations and estimates for new leads without the CEO filling in technical or timeline details.
* The technical section of a quotation goes out within three working days of the discovery call.
* Your projects ship within 10% of their estimated timeline and budget.
* Every client gets a weekly status update, and escalations to the CEO are the exception.
* Every active project has documentation in Confluence that another team member could pick up and work from.
* We have an estimation model built from at least 10 past projects.

Pay: From ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Your Role
  
  
Lead end-to-end delivery of customer engagements from scoping through execution and renewal. Serve as the primary contact for client stakeholders while managing cross-functional teams to ensure on-time, in-scope delivery aligned to business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Client & Delivery Management**

* Primary point of contact for assigned engagements across business and technical stakeholders
* Lead project governance including steering committees, status reviews, and executive readouts
* Translate client objectives into clear engagement plans with measurable success criteria
* Manage client expectations, scope boundaries, and change requests; escalate and resolve conflicts

* Coordinate cross-functional teams (Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Product, Support)

* Ensure quality project artifacts: charters, SOWs, status decks, runbooks, handover documentation

**Commercial & Value Delivery**

* Own services SOW: scope, assumptions, deliverables, acceptance criteria
* Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities with Sales and Customer Success
* Define and track value metrics: adoption, performance, time-to-value, business impact
* Drive user adoption and change management with client sponsors

**Risk & Quality Management**

* Maintain consolidated view of project health: schedule, scope, budget, risks, satisfaction
* Anticipate and mitigate delivery risks; manage dependencies across teams
* Enforce best-practice methodologies (agile/hybrid delivery, SDLC, data & AI standards)

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* 7+ years in consulting, professional services, or project management with enterprise customers
* Proven track record leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations (SaaS, data/analytics, AI/ML, MarTech/CDP)

* Expertise in project management: planning, estimation, risk management, governance
* Experience owning SOWs, budgets, and profitability for services engagements

* Structured problem-solving; comfortable with ambiguity
