3699e857.title: Client Facing Solution Architect
3699e857.description:
**About Us**
Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.
  
  
As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.
  
  
Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Solution Architecture team is looking to bring on an experienced Solution Architect to support both ongoing and new implementations. We see significant growth in our future and would love for you to be a part of it! You will partner with customers and numerous internal teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that provide solutions to solve customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of Abacus’ offerings. As a Solutions Architect, you will demonstrate best practices around advanced cloud solutions and healthcare payer systems including claims processing (i.e., Medical, Vision, Prescription claims), clinical informatics (e.g., Lab Results), provider systems such as EHR, and CMS Interoperability mandate solutions. As a trusted customer advocate, you will have the opportunity to guide a client’s successful adoption of Abacus’ core data management offerings.
  
  
**Your day to day**

* Author the project architecture design documents, including data flows, sequence diagrams and overall system architecture, that will drive the technical implementation of the solutions. This role will primarily focus on defining solutions associated with CMS Interoperability, but may also work on other data solutions.
* Work across business and IT teams to understand the current business and system capabilities and determine the desired state to define the overall technology strategy roadmap
* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business experts, technical business analysts, project managers, sales / account executives and data engineers to successfully implement client projects which reduce technology costs and solution redundancy.
* Collaborate with Product Management to identify client-specific requirements that may translate into an existing standard product feature or a future feature on the Abacus product roadmap.
* Define the solution architecture visions for designated components that describe the long-term goals as well as near-term needs of the client.
* Provide mentorship to internal teams on business needs and use cases for seamless client implementation. Provide ongoing support to address questions and issues raised by the implementation team.

**What You Bring To The Team**

* Understanding and passion for healthcare data and systems – including payer, provider, and integration partners. Strong working knowledge of US healthcare data, including but not limited to Medical Claims, Pharmacy Claims, Membership / Enrollment, Provider and Clinical.
* Domain expertise in CMS Interoperability Mandate (9115 / 0057) - including the technology used to serve the mandated APIs as well as the data structures (FHIR) required to be compliant.
* Ability to define the solution architecture vision in architecture design documents
* Broad and general technical knowledge as well as competencies in infrastructure, data models, databases, service orientation, programming, frameworks, standards, and technical modeling. Strong experience with one or more cloud vendors (AWS / Azure / GCP) and data platforms (Databricks / Snowflake) desired.
* Strong understanding of healthcare industry trends, regulations, and customer needs with preference for previous payer / Interoperability vendor experience
* Experience translating business needs into technology solutions that enable delivery of the Abacus platform.
* Strong communicator who can leverage their domain and technical expertise effectively with the client and build working relationships with internal and external team members. Ability to communicate succinctly and clearly, both verbally and written, across technical and non-technical audiences at multiple levels, including business leaders.
* Experience working in the payer / healthcare data space and understanding of the historical data architecture needs of our clients.
* Understanding of client services or experience working for a cloud-based data management provider to large clients.

**What We Would Like To See, But Not Required**

* Working knowledge of Provider (EHR) Data formats and topics – including FHIR, X-12, HL-7 V2.3, and CCDA/CDA - as well as the general system architecture required to consume and make use of this data.
* Working knowledge of Utilization Management / Care Management / Disease Management.

**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive Leave & Benefits
* Comprehensive health coverage
* Equity for every employee – share in our success
* Growth-focused environment – your development matters here

**Work arrangements**

* Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week (5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST)
* Location: Remote
* Shift: Your standard working hours will be nine (9) hours per day within the Company’s standard working hours. Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.

**Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer**
As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.
  
  
**AI Use in Recruitment**
We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks.
**We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.**
**Identity and Location Verification**
To protect the integrity of our hiring process, all interviews are conducted by live video with your camera on. Virtual or blurred backgrounds and headsets are not permitted absent an approved accommodation, and you should be in a well-lit, private space where your face and surroundings are clearly visible. Candidates who advance may also be asked to complete identity and location verification, which may include verifying your identity, work history, and confirming that you are located where your application states. Applications containing knowingly false or materially misrepresented information, including identity, location, or credentials, may be disqualified, and any offer may be rescinded if a material misrepresentation is discovered at any point in the process.
  
  
If you need an accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know in advance.
  
  
By applying, you acknowledge that we will collect and process your personal information for recruiting purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including for the verification steps described above. Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice for more information, including your rights.

***Olympus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

"We are deeply committed to fostering a respectful, fair, and welcoming workplace for all individuals, perspectives, and lifestyles. We believe in fostering a nondiscriminatory, inclusive work environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging, in full compliance with legal standards. 82fc632a.title: Azure Data Architect
82fc632a.description:
**Job Description**  
**Role - Azure Data Architect**  
**Role -** Azure Data Architect

**Skills Mandatory -** Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Enterprise Data Architecture, Data Modelling, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure SQL, Tableau, Stakeholder Management

**Skills Primary -** Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Data Modelling, Enterprise Data Architecture, Azure Data Platform

**Skills Good to Have -** Databricks, Snowflake, Purview, Data Governance Frameworks, Tableau Migration Experience

**Qualification -** Bachelor's Degree

**Total Experience -** 12+ years (Azure Data Architect)**Relevant Experience -** 5+ years as Data Architect / Enterprise Data Architect

**Work Location -** Kochi /TVM OR Remote

**Expected Date of Onboarding-** 30 November 2026

**Number of Positions -**1

Job Purpose (both Onsite / Offshore)  
The role reviews the current Azure Synapse-based Customer Data Platform, enterprise data architecture, data modelling practices and reporting ecosystem. It also assesses the ongoing Tableau-to-Power BI migration and advises on Microsoft Fabric as a future-state analytics platform.  
The architect acts as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, leads architecture discussions and conducts technical assessments. The role delivers executive-level recommendations to improve platform effectiveness, reporting consistency and future technology direction.  
Job Description / Duties and Responsibilities  
- Lead architecture and platform assessments across Azure Synapse, Power BI, Tableau and Microsoft Fabric environments.  
- Assess the current Azure Synapse-based Customer Data Platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, semantic and reporting layers.

- Review enterprise data architecture, data domains and the implementation of medallion architecture patterns.  
- Evaluate data models, business rules, semantic models and reporting structures for consistency, reuse, scalability and maintainability.  
- Identify architectural bottlenecks, duplicated logic, technical debt and optimisation opportunities.  
- Assess Tableau and Power BI reporting environments, including migration progress, dependencies, risks and rationalisation opportunities.  
- Evaluate Microsoft Fabric capabilities against Azure Synapse and recommend the future platform direction.  
- Run architecture workshops, stakeholder interviews and discovery sessions with business and technical teams.  
- Present architecture findings, recommendations and roadmaps to client stakeholders and leadership.  
- Prepare architecture assessment reports, findings registers, migration assessments and executive presentations.  
- Recommend improvements in data architecture, governance, reporting architecture and platform modernisation.  
- Provide architecture guidance on security, scalability, governance, data quality and operational excellence.  
- Act as the primary architecture lead for the engagement and a trusted advisor on strategic data platform decisions.  
Skills and Competencies  
- Strong experience in Azure Synapse Analytics architecture and implementation.  
- Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Fabric Data Warehouse, Data Factory / Pipelines and Power BI integration.  
- Strong Power BI architecture skills: semantic modelling, DAX, governance and reporting best practices.  
- Experience evaluating and modernising enterprise analytics platforms.  
- Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, dimensional modelling, medallion architecture and analytics and reporting architecture.  
- Experience with Azure data platform services: ADLS, Azure SQL, ADF and Azure Synapse Analytics.  
- Understanding of data governance, metadata management, lineage and data quality practices.  
- Experience assessing and guiding reporting migrations from Tableau to Power BI.  
- Strong SQL and data analysis skills.  
- Experience preparing architecture assessments, recommendations and modernisation roadmaps.  
- Excellent communication and consulting skills, with the ability to engage senior business and technology stakeholders.  
- Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills.  
- Ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.  
- Self-driven and comfortable working independently in a client-facing offshore delivery model.  
- Ability to influence architecture decisions through evidence-based recommendations.  
Good to Have  
- Databricks, Snowflake, Purview, data governance frameworks and Tableau migration experience.  
- Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Azure Data Engineer Associate, TOGAF.

b3f2c00c.title: Cloud Architect
b3f2c00c.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

Set and apply standards for deploying and running infrastructure and applications across our hybrid environment (GCP, AWS).

* Build reusable Terraform modules and self-service pipelines, including migrating existing resources into Terraform Cloud.
* Extend Kubernetes to new use cases across our platforms as part of the cloud-first transformation.
* Own the automated lifecycle of enterprise standard compute and container images and drive workloads onto approved images.
* Help standardize IAM roles, policies, and access controls across users, applications, and automation.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS

* Platform / IDP: Kubernetes at scale (GKE/EKS), image and container lifecycle, Terraform module design, developer self-service.
* CI/CD: Harness, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab; artifact management and release safety.
* Configuration management: Ansible or SaltStack.
* Cloud operations: patching, backup, tagging, capacity, change, incident, and problem management.
* Apigee: infrastructure resiliency, proxy and environment deployments.
* Networking: DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, hybrid connectivity.
* Security and identity: IAM design, secrets and certificate management, policy as code.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

50326d97.description:
**ABOUT US**

Ensono is a hybrid IT services provider that sees a world in transformation. We understand the world of business has become more complex, layered, and interdependent because we're enabling the IT infrastructure for that transformation. Our clients are some of the most innovative and forward-thinking companies in the world and we help keep their businesses thriving. With nearly 50 years of experience, we optimize and modernize IT infrastructure by amplifying the power of mainframes and mid-range servers with the agility of cloud. Check us out at www.ensono.com

  

**Job Description:**

  

**Role Summary**

Ensono's Public Cloud Consulting practice is looking for a Junior Azure Platform Security Engineer to support the secure operation and improvement of enterprise Microsoft Azure environments. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and architects, the role focuses on remediating security findings, implementing Private Endpoints, hardening Azure services, and validating secure network connectivity.

The successful candidate will build practical experience across Azure security, networking, DNS, infrastructure as code, and production change management while helping application and product teams reduce externally exposed attack surfaces with minimal service impact.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the implementation of Azure Private Endpoints and the transition of supported Azure services from public to private connectivity.

* Assist with remediation of security findings identified through Microsoft Defender for Cloud and related security tools.

* Apply approved hardening changes to Azure Storage Accounts, Azure SQL and database services, and Azure App Services.

* Gather application dependencies, connectivity requirements, and change-impact information before remediation activities.

* Configure and troubleshoot VNets, subnets, routes, Private Link connectivity, service-to-service traffic, and Private Endpoint DNS resolution with support from senior team members.

* Validate expected traffic flows through Azure Firewall and Palo Alto firewalls and collect evidence for troubleshooting.

* Support both Terraform-managed and manually deployed Azure environments, following existing standards and peer-review processes.

* Coordinate with application, product, and infrastructure teams to schedule, test, and safely implement changes in live environments.

* Perform pre-change and post-change validation, update technical documentation, and escalate risks or unexpected behaviour promptly.

* Help reduce public exposure and align Azure resources with approved security baselines and operational procedures.

  

**Junior-Level Role Expectations**

* Works within defined designs, standards, and change procedures.

* Completes assigned implementation and troubleshooting tasks with guidance.

* Documents work clearly and raises dependencies, risks, and blockers early.

* Develops knowledge through hands-on delivery, shadowing, and structured learning.

**Essential Technical Skills**

* Foundational hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure administration, networking, or security.

* Working knowledge of Azure Private Link, Private Endpoints, private DNS zones, and name-resolution concepts.

* Understanding of VNets, subnets, network security groups, routing, IP addressing, and basic traffic flows.

* Exposure to securing Azure Storage Accounts, Azure SQL or other database services, and Azure App Services.

* Awareness of Microsoft Defender for Cloud recommendations and security remediation workflows.

* Basic working knowledge of Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code approach, including plan review and controlled deployment.

* Familiarity with Azure Firewall; exposure to Palo Alto firewalls or similar network security platforms is beneficial.

* Ability to follow dependency checks, test plans, rollback plans, and production change controls.

* Basic troubleshooting skills using Azure Portal, logs, DNS tools, and connectivity tests.

* Clear written and verbal communication, teamwork, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Approximately 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in cloud operations, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, or technical support.

* Practical exposure to Azure through employment, internship, lab work, project delivery, or structured training.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline.

* Experience working with ticketing, incident, problem, or change-management processes is desirable.

  

**Nice to Have**

* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or Azure Security Engineer Associate certification.

* Exposure to Azure DevOps or GitHub workflows and peer-reviewed code changes.

* Awareness of Azure Policy, role-based access control, logging, monitoring, and security best practices.

* Experience supporting enterprise or customer-facing environments.

  

**Key Skill Areas**

Azure Security | Private Endpoints | Private Link | Azure Networking | DNS | VNets | Subnets | Routing | Storage Accounts | Azure SQL | App Services | Microsoft Defender for Cloud | Terraform | Infrastructure as Code | Azure Firewall | Palo Alto | Security Remediation | Troubleshooting | Production Change Management

1a703d85.title: AI Delivery Manager
1a703d85.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Delivery Manager based in India.**
The AI Delivery Manager will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of innovative Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI projects. This role combines strong project and program management expertise with a solid understanding of AI technologies, software engineering, and modern data platforms. The successful candidate will oversee multiple AI initiatives, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives. Working closely with clients, business stakeholders, data scientists, ML engineers, software developers, and architects, the role will drive collaboration across technical and business teams. The position covers the full AI delivery lifecycle, from proof of concepts and MVPs to production deployment and ongoing optimization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI transformation initiatives in a dynamic, collaborative, and technology-driven environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI projects, from initial planning and requirements gathering through development, deployment, and production implementation.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, timelines, and success metrics in alignment with business priorities.
* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocation, and delivery roadmaps.
* Oversee multiple AI projects and workstreams simultaneously, ensuring effective prioritization and coordination of resources.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, manage dependencies, and implement corrective actions to maintain delivery commitments.
* Ensure projects meet agreed expectations regarding scope, schedule, budget, quality, and business outcomes.
* Manage AI/ML delivery lifecycles, including data preparation, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous optimization.
* Coordinate the delivery of initiatives involving Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, and AI-driven automation.
* Collaborate with technical teams on AI solution architecture, model selection, data requirements, APIs, system integrations, and deployment strategies.
* Maintain a working understanding of emerging AI concepts and technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, AI agents, MLOps, and LLM evaluation.
* Coordinate proof of concepts (POCs), minimum viable products (MVPs), pilot programs, and full-scale production implementations.
* Serve as the primary delivery contact between clients, business stakeholders, and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Organize project reviews, steering committee meetings, stakeholder discussions, and executive reporting sessions.
* Translate business requirements into actionable technical deliverables and ensure consistent alignment between business expectations and engineering execution.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, communicate project updates, highlight risks, and facilitate timely decisions.
* Drive collaboration across business, product, engineering, data, security, and architecture teams to ensure successful project delivery.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in project or program management, preferably leading AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI initiatives.
* Strong understanding of AI and Machine Learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Knowledge of Generative AI technologies and Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.
* Familiarity with NLP and/or Computer Vision applications, AI agents, and agentic AI solutions.
* Understanding of model evaluation, monitoring, MLOps, and LLMOps practices.
* Ability to understand and coordinate technical discussions involving AI architecture, data pipelines, model selection, APIs, integrations, and production deployment.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Familiarity with AI development platforms and tools, including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Databricks, and MLflow.
* Understanding of containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or Smartsheet.
* Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting and analytics tools for project tracking and performance reporting.
* Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, including experience working with senior leadership, clients, and multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify delivery challenges and drive practical solutions.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language and actionable project plans.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, collaborative environments with evolving technology requirements and business priorities.

**Benefits**

* Flexible working arrangements, including remote work opportunities depending on project and business requirements.
* Opportunity to work on innovative AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI projects.
* Exposure to modern technologies, cloud platforms, and emerging AI solutions.
* Professional development opportunities in a rapidly evolving technology landscape.
* Collaborative and inclusive working environment that values diverse perspectives and individual contributions.
* Opportunities to work with international clients and multidisciplinary teams.
* Flexible scheduling options, including arrangements outside traditional business hours when required.
* Supportive return-to-work program for professionals resuming their careers after extended breaks due to health or family circumstances.

83dd1120.title: Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager (India)
83dd1120.description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At **Worldwide Clinical Trials** , we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.

  

With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.

  

**Make an Impact as a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager at Worldwide**

  

As a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager, you'll play a critical role in advancing key information security initiatives that support business goals, regulatory commitments, and risk reduction objectives. Working within the Governance, Risk and Compliance team and reporting to the Senior Director of Governance, Risk and Compliance, you'll lead complex programs that drive meaningful security and operational outcomes across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you'll provide end-to-end leadership for a portfolio of information security and GRC programs, guiding strategy, governance, planning, execution, and long-term adoption. You'll partner closely with leaders across the Office of the CISO, Information Technology, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, and other business functions to ensure programs deliver measurable value and sustainable results.

Your ability to bring structure to complex initiatives, align diverse stakeholders, and provide clear executive-level insights will help strengthen security capabilities and support continued organizational success.

  

**Where You'll Work**

  

This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.

  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Lead multiple information security and GRC programs from strategy and planning through delivery, operational transition, and benefits realization.
* Develop and maintain multi-year program roadmaps aligned to security priorities, regulatory requirements, audit commitments, and business objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks, steering forums, escalation paths, and delivery standards that enable effective program execution.
* Manage program scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and change activities across multiple workstreams.
* Partner with project managers, workstream leaders, and vendors to ensure alignment, accountability, and successful delivery outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across Information Security, IT, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, Procurement, Clinical Operations, and business teams.
* Deliver concise, decision-focused reporting to executive leadership, including portfolio status, risks, forecasts, financials, and key milestones.
* Oversee vendor performance, program financials, stakeholder engagement, adoption planning, and operational readiness activities.
Define and monitor program success metrics, risk indicators, and benefits realization while continuously improving governance and delivery practices.  

  

**What You'll Bring**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business, Project or Program Management, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of progressive project and program management experience, including ownership of multiple concurrent information security or cybersecurity programs.
* Proven experience leading security programs end-to-end, including strategy, governance, planning, execution, financial oversight, executive reporting, operational transition, and benefits realization.
* Experience delivering security initiatives such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, security operations, cloud security, data protection, third-party risk, compliance remediation, security tooling, or security transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of program and project management disciplines, including portfolio governance, budgeting, resource management, vendor management, risk management, and benefits tracking.
* Working knowledge of information security frameworks, controls, risk management principles, and security operations, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, workstream leads, project managers, and vendors within a matrixed environment; experience in regulated industries such as clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or pharmaceuticals is strongly preferred.
Proficiency in English, along with excellent written, verbal, facilitation, negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills; PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or similar certifications are preferred.  

  

**Discover the Difference**

  

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit **http://www.worldwide.com/careers** **,** or connect with us on **LinkedIn** .

**What will you own?**

* Write specification documents and workflows.
* Establish and implement a team culture within his/her assigned project.
* Manage multiple projects at all stages while ensuring consistent high levels of service delivery.

  

**What are we looking for?**

* The ideal candidate will have 10 - 15 years of end to end project management experience in a customer facing role.
* Must have proven experience using project management tools and methodologies
* Excellent communication skills
* Excellent Customer Management & negotiation skills
* Excellent leadership skills
* University Degree in electrical or computer engineering, or Equivalent experience
* Highly knowledgeable in project management
* Project Management Professional (PMP) accreditation preferred.
* Knowledge of Broadcast, Digital, Linear, or SSAI is preferred.
* Experience with Complex Cloud Solutions
* Proven track record working in a team environment
* Proven experience in delivering real-time projects under time constraints
* Excellent project management skills and competency
* Good technical knowledge is an asset

  

**Life at Amagi:**

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

* Be Vulnerable, Be You. Authenticity is our baseline.
* Goodness Wins. We always lead with integrity.
* Have Fun with Challenges. We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* Think Macro, Do Micro. We dream big but execute with relentless precision.

  

**A Place That Takes Care of You:**

We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

**Minimum qualifications:**

* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) Gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As an AI Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your deep expertise in strategic product areas in partnership with Platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. c98b9c41.title: Solutions Specialist, MCU
c98b9c41.description:
**About Us**
Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.
  
  
Our software and development tools help build products for cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries worldwide. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.
  
  
Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.
  
  
We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.
  
  
**About The Role**
Qt for MCUs is on a mission to bring Qt’s industry-leading UI framework to the most resource-constrained microcontrollers on the market — enabling rich, responsive user experiences on devices where every byte of Flash and every millisecond of CPU time matters. Our team works directly with the world’s leading silicon vendors and embedded product companies to make that vision a reality.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer — MCU, you are the technical heart of our customer engagements. You will port Qt for MCUs to new silicon platforms, design display adaptation layers, solve complex hardware-software integration challenges, and serve as the go-to subject matter expert for MCU-related opportunities across sales, pre-sales, and product engineering.
  
  
This role is located in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Port Qt for MCUs to new microcontroller platforms — from BSP bring-up and HAL integration through to display adaptation, framebuffer management, and validated performance on target hardware
* Design and optimise display and graphics pipelines for memory-constrained MCUs, including DMA-driven transfers, partial rendering, and asset optimisation using the Qt for MCUs toolchain
* Act as the primary technical SME for customer engagements, proof-of-concept projects, and evaluations — delivering workshops, demos, and training to engineering teams worldwide
* Debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, BSP, and UI stack layers using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and oscilloscopes; provide root-cause analysis and drive resolution with product engineering
* Author application notes, porting guides, and best-practice documentation; support the sales team with technical proposals and RFP responses for Qt for MCUs solutions
* Collaborate closely with silicon vendors (Infineon, Renesas, NXP, STMicroelectronics) and internal engineering teams to bridge cutting-edge Qt technology with real-world MCU constraints

**What You Bring To The Table**

* 5–8 years of hands-on embedded software engineering experience with a strong focus on microcontroller-based products and ARM Cortex-M class devices (STM32, NXP i.MX RT, Renesas RA/RH)
* Proven experience porting or adapting embedded software stacks in bare-metal and RTOS environments (FreeRTOS and/or Zephyr), with a solid grasp of MCU memory architecture
* Hands-on experience with TFT/LCD display integration: framebuffer management, pixel format handling, display controller configuration, and serial protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, DMA)
* Experience with at least one embedded GUI framework — Qt for MCUs, LVGL, Embedded Wizard, or STemWin — and proficiency in C and C++ with CMake-based build systems
* Strong communication skills in English; ability to translate deep technical knowledge into clear guidance for both engineering and commercial audiences

**Bonus Points For…**

* Experience with additional MCU families (ESP32/Espressif, PIC/Microchip) or silicon vendor BSP ecosystems such as STM32CubeIDE, MCUXpresso, e2studio, or ModusToolbox
* Prior Solutions Engineering, Field Application Engineering, or other customer-facing technical role experience
* Familiarity with Qt Widgets or Qt Quick/QML on higher-powered targets, and/or contributions to open-source embedded or GUI projects

**Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters.**
We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.
  
  

* Flexibility You Can Count On We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.
* Meaningful Wellbeing Support From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.
* Opportunities to Grow Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.
* Inclusive by Design You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.
* Rewarding Your Impact Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are.

**Bring Your Whole Self**
The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work.
  
  
We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference.
  
  
**We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.**

23f60f94.title: Engineer I - Data center Solutions Design
23f60f94.description:
**JD-Engineer I or II- Mechanical Engineering- Data center Solutions Design**

  

Seeking a ***Solutions Mechanical Engineer*** with experience in Technical Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) or related piping and fluid systems (HVAC, hydronics, process cooling) to design and deliver custom solutions. The role focuses on supporting customer orders from initial quote preparation through to production-ready designs, working globally with customers, offering management, and suppliers. Responsibilities include creating rapid concept layouts using configurator/automation tools, refining them into manufacturable solutions, and engaging suppliers early to balance cost, quality, and lead time. The role also requires ensuring layouts align with customer requirements while feeding lessons learned into NPDI standards.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with customers and offering management to define TCS/SFN or related piping system requirements, design criteria, and constraints.
* Generate rapid concept layouts of TCS/SFN systems, including piping, manifolds, valves, clamps, and fittings, to support timely and accurate quote preparation.
* Use and help refine rapid layout/quoting tools to streamline CPQ integration and improve speed and accuracy of proposals.
* Translate concept layouts into manufacturable designs using company standards and supplier capabilities.
* Work with suppliers early in the design process to confirm manufacturability, cost targets, and lead times, and validate final builds through pressure/leak testing, cleanliness verification, and quality checks.
* Oversee the smooth transition from concept to production, including documentation, BOM creation, and engineering change management in PLM systems (Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill).
* Capture lessons learned and integrate improvements into standard NPDI TCS/SFN modules and design practices.

  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
* 3 - 8 years of experience in piping/fluid systems, preferably in data center liquid cooling, HVAC, hydronics, or process cooling.
* Proficiency with Creo for detailed TCS/SFN design, assemblies, and engineering documentation.
* Familiarity with rapid concept and layout tools such as Creo, AutoCAD Plant 3D, Revit MEP, or SpaceClaim for quick iteration and customer visualizations.
* Experience preparing layout drawings, routing plans, and BOMs for piping or liquid cooling systems.
* Knowledge of pressure testing, leak detection, and cleanliness requirements for fluid assemblies.
* Strong English communication skills for collaboration with customers, offering teams, and suppliers.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with global engineering teams.

  

* **Preferred Skills**

+ Experience with automation/configuration tools such as kBridge, Eplan, or similar for generating repeatable layouts and BOMs.
+ Knowledge of manufacturing processes for stainless-steel and plastic piping systems, including welding, bending, clamping, and joining methods.
+ Understanding of fluid system components such as manifolds, quick disconnects, strainers, expansion tanks, balancing valves, and sensors.
+ Ability to perform system balancing, pressure drop calculations, and valve Cv selection.
+ Familiarity with NPDI, Stage-Gate, or other structured product development processes.
+ Hands-on involvement in prototype builds, FAT/SAT, and validation reporting.

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

AWS - Cloud Engineer

6-9 Years

*Customer Experience Platform Engineering*

Role Summary

We are seeking an AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, integrate, and support cloud-native customer experience capabilities within an Amazon Connect-powered contact center ecosystem. This role uses AWS services, APIs, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and Infrastructure as Code to extend Amazon Connect and deliver seamless experiences across voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service, agent workflows, analytics, and enterprise systems. The ideal candidate combines hands-on AWS engineering expertise with experience in contact center technologies, customer journey design, and the operational needs of a large-scale customer experience platform. We operate with an AI-first engineering mindset and expect engineers to use AI-assisted practices responsibly to improve speed, quality, and innovation.

Technical Skills Framework

Primary skills are the tools and capabilities used by the team to perform the role. Each definition describes the core skill and its application within the Amazon Connect contact center ecosystem. Comparable skillsets represent adjacent experience that may transfer and accelerate onboarding, but are not technically aligned to the team’s current way of working.

Primary Skills

Skill

Definition

Comparable skillset

Lambda

Build scalable serverless applications, APIs, routing extensions, workflow services, and event-driven integrations that enhance Amazon Connect and support customer and agent experiences.

Python; JavaScript

AWS Services

Engineer cloud-native capabilities using S3, DynamoDB, KMS, EventBridge, IAM, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and related services to support interaction processing, notifications, orchestration, analytics, and secure integration with Amazon Connect.

Comparable Azure or Google Cloud services

CDK

Implement Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK to automate consistent, secure deployment and management of Amazon Connect supporting services and customer experience capabilities.

CloudFormation; Terraform

Design, secure, and manage REST and HTTP APIs that connect Amazon Connect, agent experiences, enterprise systems, and third-party contact center technologies.

APIGEE; APIC

Genesys Architect; NICE Studio; Five9 Studio; Cisco CVP

Connect Desktop

Understand Amazon Connect agent desktop configuration, routing profiles, agent workflows, and operational processes so cloud-native capabilities integrate seamlessly into the agent experience.

Genesys Cloud administration; NICE CXone administration; Five9 administration

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Platform Engineering

* Design and develop cloud-native capabilities that extend Amazon Connect functionality and improve customer and agent experiences.

* Build services that enable customer self-service, routing enhancements, agent productivity, interaction processing, workflow orchestration, notifications, authentication, analytics, and experience optimization.

* Partner with Connect Engineers, Product Owners, architects, and business stakeholders to implement end-to-end customer journeys using Amazon Connect and supporting AWS services.

* Translate contact center and customer experience needs into scalable, reusable, and supportable technical capabilities.

Contact Center Ecosystem Integration

* Develop APIs, event-driven services, and integration patterns that connect Amazon Connect with enterprise systems and third-party contact center technologies.

* Build integrations supporting voice, chat, email, messaging, customer authentication, outbound communications, workforce processes, analytics, and customer engagement capabilities.

* Integrate contact center workflows with customer, policy, claims, knowledge, workforce, communication, reporting, and other enterprise platforms.

* Contribute to migration and modernization initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and platform scalability.

Cloud-Native Application Development

* Design, develop, test, and support serverless applications, APIs, microservices, and reusable platform services using Lambda, TypeScript, and related AWS technologies.

* Use event-driven and asynchronous patterns to process contact events, coordinate workflows, and decouple Amazon Connect from downstream systems.

* Design for resilience, scalability, performance, recoverability, security, and cost efficiency across the customer interaction lifecycle.

Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps

* Implement Amazon Connect supporting infrastructure and AWS services using CDK and repeatable deployment patterns.

* Build and maintain CI/CD automation, testing, quality gates, security scanning, and environment promotion processes.

* Apply least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and enterprise cloud governance standards.

API and Integration Engineering

* Design, secure, version, document, and operate APIs used by contact flows, agent applications, customer channels, and enterprise systems.

* Apply authentication, authorization, throttling, error handling, observability, and governance standards.

* Evaluate integration alternatives and document architectural decisions and tradeoffs based on customer experience, operational, and technical requirements.

Platform Operations and Optimization

* Monitor production services and end-to-end contact center integrations, respond to incidents, and restore customer and agent capabilities.

* Use telemetry to identify customer journey failures, integration issues, performance constraints, and improvement opportunities.

* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements that increase reliability, recoverability, and operational supportability.

* Optimize cloud consumption while protecting customer experience, platform performance, and service resilience.

AI-First Engineering

9495d403.title: Solution Architect - AWS Integration & API Gateway
9495d403.description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Solution Architect to design and lead a central email gateway. It will sit between the client's commerce platform, its middleware (enterprise service bus) and a new email service provider, and will carry all business-critical transactional email, such as order, shipping, refund and account notifications. The gateway offers two integration models:
  
  

* a pass-through API for systems that are ready to use the new provider directly
* a backward-compatible API that mimics the legacy provider, so existing systems only need to change an endpoint

The Architect will own the AWS target architecture, the versioned API contracts, a configuration-driven mapping model, and the resilience design needed to make sure no email is lost or sent twice. The role leads a small cross-functional team on a short build window, drives technical decisions with the client's architects, and owns cutover readiness and early-life support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design**

* Own the AWS target architecture across edge, API Gateway, private networking, load-balancing and ECS Fargate integration, containerized compute, eventing, audit and data flows
* Define versioned OpenAPI contracts for the pass-through and backward-compatible APIs
* Design a configuration-driven mapping engine for campaign, field and error-code translation
* Design resilience patterns: timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaker, idempotency and dead-letter queue (DLQ) handling
* Design the Security & Observability Framework

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead discovery and capture existing integration contracts from live traffic
* Set engineering standards and review all code, including AI-generated code
* Guide developers, DevOps and QA on design, testability and performance
* Establish AI-assisted application-building workflows using AI approved

**Stakeholder & Delivery**

* Present options and recommendations to the client's architecture and platform teams
* Coordinate the ecommerce, middleware and email provider teams through integration and SIT
* Own cutover planning, go/no-go criteria and early-life support

**Security & Compliance**

* Ensure OAuth2 machine-to-machine authentication, encryption, least-privilege IAM and PII masking
* Align audit retention and the data purge approach with GDPR/CCPA requirements

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong solution architecture experience on AWS: API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, SQS, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, IAM and KMS
* Configuration management using AppConfig or DynamoDB; observability with CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry/ADOT or X-Ray; CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code design.
* Proven design of API gateways or enterprise integration layers for high-volume transactional systems
* Hands-on with Node.js/TypeScript or Java/Spring Boot microservices
* Strong grasp of resilience patterns, idempotency and event-driven design
* OpenAPI-first design and contract testing practices
* Excellent stakeholder communication and technical leadership

**Good-to-Have**

* Exposure to email service provider platforms; retail transactional email, ESB/middleware platforms
* Fastify; Akamai WAF; Terraform or AWS CDK; OpenSearch/ELK-based operational search.
* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional certification

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of relevant software engineering experience with solution architecture and hands-on technical leadership.
* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent
* AWS architecture certification is desirable.

07c69810.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Telecom and Voice Operations Manager, you will lead client-facing telecom and voice services across cloud and on-premises infrastructure within our Advisory practice at PwC Acceleration Center India. This role offers the opportunity to shape managed service delivery through cloud administration, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and service management. You will work with platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud, using tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, and CrowdStrike where appropriate. By connecting infrastructure optimization, cloud compliance, and cost management practices, including FinOps and Apptio, you will help clients manage operational complexity and improve service performance.

You will coach team members through feedback and work review, draw on their varied strengths, and foster an inclusive environment where concerns can be raised. Your accountability includes coordinating with practice leadership on quality and timelines, addressing difficult conversations with clients and stakeholders, and escalating issues when appropriate. With professional skepticism and business knowledge, you will identify opportunities to improve delivery through AI and automation while upholding technical standards, independence requirements, and the firm’s values.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading telecom and voice service operations across client cloud and on-premises infrastructure, coordinating incident response, maintenance, service requests, and technical support
* Managing cloud operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud platforms, aligning infrastructure administration with client service requirements
* Directing troubleshooting of voice and infrastructure issues, using Splunk, Dynatrace APM, and Performance Monitor to investigate disruptions and track performance
* Guiding cloud migration handoffs and infrastructure changes, reviewing architecture, operational readiness, performance impacts, and continuity of voice services
* Overseeing cloud compliance and security activities within managed operations, coordinating use of CrowdStrike and escalation of risks affecting infrastructure and voice environments
* Applying Apptio and FinOps practices to assess cloud consumption and infrastructure costs, identifying opportunities to improve resource use and service efficiency
* Managing client workstreams, timelines, and deliverables, consulting with stakeholders to clarify technical needs, communicate tradeoffs, and address changing priorities
* Coaching team members through technical reviews and feedback, using automation, digital tools, and AI-assisted workflows to improve service management and problem resolution

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 5 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Leading telecom and voice service operations across client infrastructure environments while coordinating cloud service delivery
* Managing cloud and on-premises infrastructure support, troubleshooting issues and improving service performance
* Leveraging AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform for cloud administration and migration initiatives
* Applying Dynatrace APM and Splunk to monitor infrastructure performance and guide operational improvements
* Using Apptio and FinOps operating models to assess infrastructure costs and identify optimization opportunities
* Coaching technical teams through complex service issues, providing feedback and maintaining client communication
* Integrating cloud compliance and security considerations into operational planning and technology administration

0f39af02.description:
Delivery Manager - US IT Staffing

  

**Location:** Sector 74A, Gurugram Onsite

**Experience:** 3+ years in US IT Staffing

  

**Suitable profiles:** Delivery Manager, Delivery Lead, Lead Recruiter, or Senior Recruiter ready to take on team leadership responsibilities.

  

About the Role

We are looking for a **sharp, target-driven staffing professional** to drive recruitment delivery for US IT requirements. This is a hands-on role combining **recruiting, team mentoring, and delivery ownership**, with clear accountability for quality submissions, interviews, and placements.

Strong Senior and Lead Recruiters with demonstrated leadership potential are encouraged to apply. **A stable employment history and consistent performance will be highly valued.**

  

Key Responsibilities

* Own recruitment delivery for assigned US IT requirements and meet agreed **submission, interview, and placement targets**.
* Remain actively involved in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and closures.
* Create and refine **advanced Boolean search strings** to identify relevant candidates across job portals, LinkedIn, and resume databases.
* Prioritize requirements, allocate work, and guide recruiters toward timely, quality submissions.
* Review candidate profiles for technical relevance, communication skills, availability, and alignment with client requirements.
* Mentor recruiters on sourcing techniques, screening, professional outreach, follow-ups, and candidate management.
* Track recruitment activity and conversion metrics, identify delivery gaps, and take corrective action.
* Coordinate with account managers and internal stakeholders on priorities, candidate feedback, and delivery progress.
* Maintain professional communication and accurate recruitment records throughout the hiring process.

  

Required Skills and Experience

* **Minimum 3 years of hands-on US IT Staffing experience**, with a proven record of meeting recruitment targets.
* **Strong Boolean sourcing skills**, including the ability to build precise searches for niche technical requirements.
* Good understanding of IT roles, technologies, and US staffing processes.
* Excellent **verbal and written communication skills**, with professional candidate and stakeholder engagement.
* A confident leadership presence, sound judgment, and the ability to hold a team accountable respectfully.
* Ability to mentor recruiters, improve team performance, and lead by example.
* Strong ownership, urgency, organization, and follow-through.
* A **positive attitude, professional conduct, and openness to feedback**.
* Willingness to work **onsite in Sector 74A, Gurugram**.

  

What We Value

**Consistent delivery, career stability, strong sourcing ability, and a lead-by-example mindset.** The ideal candidate is commercially focused, communicates clearly, supports the team, and takes responsibility for results.

08dd5918.title: STEM Program Manager
08dd5918.description:
**Job Title: STEM Program Manager**  
**Department:** Programs / STEM Education  
**Reports To:**  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** Kalyan Nagar, Bengaluru  
**Experience:** 3–7 years in program management, education, STEM/EdTech, training, or a related field

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **STEM Program Manager** to plan, manage, and deliver STEM education programs across schools, institutions, and other learning environments.

The Program Manager will be responsible for end-to-end program execution, including curriculum planning, trainer management, school/client coordination, resource planning, quality monitoring, reporting, and program improvement.

The ideal candidate should have strong project management, communication, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills, along with a good understanding of STEM education and experiential learning.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Planning & Execution**

* Plan and manage STEM education programs from initiation through completion.
* Develop program plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and implementation schedules.
* Coordinate with schools, educational institutions, clients, and internal teams for successful program execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered according to agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and learning objectives.
* Identify potential operational challenges and implement timely solutions.

**Curriculum & Content**

* Work with curriculum/content teams to develop and improve STEM learning programs.
* Review lesson plans, projects, activities, assessments, and training materials.
* Ensure content is age-appropriate, practical, engaging, and aligned with program objectives.
* Identify new STEM technologies, tools, and learning methodologies that can strengthen programs.

**Trainer Management**

* Recruit, onboard, train, and manage STEM Trainers and facilitators.
* Prepare trainer schedules and allocate resources based on program requirements.
* Conduct trainer orientation, reviews, and performance assessments.
* Monitor trainer performance and provide coaching and feedback.
* Ensure trainers follow curriculum, safety procedures, classroom standards, and reporting processes.

**School / Client Management**

* Act as the primary program contact for assigned schools or clients.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with school management, teachers, coordinators, and other stakeholders.
* Conduct regular review meetings and collect stakeholder feedback.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate internally to address them.
* Support presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and program onboarding when required.

**Operations & Resource Management**

* Plan STEM kits, equipment, consumables, infrastructure, and other resources required for programs.
* Coordinate logistics for workshops, events, competitions, exhibitions, and STEM labs.
* Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, inventory tracking, and safety of STEM equipment.
* Coordinate with procurement and operations teams for timely availability of resources.

**Monitoring & Reporting**

* Track program progress against defined milestones and objectives.
* Monitor student participation, attendance, learning outcomes, and project completion.
* Prepare regular program reports, MIS dashboards, and performance summaries.
* Analyze feedback and program data to identify areas for improvement.
* Maintain accurate documentation of program activities and outcomes.

**Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain quality standards for STEM program delivery.
* Conduct periodic classroom observations and program audits.
* Identify gaps in curriculum, training, operations, and student engagement.
* Implement corrective and improvement measures.
* Develop best practices and standard operating procedures for program delivery.

**Events & Special Programs**

* Plan and manage STEM competitions, hackathons, exhibitions, science fairs, innovation challenges, boot camps, and other special events.
* Coordinate trainers, students, schools, equipment, logistics, and event partners.
* Ensure smooth execution and timely closure of events.

**Required Skills**

* Strong program/project management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management abilities.
* Team leadership and people-management skills.
* Strong organizational and planning abilities.
* Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously.
* Good understanding of STEM education and experiential learning.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace and program-management or reporting tools.
* Ability to analyze program data and prepare reports.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degrees in engineering, Technology, Science, Education, Management, or a related field.
* A certification in Project Management, Education, STEM, or a related area is an advantage.

**Preferred Experience**

* 3–7 years of experience in program/project management, education, EdTech, STEM education, training, or a related field.
* Experience managing trainers or education teams.
* Experience working with schools, educational institutions, or corporate/CSR education programs.
* Experience managing multi-location programs is an advantage.
* Practical exposure to robotics, coding, electronics, IoT, AI, maker education, or other STEM domains is preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Successful and timely execution of STEM programs.
* Program quality and achievement of learning objectives.
* Student engagement and learning outcomes.
* Trainer performance and retention.
* School/client satisfaction.
* Program completion and adherence to timelines.
* Resource and operational efficiency.
* Quality and timeliness of reporting.
* Successful execution of events and special programs.
* Continuous improvement in program delivery.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong leadership and ownership.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Structured and detail-oriented approach.
* Passion for education and STEM.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to build strong relationships with multiple stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel, if required.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

b401f9e5.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Gurugram, Haryana, India; New Delhi, Delhi, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Knowledge of advanced technical and cultural domains.
* Ability to bridge the gap between cultural sector and emerging technologies with a track record of such programs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to travel 20% of the time domestically and internationally

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

We drive the development and implementation of Google’s global sustainability strategy to further empower action, ensure alignment and prioritization, identify leadership opportunities, and mitigate risks. We drive sustainability strategy and programs on carbon, circular economy, water, product integration, reporting, and employee engagement, while serving as a sustainability leadership advocate internally and externally.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Organize activities and proactively identify process improvements using agile methodologies to guide results.
* Define cross-functional challenges, manage stakeholder expectations, and guide alignment on project goals and deliverables.
* Use stand-alone judgment to navigate changing circumstances and escalate obstacles to leadership in a timely manner.
* Leverage AI and internal tools to optimize project portfolios while maintaining professional documentation and milestone tracking.
* Monitor progress and communicate results by applying standard organizational processes and technologies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
