b52c50c3.title: Pre Sales Tax Consultant(7+ years) - Chartered Accountant
b52c50c3.description:
**Job Description**
Thomson Reuters is seeking a Solutions Consultant to drive revenue growth for its tax technology portfolio across the India market. This client-facing, commercially focused pre-sales role partners closely with Sales teams to identify, qualify, shape and close strategic opportunities, bringing deep domain expertise in indirect tax, GST, direct tax, e-invoicing, compliance workflows, global trade and tax technology solutions. The Solutions Consultant acts as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them understand how Thomson Reuters solutions address their business, compliance, operational and technology challenges.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Sales teams across the full sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through solution design, proposal development, negotiation support and deal closure, and help develop and close new business to meet and exceed gross sales targets.
* Lead customer discovery to understand business challenges, compliance requirements, current tax processes, technology landscape and desired outcomes, then recommend the most appropriate Thomson Reuters tax solutions.
* Translate complex indirect tax, GST and e-invoicing requirements into clear solution narratives and differentiated value propositions that position Thomson Reuters against competitors.
* Own and deliver tailored product demonstrations, solution workshops, proof-of-concept discussions and functional deep-dives for stakeholders across tax, finance, IT, procurement, shared services and executive leadership.
* Support RFPs, RFIs, tenders and customer questionnaires, contribute to business cases and commercial positioning, and work with Sales, Product, Legal and Commercial Policy to execute complex deals.
* Stay current on indirect tax, GST, e-invoicing, regulatory change and tax technology trends in India, and bring these insights into customer conversations and industry forums.
* Share customer feedback, market trends, competitive insights and product enhancement opportunities with Product and Business teams, acting as an internal advocate for customer needs.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, activity and customer information in Salesforce and other CRM systems, and collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services and Support to keep forecasts accurate and customer requirements addressed.

**Required Qualifications**

* CA qualification with typically 10+ years of relevant experience in indirect tax, GST, e-invoicing, tax technology, finance transformation, consulting, pre-sales or enterprise software solutions.
* Strong understanding of global indirect tax regulations, GST compliance, e-invoicing, e-way bill processes and related tax technology workflows.
* Proven customer-facing experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, tax technology consulting, enterprise software sales support or advisory services, with the ability to support or influence complex B2B sales cycles.
* Strong commercial acumen and understanding of the sales process, including opportunity qualification, discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, proposal support and deal closure.
* Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, tenders, proposals, demonstrations or bid processes.
* Ability to map customer business challenges to appropriate solutions, with a consultative mindset, strong problem-solving skills and a customer-first approach.
* Strong presentation, storytelling and communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders across tax, finance, accounting, IT, procurement and executive leadership.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities, priorities and pre-sales projects simultaneously, with strong CRM discipline, preferably in Salesforce.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience identifying cross-sell and up-sell opportunities across a broader tax, accounting or compliance solution portfolio.
* Experience with enterprise tax, ERP, compliance or finance automation solutions.
* Prior experience with Thomson Reuters tax products or comparable tax technology platforms.
* Background in Big Four, tax consulting, tax technology implementation, enterprise SaaS or regulatory compliance solutions.
* Exposure to large corporate tax and finance departments, shared service centers or multinational compliance environments.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
  
  
Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
  
  
More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:
  
  
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
  
  
We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. 5c808fef.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training ,Speech AI ,Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI . As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing agentic and RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on Speech AI, LLMs, Agentic and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of speech AI , LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs) ,Speech AI
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM ,Speech AI models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Proven ability to optimize LLM models ,Speech models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

78787c78.title: Infrastructure & Platform Architect
78787c78.description:
**Infrastructure & Platform Architect**

**ENTERPRISE DATA & ANALYTICS**

  

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. Its our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, deployment, and management of enterprise cloud infrastructure primarily on **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**.
* Provide technical leadership and hands-on expertise across Oracle cloud services and technologies, including:

+ **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** – Enterprise application integration, API-based connectivity, and integration orchestration.
+ **Oracle Data Transforms (ODT)** – Data transformation, ELT workflows, and data integration.
+ **Oracle GoldenGate (OGG)** – Change Data Capture (CDC), replication, and real-time data integration.
+ **Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP)** – Modern data platform architecture, data engineering, analytics, and AI-enabled workloads.

* Architect scalable, secure, highly available, and cost-effective OCI environments.
* Design and implement cloud networking, IAM, security policies, connectivity, and resource governance.
* Lead platform modernization, infrastructure optimization, and cloud integration initiatives.
* Establish architecture standards, best practices, and operational guidelines for Oracle Cloud platforms.

  

**2. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Architecture**

* Design, implement, and support enterprise infrastructure and data platforms on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Provide architectural guidance across GCP services, including:

+ BigQuery
+ Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow)
+ Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
+ Cloud Run
+ Cloud Storage
+ Compute Engine
+ IAM, VPC, and Cloud Monitoring

* Design and support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures integrating OCI and GCP.
* Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to design reliable and scalable cloud data platforms.

  

**3. Kubernetes & Container Platform Architecture**

* Architect, deploy, and manage enterprise Kubernetes environments, including **Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
* Define standards for container orchestration, workload deployment, scaling, security, and networking.
* Drive adoption of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and container-based deployment strategies.
* Provide technical guidance on Kubernetes cluster management, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and platform reliability.
* Establish best practices for container security, high availability, and disaster recovery.

  

**4. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation**

* Lead the design and implementation of **Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** solutions across OCI and GCP.
* Develop standardized, reusable Terraform modules for automated cloud infrastructure provisioning.
* Architect **self-service cloud provisioning solutions** that enable engineering teams and business users to request and deploy approved cloud resources through automated workflows.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, access management, and environment lifecycle management.
* Establish infrastructure governance, policy enforcement, approval workflows, and automated compliance validation.
* Integrate infrastructure automation with GitLab CI/CD or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational effort and improve platform efficiency.

  

**5. Enterprise Data Platform & Pipeline Architecture**

* Provide architectural guidance and operational oversight for enterprise data platforms and integration pipelines across OCI and GCP.
* Support Oracle GoldenGate CDC pipelines, OIC integrations, Oracle Data Transforms, and cloud-based data ingestion and transformation frameworks.
* Guide the implementation and optimization of data orchestration tools such as Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow) and dbt.
* Design reliable data integration patterns across Oracle applications, cloud databases, and enterprise analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with data architects and engineers to ensure data platform scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Establish monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational standards for enterprise data pipelines.

  

**6. Infrastructure Operations, Monitoring & Platform Reliability**

* **Lead and provide technical direction to cloud infrastructure, platform support, and monitoring teams** responsible for maintaining enterprise cloud environments.
* Oversee day-to-day platform operations, infrastructure health, monitoring, incident management, and production support.
* Establish operational processes, service-level objectives (SLOs), availability targets, and platform reliability standards.
* Implement proactive monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, and automated incident response across OCI and GCP.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead infrastructure patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
* Establish operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and support models.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring infrastructure support and maintenance activities.

  

**7. Technical Leadership, Governance & Collaboration**

* Serve as a **senior technical leader and subject matter expert** for enterprise cloud infrastructure and platform architecture.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Mentor platform engineers, infrastructure engineers, DevOps engineers, and cloud support teams.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, networking, data engineering, and application teams.
* Drive cloud governance, infrastructure standardization, security compliance, and cost optimization.
* Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and recommend platform improvements aligned with enterprise objectives.
* Provide technical oversight for vendor implementations, infrastructure upgrades, and cloud transformation initiatives.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* **10+ years of hands-on experience** in Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, or DevOps, including significant experience leading enterprise cloud infrastructure initiatives.
* **Strong, recent, and hands-on expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**, including designing, provisioning, configuring, deploying, and managing production cloud environments.
* **Demonstrated hands-on experience with Oracle cloud data and integration technologies**, particularly:

+ **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** – Integration development, deployment, administration, and troubleshooting.
+ **Oracle Data Transforms (ODT)** – Data integration, transformation workflows, and platform administration.
+ **Oracle GoldenGate (OGG)** – CDC, replication, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
+ **Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP)** – Practical knowledge of its architecture, capabilities, and integration with enterprise data and AI workloads.

* **Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, including infrastructure architecture, cloud networking, IAM, Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, and core data platform services.
* **Proven experience with Kubernetes**, preferably Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), including cluster administration, container deployments, networking, scaling, security, and troubleshooting.
* **Extensive hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**, including building reusable modules, automating cloud resource provisioning, and implementing standardized infrastructure deployment frameworks.
* **Experience designing and implementing self-service infrastructure automation**, enabling automated provisioning of cloud services with appropriate governance and access controls.
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps automation**, preferably GitLab CI/CD, including infrastructure and application deployment pipelines.
* **Prior hands-on experience with enterprise data platforms and pipelines**, including data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and integration tools such as Oracle GoldenGate, OIC, ODT, BigQuery, Cloud Composer (Airflow), or dbt.
* **Demonstrated experience leading infrastructure operations, platform maintenance, and production support teams**, including incident management, monitoring, troubleshooting, and service reliability.
* **Strong experience with enterprise cloud monitoring and observability**, including OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, Google Cloud Monitoring, and centralized alerting solutions.
* **Practical experience with cloud security, networking, IAM, disaster recovery, high availability, and infrastructure governance**.
* **Proven technical leadership experience**, including architecture ownership, mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, and coordinating cross-functional engineering and support teams.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
* Excellent analytical, architectural decision-making, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  

**Important:** This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership position. Candidates must demonstrate recent implementation and operational experience with **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Oracle integration technologies**, along with the ability to architect solutions, lead engineering teams, and maintain enterprise cloud platforms. Experience limited to high-level architecture, advisory roles, or people management without hands-on technical involvement will not be sufficient.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Oracle AI Data Platform and AI-enabled enterprise data solutions.
* Experience with Oracle Autonomous Database, Oracle Fusion Cloud applications, and Oracle Database services.
* Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud integration architectures between OCI and GCP.
* Knowledge of GitOps, Helm, Argo CD, and Kubernetes deployment automation.
* Experience with enterprise cloud FinOps, cost governance, and resource optimization.

You will work closely with Account Leadership, delivery teams, and customer stakeholders to protect service quality, manage risk and cost, and drive continuous improvement.

This role matters because customers rely on stable, predictable application services to run their revenue operations, and strong service governance is what keeps those systems dependable as they grow.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery and service outcomes for assigned application accounts, including L2/L3 support, application maintenance, and enhancements, so SLA and customer experience targets are met.
* Lead service governance, including weekly and monthly service reviews, operational reviews, and QBR support, so clients have clear status and accountability.
* Own ITSM processes across incident, problem, change, request, and release management, so changes are controlled and service stays predictable.
* Manage major incidents end to end, coordinating resolution, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis, and preventive actions.
* Drive execution across cross-functional support, development, and QA teams, partnering with team leads on capacity planning and workload balancing.
* Track service cost, effort, and scope to prevent unplanned work, and identify delivery and operational risks early with timely mitigation.

**What Success Looks Like**

***First 90 days***

* Learn the assigned application portfolio, its SLAs, and the governance cadence.
* Build working relationships with the delivery team, Account Leadership, and key customer stakeholders.
* Lead a service review and a major incident process end to end.

***First 6–12 months***

* Consistently meet SLA and KPI targets, with clear accountability for service outcomes.
* Reduce repeat incidents and unplanned work through process and automation improvements.
* Build team capability and capacity so the team runs with fewer escalations.

**How You Will Grow and Make an Impact**

At Model N, our competency model helps us talk about growth, impact, and how work gets done.

* **People Leadership –** You model continuous development and elevate capability within your team, such as building coaching practices that help delivery leads grow.
* **Problem-Solving Leadership –** You drive solutions across teams and influence outcomes beyond your immediate scope, such as resolving a recurring incident pattern across several accounts.
* **Thought Leadership –** You introduce forward-thinking ideas that improve outcomes beyond your team, such as proposing service models that reduce unplanned work across the portfolio.
* **Entrepreneurial Leadership –** You drive innovation across teams and create measurable impact, such as launching automation that cuts the effort of service reviews.
* **Operational Leadership –** You drive execution across teams and improve delivery effectiveness, such as raising SLA attainment across multiple application portfolios.
* **AI Leadership –** You drive adoption of AI within your team and identify practical use cases, such as AI-assisted incident trend analysis and service reporting.

We don't expect everyone to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Typically, 8-11 years of relevant experience.
* 4–6 years in service delivery, project management, or managed application services roles, with hands-on exposure to all phases of the SDLC.
* Experience managing application services or operations in a managed services environment, with a solid understanding of ITIL-based service delivery and ITSM practices.
* Experience driving delivery across cross-functional teams of 8–15 or more members, through influence and team leads rather than direct management.
* Proven client-facing experience in service reviews, escalations, and stakeholder management.
* Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to improve productivity, decision-making, or problem-solving in a professional or personal context.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

***Preferred***

* Certifications such as PMP, ITIL, or equivalent in project management or ITSM.
* Experience managing application support portfolios in SaaS, enterprise software, or revenue management domains.
* Exposure to AI-assisted service management, such as incident trend analysis, knowledge-base improvement, RCA support, and service reporting.
* Experience working with global delivery models and distributed teams.
* Interest in leveraging AI, automation, or modern technologies to improve outcomes.

#### **How We Work**

**Our DARE core values** - **D**REAM**, A**LIGN**, R**ESPECT, and **E**XCEL - shape how we work together.

* We solve practical problems that matter to our customers and teams.

* We work across functions and value clear, respectful communication.

* We recognize good work and support growth over time.

* We are curious about better ways to work, including thoughtful use of AI and modern tools.

We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.

#### **Compensation, Benefits, and Inclusion**

At Model N, your well-being and growth matter. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support employees personally and professionally.

Benefits and compensation for this position will be provided in accordance with Model N’s India programs and applicable local requirements.

#### **Bring Your N Factor**

We are not just looking for a checklist of skills. We are looking for people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a point of view.

If this role sounds interesting and you can see yourself adding value, we would love to hear from you.

**About Model N**

Model N is transforming how Life Sciences companies manage revenue, commercialization, and compliance.

For more than **25 years,** Model N has been the leader in end-to-end commercialization, revenue optimization, and compliance for pharmaceutical and medical technology companies.

Our intelligent, cloud-based platform combines technology, data, analytics, AI, and industry expertise to help leading Life Sciences organizations **optimize revenue, navigate complex regulations, improve decision-making,** and bring life-changing products to market faster.

Today, **150+ leading companies** across the globe trust Model N to optimize growth and transform critical commercial processes. Our solutions manage approximately **$1.3 trillion in gross revenue**, helping customers reduce complexity, strengthen compliance, and unlock new opportunities for growth.

At Model N, we are building the next generation of **Life Sciences revenue management**—where technology, data, AI, and human expertise come together to create meaningful business impact.

Join us to build technology that powers innovation in Life Sciences and makes a difference at global scale.

For more information, visit www.modeln.com.

* Coordinate cross functional project teams working in a hybrid model by setting clear expectations facilitating collaboration and ensuring effective communication flows between business technology and operations to maintain momentum and accountability.

PgMP certification from PMI and a recognized insurance domain credential related to life and annuities.

We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
We are looking for world-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
  
  
The Solution Engineer will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
  
  
***This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Pre-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem
* Prior industry domain experience with a focus on BFSI is highly desirable.

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience - Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud
* Data modeling and data architecture experience
* Experience selling enterprise SaaS software to Global Accounts

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?

4c530eac.title: Archt II-Solutions Archt (INTL)
4c530eac.description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Type of Work: Highly consultative, collaborative with internal Sales and architectural . The daily focus is on independently leading technical pre-sales for mid-to-large enterprise accounts, leading whiteboarding sessions, and designing hybrid telecom/cloud networks. You will also play a critical role in identifying and scoping automation opportunities within customer deployments.
* Expected Volumes: Managing a robust pipeline of concurrent enterprise deals independently, while partnering with Architect IIIs on specific components of global strategic accounts. You will oversee technical discovery, design full network topologies, and guide Architect Is in building the corresponding lab/PoC environments.
* Risk & Criticality: Moderate-to-High commercial risk. You are independently designing solutions and scoping out automation requirements for significant revenue-generating accounts. Inaccurate scoping, missed requirements during discovery, or flawed architectural designs can lead to delivery delays, margin erosion, or lost competitive bids.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Mid-to-Large Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead for mid-to-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* Automation Scoping & Strategy: Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* Technical Discovery & Whiteboarding: Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* Solution Architecture & Validation: Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Mentorship: Guide the Architect I in understanding the actual customer requirement and solution design
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid-market feature requests.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in the telecom or tech industry, with at least 2-3 years in a customer-facing pre-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.
* Advanced Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of enterprise architectures, including SD-WAN, complex routing/switching (BGP, OSPF), firewalls, VPNs, and legacy telecom transitions.
* Automation Acumen: Strong ability to identify automation scope. You must understand how APIs work (REST/JSON) and how tools like Python, Terraform, or Ansible integrate into a network, even if you are no longer writing the code from scratch every day.
* Cloud Integration: Practical experience designing networks that connect securely to public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding cloud-native networking constructs.
* Presentation Skills: Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid-level technical decision-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Mid-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet-first SD-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

Responsible for analyzing and gathering business and technical requirements to design and document fit-for-purpose solutions. Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. 1d8e4625.description:
**Job Title**
Agentic Solutions Engineer
  
  
**Department**
: Industrial Transformation I CIB IT
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
Within the CIB ITO Industrial Transformation division, our mission is to build the industrial-grade foundation that will make this vision a reality. We are not just building tools; we are building autonomous intelligence that will define the future of Corporate & Institutional Banking.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
As the financial landscape undergoes a paradigm shift, BNP Paribas is positioning itself at the forefront of the next technological revolution. We are embarking on a massive strategic journey to accelerate the deployment of AI Agents across our global operations, with a clear and ambitious vision: to integrate advanced agentic workflows into the core of our business by 2030.
  
  
Within the CIB ITO Industrial Transformation division, our mission is to build the industrial-grade foundation that will make this vision a reality. We are not just building tools; we are building autonomous intelligence that will define the future of Corporate & Institutional Banking.
  
  
As an Agentic Solutions Engineer within the AI Platform team, your mission is to act as a bridge between cutting-edge AI capabilities and business implementation. You will lead the "Agentic Bootstrap" initiative, designed to empower project teams (including Flagship projects) to structure their requirements, define technical solutions, and successfully adopt our agentic frameworks.
  
  
Your goal is to accelerate the transition from conceptual AI ideas to robust, scalable, and production-ready agentic workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Framework Evangelism: Communicate the capabilities, best practices, and roadmap of the Agentic Framework to diverse stakeholders across the CIB.
* Solution Guidance: Provide hands-on technical guidance and support to project teams during the implementation phase, ensuring alignment with AI Platform standards.
* Continuous Evolution: Actively contribute to the evolution of the internal framework by gathering feedback from the field and implementing new features or optimizations.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* LLM Proficiency: Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven Implementation Experience: Demonstrated track record in deploying AI solutions, specifically using tools such as: GenAI frameworks (Google AI SDK, LangGraph)
* Fact MCP, STT
* Arize, Dynatrace
* Docker, Kubernetes
* Architectural Vision: Ability to design complex applications with a focus on scalable and robust AI architecture (Design Application).

**Specific Qualifications**
Approach & Soft Skills:
  
  

* Analytical Thinking: A strong sense of synthesis and the ability to transform complex requirements into simple, actionable technical formalizations.
* Mindset: Curiosity & Continuous Learning: A proactive drive to discover new technologies and stay ahead of the AI curve.
* Adaptability: Willingness to explore uncharted territories and solve unprecedented problems.
* Empathy & Open-mindedness: An ability to listen to user needs and work collaboratively within a global, multi-disciplinary environment.

**Are you our next Agentic Solutions Engineer?**
We are looking for a unique profile that refuses to choose between "hard" and "soft" skills. To succeed in this role, you must possess a rare equilibrium: the technical depth required to architect the future of AI, combined with the interpersonal agility to navigate a complex, rapidly transforming environment.
  
  
If you are a tech enthusiast who thrives on communication, possesses the empathy to guide others through change, and has the vision to build the foundations of 2030, we want to meet you.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential**
**(**
**Required knowledge, skills and abilities):**

* Large Language Models (LLM) expertise
* Generative AI Frameworks
* Agentic Orchestration (LangGraph, etc.)
* Google AI SDK
* Application Design & Architecture
* Technical Formalization (from requirements to solution)

**Behavioral Skills**

* Communication & Impact
* Analytical Synthesis
* Adaptability & Resilience
* Proactive Curiosity
* Empathy & Collaborative Mindset

**Education Level**
Engineering / Equivalent Degree with 8+ years of relevant work Experience.
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore/ Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. Highly technical, hands-on, and execution-focused. The daily focus is on supporting senior architects on massive enterprise deals, managing smaller transactional deals independently, and building technical designs centered around enterprise networking, 5G, and Unified Communications.

High volume of tactical execution. You will manage multiple solution designs, design network and telecom hardware/software, build Bill of Materials (BOMs), draw network topologies, and assist in drafting technical responses for RFPs/RFIs concurrently.

You are the hands-on technical validator for the team. Design failures or inaccurate BOMs can stall the sales cycle and impact margins.

* Basic Tool Automation: Identify opportunities to use basic scripts (e.g., Python, REST APIs) to speed up repetitive lab setups or configuration tasks.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* 2 to 4 years of hands-on technical experience in networking, network engineering, tech support, or a junior pre-sales/systems engineering role.

* Understanding, integrating or building with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) including prompt engineering and tool/function calling.

We are seeking a **Java Technical Architect** who owns the end-to-end architecture of cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS products. You will bring deep hands-on expertise in Java (8 through 17/21), Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven systems and AWS, combined with the judgment to make and defend architectural trade-offs.This is a hands-on architecture role. You will define target architectures, set engineering standards, review critical code, and guide multiple teams and Technical Leads. You will also act as a trusted technical advisor to clients, translating business goals into scalable, secure and cost-effective solutions

**What youll do:Architecture & Solution Design**

+ Define and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise, cloud-native SaaS products, from solution vision to deployment topology.
+ Design multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, tenant-aware security and per-tenant configuration.
+ Decompose domains using Domain Driven Design (DDD) and define microservice boundaries, APIs and data ownership.
+ Design event-driven and reactive systems using Kafka, CQRS, event sourcing and Saga patterns where appropriate.
+ Define non-functional requirements (scalability, availability, performance, security, observability, cost) and design to meet them.
+ Architect AWS solutions using services such as EKS, S3, Cognito, KMS, RDS, SQS/SNS, API Gateway and Lambda.
+ Evaluate options and present multiple architectural approaches with clear trade-offs, then document decisions as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
+ Lead modernization of legacy monoliths to microservices and cloud-native platforms.
+ Research emerging technologies, including AI/ML and GenAI integrations, and build proofs of concept to validate them.

  

**Technical Leadership & Governance**

+ Set coding standards, reference architectures, reusable frameworks and engineering best practices across teams.
+ Review designs and critical code through Git pull requests, ensuring quality, security and performance.
+ Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers, and raise the overall architecture maturity of the team.
+ Define API strategy and standards for REST, gRPC and GraphQL services, including versioning and contracts.
+ Drive security by design: authentication and authorization (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), encryption, secrets management and OWASP compliance.
+ Establish observability standards for logging, metrics, distributed tracing and alerting.
+ Guide CI/CD, DevOps and Infrastructure as Code practices, and own performance and load-testing strategy.
+ Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root-cause analysis for critical incidents.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

+ Engage with clients and stakeholders in pre-sales and discovery to shape solutions, estimates and technical proposals.
+ Conduct requirement, feasibility and impact analysis for new features and change requests.
+ Coordinate architecture and dependencies across onsite, offshore and external teams.
+ Work with product owners and delivery managers to align technical roadmaps with business priorities.
+ Participate in scrum ceremonies and support delivery teams through the full project lifecycle, including warranty support.

  

**Your QualificationsExperience**

+ Bachelors or master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
+ 12–16 years of software development experience in Java, with at least 4 years in an architect or solution architect role.
+ Proven record of architecting and delivering cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS products at enterprise scale.
+ Experience leading multiple teams and Technical Leads across concurrent projects.

  

**Technical Skills**

+ Expert in Java 8 and modern Java (11/17/21), including concurrency, JVM internals and performance tuning.
+ Deep expertise in Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud (Config, Gateway, Discovery), Spring Security and Spring WebFlux.
+ Strong command of microservices architecture, DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, and resilience patterns (circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead).
+ Mastery of design patterns, including GoF, J2EE, enterprise integration and cloud design patterns.
+ Hands-on AWS experience is a must, including EKS, S3, Cognito, KMS, RDS, IAM and networking (VPC). AWS Solutions Architect certification is a strong plus.
+ Proven experience designing multi-tenancy (database-per-tenant, schema-per-tenant and shared-schema models).
+ Strong SQL and data modeling with RDBMS such as PostgreSQL, Oracle and MySQL; experience with NoSQL such as MongoDB, Cassandra or DynamoDB.
+ Experience with caching (Redis, Hazelcast) and search (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).
+ Skilled in ORM and data access with Hibernate, JPA, MyBatis/iBatis and JDBC.
+ Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ or JMS.
+ Proficient in designing and consuming REST, gRPC and GraphQL APIs.
+ Containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes; Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
+ CI/CD with Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI; build tools Maven and Gradle; version control with Git.
+ Testing practices including TDD, JUnit, Mockito, contract testing, and performance testing with JMeter or Gatling.
+ Observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry or Datadog.
+ Working knowledge of application security, OAuth2/OIDC, and compliance needs such as SOC 2, GDPR or HIPAA.
+ Hands on experience with AI Productivity tools such as Chat GPT, Copilot, Gemini, Claude.
+ Experience with Spring AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and implementing observability standards using OpenTelemetry (OTel) for distributed tracing, metrics, and logging in AI-enabled microservices.

**Good to Have**

+ Experience with Azure, GCP or PCF in addition to AWS.
+ Exposure to integrating AI/ML or LLM-based services into enterprise applications.
+ Experience with serverless architectures and cost optimization (FinOps) on cloud.
+ Familiarity with front-end architectures (React or Angular) for full-stack solution design.

  
  

**Behavioral:**

+ Here are five essential behavioral skills a Technical Lead should possess:
+ **Effective Communication:** Clearly and concisely convey ideas, requirements, and feedback to team members, stakeholders, and clients, fostering an environment of open dialogue and mutual understanding.
+ **Leadership and Mentorship**: Inspire and guide the development team, providing support and encouragement, while promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
+ **Problem-Solving Attitude:** Approach challenges with a proactive mindset, quickly identifying issues and developing innovative solutions to overcome obstacles.
+ **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Work well within a team, encouraging collaboration and valuing diverse perspectives to achieve common goals and deliver high-quality results.
+ **Adaptability and Flexibility:** Stay adaptable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, effectively managing changing priorities and requirements while maintaining focus on project objectives.

  

**What you’ll get in return:**Joining Taazaa Tech means thriving in a dynamic, innovative environment with competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. You'll have ample opportunities for professional growth through workshops and certifications, while enjoying a flexible work-life balance with remote options. Our collaborative culture fosters creativity and exposes you to diverse projects across various industries. We offer clear career advancement pathways, comprehensive health benefits, and perks like team-building activities.

**Who we are:**Taazaa Tech is a kaleidoscope of innovation, where every idea is a brushstroke on the canvas of tomorrow. It's a symphony of talent, where creativity dances with technology to orchestrate solutions beyond imagination. In this vibrant ecosystem, challenges are sparks igniting the flames of innovation, propelling us towards new horizons.

**Welcome to Taazaa, where we sculpt the future with passion, purpose, and boundless creativity.**

163eb358.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Technical Consultant — Marketing Cloud Next is a hands-on delivery specialist responsible for
  
  
executing the build, configuration, data migration and testing workstreams within Marketing Cloud Next
  
  
migration waves. Working under the direction of the Technical Architect and Solution Architect, the STC owns
  
  
specific delivery workstreams end-to-end — including Email Studio configuration, Journey Builder
  
  
implementation, subscriber data migration, AMPscript and SSJS development, Data Cloud data stream
  
  
configuration and automated migration validation tooling. The STC also mentors Technical Consultants on the
  
  
wave team, reviewing their work and ensuring factory quality standards are upheld across all MCN
  
  
deliverables.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Execute Marketing Cloud Next platform configuration — building Email Studio sending domains, IP

configurations, Content Builder templates, Automation Studio programs, Journey Builder flows and
  
  
subscriber data extension schemas as specified in the Technical Architect's solution design.
  
  

* Execute subscriber data migration — running the full data migration lifecycle: data profiling,

transformation scripting, data extension population, suppression list loading, consent record migration
  
  
and bulk data load execution using ETL tools and Salesforce Bulk API.
  
  

* Develop AMPscript and SSJS personalisation — writing dynamic content personalisation scripts for

migrated email templates, recreating legacy segmentation logic, lookup functions and conditional content
  
  
rules in MCN native scripting.
  
  

* Configure Salesforce Data Cloud data streams — setting up data stream ingestion from source

systems, configuring DLO schemas, mapping fields to DMOs and validating data completeness per the
  
  
Data Cloud Architect's design.
  
  

* Migrate and rebuild Journey Builder flows — translating legacy marketing automation workflows,

drip campaigns and triggered sends into Journey Builder — recreating entry sources, decision splits, wait
  
  
steps, send activities and exit criteria.
  
  

* Build migration validation and reconciliation tooling — developing Apex batch utilities, LWC

dashboards and Salesforce Flow automations for subscriber count reconciliation, data extension record
  
  
validation and consent flag verification.
  
  

* Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating migration dry runs against SIT/UAT environments,

capturing reconciliation counts, logging validation failures and iterating until dry run success criteria are
  
  
met.
  
  

* Configure sender authentication and deliverability — implementing SPF, DKIM and DMARC DNS

records, private domain configuration, reply mail management and IP warm-up scheduling as directed by
  
  
the TA.
  
  

* Develop and execute unit and system integration tests — writing test scripts for migrated journeys,

data extensions and automations; executing SIT cycles; logging defects; retesting fixes against factory
  
  
quality thresholds.
  
  

* Support go-live cutover execution — following the cutover runbook: executing final subscriber data

loads, activating journeys, validating data extension record counts and confirming suppression lists are
  
  
active.
  
  

* Prepare technical handover documentation — producing configuration workbooks, data mapping

sheets, AMPscript library documentation and journey flow diagrams for client team handover post go-
  
  
live.
  
  

* Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC deliverables for quality, explaining MCN platform

patterns, unblocking technical issues and providing feedback aligned to factory standards.
  
  

* Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating reusable MCN

configuration templates, AMPscript snippet libraries, data migration scripts and validation toolkits in the
  
  
shared accelerator repository.
  
  
**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Marketing Cloud Next — Hands-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Email Studio, Journey

Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder and Contact Builder end-to-end, including sending domain
  
  
configuration, journey entry sources, decision splits and triggered sends.
  
  

* AMPscript & SSJS Development: Proficiency in AMPscript and SSJS for dynamic email personalisation

— lookup functions, conditional content, row sets, attribute rendering and legacy personalisation logic
  
  
recreation.
  
  

* Subscriber Data Migration Execution: Hands-on experience executing subscriber data migrations —

data extension population, bulk data loading via Import Wizard and API, suppression list management,
  
  
consent record migration and reconciliation validation at scale.
  
  

* Salesforce Data Cloud — Configuration: Working knowledge of Data Cloud data stream setup,

DLO/DMO schema configuration, field mapping and data ingestion validation.
  
  

* ETL Tools & Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica Cloud, Talend, Azure

Data Factory, MuleSoft) or scripted Bulk API / REST API approaches for subscriber data extraction,
  
  
transformation and loading.
  
  

* Apex & Platform Development: Ability to write Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, REST callout handlers

and Apex test classes for migration utility development, including subscriber reconciliation tools and
  
  
consent flag verification.
  
  

* Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, subscriber

count trackers and Salesforce Flow automations as internal factory tooling.
  
  

* CI/CD & Source Control: Comfortable working within Salesforce DX and Git-based workflows —

committing changes, following branching conventions, submitting PRs and using Gearset/Copado for
  
  
environment promotion.
  
  
**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**

* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud

Next
  
  

* Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) for cross-channel reporting post-migration
* Experience with WhatsApp, Push, SMS or LINE channel configuration in Marketing Cloud Next
* Familiarity with Marketing Cloud REST and SOAP API for programmatic data operations and triggered

sends
  
  

* Understanding of IP warm-up strategy and email deliverability monitoring tools (250ok, Validity/Return

Path)
  
  

* Exposure to Agentforce journeys triggered from Data Cloud activation segments

**Experience Requirements**

* 5–8 years of Salesforce and marketing technology delivery experience
* 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Marketing Cloud Next configuration experience
* Experience executing at least 1 end-to-end Marketing Cloud migration or large implementation project as

a key delivery contributor
  
  

* Demonstrated hands-on experience with subscriber data migration — bulk loading, data extension setup,

consent migration and reconciliation validation
  
  

* Experience mentoring junior Technical Consultants on MCN configuration and data migration tasks

SALESFORCE & PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS
  
  

* Required: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Email Specialist
* Required: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Administrator
* Required: Salesforce Administrator
* Preferred: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant
* Preferred: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
* Preferred: Salesforce Platform Developer I

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*

**About Team**
Sam’s Club eCommerce is a team of engineers passionate about taking care of our members and associates. The team helps build and maintain the foundational and experiential systems that allow our members to shop online, pick up in store, experience our several service offerings and check out in the club using Scan & Go. This team is geographically distributed but is tight knit and proud of what they do!
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Work with product managers, architects and engineering leaders to define and scope large and complex initiatives.
  
  
You will build Discovery and Execution plans that include coordination of numerous cross-functional teams
  
  
You will lead multiple teams of engineers to deliver cross-functional initiatives
  
  
You will identify, track and manage risks and issues that threaten project or program success
  
  
You will communicate to team members, peers and leadership in a way that supports effective program execution
  
  
You will work with your team of peer TPMs to drive consistency and improvement in technical program execution. This includes standardization of practices and tooling where it makes sense.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with engineering management and stakeholders, including senior leadership, business partners, and external vendors.
  
  
Stay current with industry trends and advancements, incorporating new technologies and methodologies into project management practices.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
A deep experience in software engineering and technical program management. The candidate should have 10+ years of experience as a technical program manager leading large and cross-functional initiatives. This is a role where one can bring their wealth of experience and grow as a leader!
  
  
The candidate should have previous experience as a systems or software engineer. They are not expected to write software but should be able to contribute to design and architecture discussions based on previous experience.
  
  
The candidate should have experience in eCommerce industry, ideally retail eCommerce. This will help the candidate understand the technical and functional landscape so they can effectively manage across the numerous teams required to bring an eCommerce shopping experience to life.
  
  
The candidate should be a skilled communicator. This role requires an extremely effective communicator who can work with team members, peers and leaders.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable communicating with senior leadership up to and including VP or SVP. They should be able to adjust their communication style for the audience.
  
  
The candidate should have several years of experience using Jira and Confluence to manage and track program execution.
  
  
Lastly, the candidate should have a very high level of integrity and respect for the individual. These are key attributes that define how we do all of our work.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer

We are seeking an experienced
**Presales Architect - Applications**
with deep expertise in
**enterprise data architecture and on-premises data platforms**
to support complex sales engagements.
  
  
This role focuses on designing
**scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions within traditional enterprise environments**
, enabling organizations to modernize legacy systems, improve data governance, and enhance analytics capabilities.
  
  
You will partner with sales, delivery, and customer stakeholders to shape data strategies, build compelling proposals, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture & Design
* Lead discovery sessions to assess existing enterprise data ecosystems, legacy platforms, and business requirements
* Design end-to-end data architectures including:

+ Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW)
+ Operational Data Stores (ODS)
+ Data marts and reporting systems
+ Batch and near real-time data integration

+ Relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, etc.)
+ ETL and data integration tools
+ Storage, archival, and lifecycle management systems

+ Hardware (servers, storage, networking)
+ Software licensing (databases, ETL, BI tools)
+ Data processing and integration workloads
+ Ongoing operations and support

* Build bottom-up estimates using:

+ Data volumes and growth projections
+ Workload and performance requirements

* Conduct ROI and TCO analysis for:

+ Legacy modernization initiatives
+ Platform consolidation and optimization

* Compare alternative architecture approaches (e.g., centralized vs distributed data platforms)
* Validate cost assumptions with delivery and finance teams

* Develop comprehensive proposals including:

+ Data architecture diagrams
+ Data flow and integration patterns
+ Implementation roadmaps and migration plans
+ Resource planning and timelines
+ Risk mitigation strategies and governance models

* Clearly articulate business value including:

+ Improved data quality and reliability
+ Faster reporting and analytics
+ Operational efficiency and cost savings

+ Accelerate documentation
+ Improve clarity and structure of proposals
+ Synthesize complex requirements

* Define strategies for:

+ Legacy data warehouse modernization
+ Data platform consolidation
+ ETL optimization and re-engineering
+ Data archival and lifecycle management

+ Replatforming to modern database systems
+ Data model redesign (dimensional, normalized, data vault)

* Enable capabilities for:

+ Near real-time data availability
+ Improved reporting performance
+ Better data accessibility

* Data Governance, Quality & Security
* Design and implement frameworks for:

+ Data governance and stewardship
+ Data quality management
+ Metadata management and lineage

* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards:

+ Role-based access control
+ Data masking and encryption
+ Regulatory compliance requirements

* Develop transition documents and implementation playbooks
* Support project kickoffs and early delivery alignment
* Define SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics

Capture feedback to improve solution quality and reusability
  
  
**You will be successful in this role if you have:**
BA/BS degree and 10+ years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience
  
  
Master’s degree preferred.
  
  
**Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or presales consulting
* Minimum 5 years focused on enterprise data platforms in on-premises environments
* Proven track record in:

+ Designing enterprise data solutions
+ Supporting and influencing large deals
+ Building cost models and ROI justifications

* Experience in RFP responses and technical proposal development

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong experience with enterprise database platforms:

+ Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, or similar

* Deep understanding of:

+ Data warehousing concepts (EDW, ODS, data marts)
+ Data modeling techniques (dimensional, normalized, data vault)

* Hands-on experience with:

+ ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, DataStage, SSIS, etc.)
+ Batch and near real-time data integration

* Knowledge of:

+ Data governance, metadata, and data quality tools
+ Performance tuning and query optimization

* Experience with:

+ High availability, backup, and disaster recovery strategies

* Familiarity with BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, etc.)
* Proficiency in using GenAI tools for presales productivity and documentation

**Business & Soft Skills**

* Strong ability to translate data architecture into business value
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Consultative approach to discovery and problem-solving
* Ability to manage multiple presales opportunities
* Strong collaboration across cross-functional teams
* Financial acumen in cost modeling and ROI analysis

**Certifications & Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience in system integrators or managed services environments
* Familiarity with MPP or appliance-based data systems (e.g., Teradata, Netezza)
