9c4d910c.description:
**Meet the Team**
Splunk is growing its Global Partner Technical team and is looking for a Global Partner Solution Engineer (Partner SE) to help develop, improve, and scale the productivity and capabilities of our Global Solution Integrator (GSI) partner ecosystem across industries and business segments. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of Cisco and Splunk technology, partners, and customers—creating scalable solutions, enabling partner-led growth, and building trusted technical relationships that drive business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Global Partner Solution Engineer, you will be a strategic technical advisor to partners, customers, and internal sales teams. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help GSIs create new solutions and services, accelerate opportunities, expand within existing accounts, and differentiate Cisco and Splunk from the competition.
  
  

* Develop multi-year strategic plans with GSIs, integrating Cisco and Splunk technologies into differentiated solutions and service offerings.
* Lead technical engagements including executive discussions, customer workshops, demonstrations, whiteboarding sessions, and solution design activities.
* Build and mature partner technical practices and Centers of Excellence (CoEs), including enablement, certification, and activation of partner resources.
* Drive partner-led demand generation by identifying new opportunities, developing solution frameworks, and enabling cross-sell, up-sell, and competitive displacement strategies.
* Collaborate with account teams, Business Entities, product teams, and extended sales organizations to influence deal strategy, provide competitive intelligence, and translate customer and partner needs into technical requirements.
* Create scalable technical assets, demos, webinars, and other enablement content that help partners develop and deliver new solutions.
* Lead virtual technical teams through complex sales cycles, mobilizing the right resources to progress and close strategic opportunities.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer and partner stakeholders, shaping technology strategies and demonstrating the business value of Cisco and Splunk solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related experience, Master’s degree with 6+ years of related experience, or PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a technical sales, solutions engineering, consulting, partner engineering, or related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience designing and presenting technical solutions to customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience working across complex technology environments and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Ability to travel up to 40%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cloud, ITOps/Observability, Security, Big Data, Edge, IoT, IIoT, or closely related domains.
* Hands-on expertise in two or more technologies including Splunk SIEM/SOAR/Platform, Cisco XDR, Talos, ThousandEyes, Meraki, Splunk Observability Cloud, AppDynamics, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Native Technologies, or Microservices Architectures.
* Experience building or maturing a technical practice, partner capability, or Center of Excellence focused on developing and scaling service offerings.
* Proven experience delivering technical workshops, webinars, demonstrations, or presentations at external industry events.
* Strong communication, presentation, influencing, and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage technical and executive stakeholders across partner and customer organizations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. 122362d5.title: Advisory Customer Solution Consultant
122362d5.description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
At Confluent, we live by a core value: Earn Our Customers' Love. As a Customer Solutions Consultant (CSC), you'll be a vital partner to our customers, empowering them to unlock the full value of their investment in our cutting-edge streaming data platform.
  
  
In this dynamic role, you'll manage a diverse portfolio of customers, from Mid-Market to Enterprise and Strategic accounts. You'll work hand-in-hand with teams across Customer Solutions, Sales, Product, and Engineering, driving activities that ensure technical health, product adoption, and demonstrable value realization. Your efforts will be critical in fostering customer growth and retention.
  
  
This position is perfect for individuals who are passionate about technology, eager to solve complex business problems, and possess a strong customer-centric mindset. You'll deepen your technical expertise in Kafka, Flink, and Confluent IP, while leveraging your customer-facing skills in a high-growth environment. You'll collaborate with some of the world's most renowned companies, helping them achieve mission-critical outcomes. We're looking for curious, motivated professionals ready to accelerate their development and make a significant impact from day one.
  
  

* Serve as a Trusted Technical Advisor: Build strong relationships with customers, becoming their go-to technical expert across your diverse portfolio. Proactively support customers through the technical lifecycle, including architecture planning, cluster and security design, monitoring, and automation.
* Lead Post-Sale Engagements: Act as a primary technical contact post-sale, coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful outcomes. Guide customers in maturing their data streaming utilization and optimizing their usage through regular technical health reviews. Introduce new product capabilities via roadmap review sessions and plan for their adoption.
* Drive Customer Success: Collaborate with support engineers to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and provide actionable insights for customers to take corrective action. Pinpoint technical objections and strategize to overcome adoption blockers. Identify potential risks and execute mitigation plans with internal stakeholders to prevent customer churn.
* Develop Deep Technical Expertise: Cultivate an in-depth understanding of Confluent's technologies and the intricacies of building streaming applications to resolve complex customer challenges.

**Preferred Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Experience & Technical Aptitude: 5-12 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Software Development, Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Cloud Architecture, or similar roles. You'll have a passion for solving complex technical problems with a strong understanding of modern infrastructure and streaming technologies, thriving as a self-starter in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional Communication: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to concisely explain complex issues and solutions to a variety of technical and non-technical personas.
* Customer Portfolio Management: Demonstrated ability to manage a large customer portfolio, paying strict attention to detail and delivering results across multiple initiatives like driving expansion, customer satisfaction, feature adoption, and retention.
* Cloud & Networking Expertise: Experience with cloud and on-premises architectures, along with a solid understanding of cloud networking and security technologies (e.g., VPC, Private Link, Private Service Connect, TLS/SSL, SASL, Kerberos).
* Distributed Systems Knowledge: Experience with distributed systems and infrastructure software such as databases, message queues, Kubernetes, serverless technologies, and/or Big Data products, including developing ETL applications.
* Development & Automation: Experience with software development tools, configuration management, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD tooling (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) is a plus.
* Programming Flexibility: Development language agnostic, with proficiency in Java, Python, or SQL.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: A strong customer-centric approach, understanding the customer journey framework and the ability to prescribe ideal outcomes, guiding customers along their path to success.
* Project Management Skills: Proven project management experience for effective internal stakeholder management, coordinating with various teams to ensure overall account success.

**JOB** **ROLE**

  

Lead Engineer - Integrated Smart Home Solutions

  

**REPORTING** **TO**

  

Vertical Head- Software & Hardware Engineering

  

**TYPE** **OF** **ROLE**

  

Individual Contributor Role

**LOCATION**

  

ABSQ, Navi Mumbai

**JOB** **PURPOSE:**

Smart home solution development / ecosystem development: Lead the development of an integrated Smart Home solution in collaboration with ecosystem partners, bringing video doorbells/video door phones, smart locks and smart switches together through a unified connected platform and mobile application. Define seamless user journeys, voice-assistant integration and application use cases to deliver a secure, reliable, interoperable and intuitive smart-home experience.

**KEY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the end-to-end smart-home solution architecture and product roadmap, working with ecosystem partners, device OEMs, platform providers and internal R&D teams to define a unified user experience.
* Identify and translate customer needs into application use cases, user journeys, product requirements, functional specifications, system workflows and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Lead integration of video doorbells/video door phones, smart locks, smart switches and other compatible smart-home devices with the connected platform and mobile application.
* Define and deliver use cases such as visitor notification and two-way communication, remote door unlocking, access permissions, event history, lighting control, scenes, schedules, automation rules and device-status notifications, subject to device capabilities and safety requirements.
* Drive mobile application requirements and integration, including device onboarding and pairing, home/room/device management, user and family access, notifications, settings, firmware status and troubleshooting journeys.
* Integrate voice assistants and voice-based control, including supported commands, device discovery, scene activation and status feedback; coordinate compatibility and certification with the selected ecosystem partners.
* Define interoperability and integration requirements across devices, cloud services and mobile applications, including APIs, SDKs, webhooks and relevant connectivity/protocol options such as Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee, Matter, MQTT and REST APIs, as applicable to the selected architecture.
* Evaluate and manage ecosystem partners for devices, mobile apps, cloud platforms, voice assistants and integration services; assess technical capability, security, product maturity, commercial fit, roadmap alignment and long-term support.
* Own system-level integration plans, interface specifications, data models, device capability mapping, partner dependencies, release compatibility and end-to-end acceptance criteria.
* Ensure privacy and security by design for video, access-control and home-user data, including authentication, role-based permissions, encryption, secure device onboarding, consent-aware data handling, audit trails, vulnerability management and secure update processes.
* Coordinate integration and validation across device firmware, cloud/platform services, mobile applications and voice ecosystems; lead end-to-end testing, interoperability testing, regression testing, field trials, UAT and defect closure.
* Define reliability and serviceability requirements, including offline behaviour, connectivity recovery, device health, remote diagnostics, incident handling, firmware/software version compatibility and customer support workflows.
* Drive partner and internal teams through design reviews, proof-of-concepts, integration milestones, release readiness and post-launch improvements; manage technical risks, dependencies and issue resolution.
* Work closely with product management, design, firmware, software, cybersecurity, quality, sourcing, marketing, sales and service teams to deliver a market-ready solution within agreed scope, quality, cost and schedule.
* Maintain solution architecture, API/interface documents, use-case catalogues, test plans, integration guides, release notes and operational/support documentation.
* Monitor customer feedback, product usage and ecosystem developments to prioritise enhancements, expand compatible devices and continuously improve the smart-home experience.

**EDUCATIONAL** **QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Bachelors degree in Electronics / Electrical / Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* • A postgraduate qualification in embedded systems, IoT, software engineering or product development is an advantage.

**WORK** **EXPERIENCE**

  

* • 1012 years of relevant experience in IoT, connected consumer products, smart-home solutions, embedded/software integration or digital product engineering.
* • Demonstrated experience delivering an integrated connected product or platform involving multiple devices, mobile applications and external technology partners.
* • Experience taking solutions from requirements and proof-of-concept through integration, validation, launch and post-launch support.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

  

* Relevant certifications in IoT, cloud platforms, mobile/application integration, cybersecurity or smart-home interoperability standards are desirable.

**PREFERRED/** **ADDITIONAL** **REQUIREMENT**

  

* • Strong understanding of IoT architectures, connected platforms, mobile applications, APIs/SDKs and device-to-cloud integration.
* • Hands-on or technical leadership experience integrating video doorbells/video door phones, smart locks and smart switches.
* • Familiarity with voice assistant ecosystems and smart-home interoperability technologies such as Matter, Zigbee, Wi-Fi and BLE; experience will depend on the selected product architecture.
* • Understanding of device firmware, cloud services, mobile app release cycles, OTA updates, identity/access management and product lifecycle management.
* • Knowledge of cybersecurity and privacy practices, particularly for video devices and physical access-control products.
* • Experience in partner evaluation, technical negotiations, joint development, integration governance and vendor performance management.
* • Strong system-level troubleshooting, stakeholder management, technical documentation and cross-functional delivery skills.
* • Experience launching consumer smart-home products at scale and supporting customer-facing applications is preferred.

**INTERNAL** **/** **EXTERNAL** **INTERFACE**

  

* Internal: R&D, Electronics, Firmware, Software, IoT/Cloud, Mobile App, Cybersecurity, Quality & Validation, Product Management, Sourcing, Marketing, Sales and Service.
* External: Smart lock, video doorbell/video door phone and smart switch OEMs; smart-home platform providers; mobile app and cloud partners; voice assistant ecosystem providers; connectivity/chipset partners; certification and testing agencies.

**FUNCTIONAL** **COMPETENCIES**

  

* Smart-home solution architecture and systems integration
* Application use-case definition and customer journey design
* IoT connected platform and mobile application integration
* Voice assistant and ecosystem partner integration
* Device interoperability, API/SDK integration and protocol awareness
* Security, privacy, reliability and end-to-end validation
* Partner management, technical governance and product delivery
* Root-cause analysis, documentation and cross-functional leadership

The Senior Consultant, FinOps Strategy, Governance & Value Realization is a senior individual contributor role responsible for advancing TransUnion’s cloud and AI economics, infrastructure cost transparency, capacity planning, and value realization capabilities
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
are the main areas of ownership for the role. For this role, I’d summarize them as:
  
  

* Cloud /AI infrastructure Cost Reporting: Own trusted reporting for cloud, AI, and on-prem infrastructure spend across leadership levels.
* Capacity Planning & Utilization Analysis: Consolidate demand signals, analyze usage trends, and support forward-looking capacity decisions.

* Cross-Functional Influence: Partner with engineering, finance, and business stakeholders to drive decisions, accountability, and cost ownership.

* Experience in cloud financial management, infrastructure capacity planning, IT finance, enterprise reporting, or a closely related analytical discipline.
* Advanced understanding of cloud and business capacity planning, with a strong track record in performance analysis and executive-level reporting.
* Advanced knowledge of public cloud platforms — GCP and/or AWS — including savings plans, committed-use discounts, reservations, tagging strategies, and resource lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in Google BigQuery for querying, modeling, and analyzing cloud cost and usage datasets at scale.
* Deep, hands-on understanding of enterprise infrastructure including server, storage, network, virtualization (VMware), database, middleware, and common operating systems.
* Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and executive communication; hands-on experience with cloud cost tooling such as Harness CCM strongly preferred.
* Experience building and owning capacity utilization reporting across storage, server, VMware, database, and network infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and interpret usage statistics, develop forward-looking capacity projections, and validate assumptions with stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work independently and lead complex analytical workstreams in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities.
* Strong influencing and communication skills — able to translate complex infrastructure and cost data into clear recommendations and executive narratives.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior analysts or consultants.
* The ability to socialize ideas, build cross-functional consensus, and drive decisions in a matrixed or federated organization.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* FinOps Foundation certification (FOCP or equivalent) or equivalent demonstrated expertise in FinOps operating models.
* Scripting or automation skills — VBA, PowerShell, SQL, or Python — with a track record of building reporting automation that reduces manual effort.
* Experience with Splunk or similar observability/analytics platforms for infrastructure performance analysis.
* Experience integrating cloud /AI economics data into enterprise financial planning workflows including forecasting, budgeting, chargeback/showback, and savings recognition.
* Experience designing or operating within a federated or matrixed technology organization across cloud engineering, product engineering, and finance functions.
* Familiarity with JIRA, ServiceNow/Remedy, or similar workflow systems for optimization tracking and work-item routing.
* Experience with AI/ML or GPU infrastructure economics and governance.
* Background in cloud cost automation, anomaly detection, or agent-based FinOps tooling

ef8a5594.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
ef8a5594.description:
**Description**
Ready to do something big?
  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission-critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store, and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?
  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for worldwide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, leveraging our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces.
  
  
In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.
  
  
What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?
  
  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb\_kp4&t=2s
  
  
The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team
  
  
https://vimeo.com/80948105
  
  
Third-party sellers have become one of Amazon's greatest growth engines, outpacing our own first-party retail business for years. That success did not happen by accident. We invested in building the best possible selling tools — from inventory management and payment processing to shipment tracking, reporting, and cross-border commerce — and we continue to invent new ones every year. FBA and the Prime membership program sit at the heart of that effort, dramatically improving the customer experience of buying from independent sellers and unlocking growth for businesses of every size.
  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager with FBA, you will lead broad cross-organization efforts from the early stages through release. You will work closely with product managers, engineering managers, scientists, and engineers to build the next generation of seller platforms. You will be responsible for influencing the organization's product and technical roadmap and technical architecture. You will drive organization-wide engineering and operational excellence initiatives, represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to senior leaders, and leverage your technical knowledge to guide technical choices. You will manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs are aligned, guiding technical direction to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead broad, cross-organizational programs from strategy definition through delivery, owning the technology roadmap for seller-facing platforms and driving alignment across product, engineering, and science teams.
* Define and decompose complex technical problems into clear solutions, assessing risk, driving clarity, and creating the right sense of urgency to keep programs on track.
* Influence the organization's product and technical architecture by applying deep system knowledge, identifying gaps across services and workflows, and proposing improvements that reduce repeated effort year over year.
* Partner with senior leadership to communicate trade-offs, present options, and drive decisions — managing cross-functional stakeholder alignment and escalating with strong judgment when necessary.
* Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, driving adoption of program management best practices, and contributing to the broader technical community.

A day in the life
  
  
Your primary focus will be guiding large-scale, cross-team programs that directly shape how millions of sellers interact with Amazon's fulfillment network. You will spend your time working across product managers, engineering leaders, and scientists — aligning priorities, unblocking technical decisions, and ensuring delivery stays on course. Expect a mix of deep technical design reviews, strategic roadmap discussions with senior leaders, and hands-on problem solving when programs hit ambiguity.
  
  
**About The Team**
The FBA team builds and operates the platforms that enable sellers in 135 countries to store, ship, and manage billions of products through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our mission is straightforward: make sellers successful so customers get the selection and value they expect. We are investing in the next generation of seller tools and infrastructure, and this role will be central to shaping that future. If you want to work on programs that operate at massive scale and have a direct impact on both sellers and customers worldwide, this is the team for you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

* Design, build and automate the provisioning of foundational infrastructure resources through the portal’s services, integrations and workflows, using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting services and workflows for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Why is this level of Education Required?**

* Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion.

**Related Experience Required**

* Typically 8-10 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with TypeScript (ES6+) and Node.js server-side development.
* Developed REST and GraphQL APIs based on Node.js (Express).

* Designing and automating long-running, multi-step processes (retries, timeouts, compensation, human approval steps) using a workflow orchestration or durable-execution approach.
* Working knowledge of landing zones and serverless technologies across Azure and GCP.
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Building and deploying through CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) with Docker, and operating services on Microsoft Azure (App Service, Application Insights).
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

* Good knowledge and hands on experience with React, NextJS, GraphQL, Yoga, Prisma ORM, and Apollo Client. Previous experience in developing a React UIs with Mantine, Material UI, or Chakra UI. Familiar with popular patterns and libraries such as React Hooks, and server-state management (Apollo Client, TanStack Query). Previously developed schema-based forms either custom or based on a library such as react-hook-form or Formik, including data validator libraries such as Yup, Zod or JOI. Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth v2 or SAML and JSON Web Token and libraries such as MSAL.
* Strong experience with test automation (unit & integration) tools such as Jest and Cypress.

**Desirable:**

* Previously worked in a central IT team within a regulated environment such as the Pharmaceutical or Finance industry, including knowledge of GxP, validation and audit readiness.
* undefined

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

b1aebbaf.title: Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer (L3)
b1aebbaf.description:
**Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer (L3)**  
JOB DESCRIPTION | SECURITY L3 | Technical Service Delivery & Engineering | Hyderabad Service Delivery Center  
**Company:** Palmiq  
**Palmiq Role:** Senior IT Support Specialist - Security Operations Center (L3)  
**Department:** Technical Service Delivery & Engineering  
**Reporting To:** Service Delivery Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Role Category:** Engineering  
**Industry Type:** Emerging Technologies (SOC, Compliance & Cloud)  
**Experience:** 4-6 Years (Min. 3+ yrs hands-on Cloud Security, M365/Purview & Compliance)  
**Compensation:** INR 10 LPA - INR 16 LPA (commensurate with L3 experience)  
**Location:** Hyderabad, India (Remote initially; in-person at HYD office next year)  
**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
Palmiq is seeking a hands-on **Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer (L3)** to serve as the senior technical escalation point across our managed enterprise clients. This role sits at the intersection of **Microsoft 365 & AI Data Governance (Purview/Copilot), Regulatory Compliance (CMMC/HIPAA/NIST/CIS), Identity & Endpoint Security, SecOps (SIEM/XDR), Network Security (Fortinet), and Cloud Migrations**. You will lead complex client security remediations and incident response, mentor L1/L2 engineers, and partner with Service Delivery leadership on technical scoping, Statements of Work (SOWs), security architecture reviews, and executive reporting.  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**1. Data Security, Microsoft Purview & AI Governance**

* Design, deploy, optimize, and troubleshoot **Microsoft Purview** policies, including custom Sensitivity Labels, Auto-Labeling policies (using sensitive information types/identifier formats), **Data Loss Prevention (DLP)**, and **Insider Risk Management**.
* Implement and enforce **data protection lifecycle controls**, including encryption in-transit and at-rest, data retention policies, legal holds, and purge workflows.
* Lead **Microsoft 365 Copilot security and readiness** engagements - disabling external web search where required, blocking Copilot from summarizing labeled sensitive files or accepting restricted prompts, and validating audit logging and retention.
* Audit and remediate **SharePoint and Teams oversharing** by removing company-wide/"everyone" access and enforcing strict named-user sharing defaults.

**2. GRC & Regulatory Compliance (CMMC, HIPAA, NIST & CIS)**

* Execute technical remediation activities aligned with **CMMC, HIPAA, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls** across regulated client environments.
* Establish repeatable compliance procedures, perform quality assurance (QA) checks, conduct **periodic access reviews**, re-run readiness assessments, and compile audit-ready compliance evidence packs for client handover.

**3. Identity, Endpoint Security & SecOps**

* Enforce **IAM/RBAC**, least-privilege access, **Privileged Access Management (PAM)**, and **Zero Trust principles** across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (hybrid identity) environments.
* Manage and enforce device security baselines via **Microsoft Intune** and **Entra ID Conditional Access** - ensuring corporate devices are enrolled, encrypted, and compliant while restricting unmanaged/personal devices to browser-only access with no downloads.
* Drive continuous **Vulnerability Assessment & Management (VAM)**, structured patch cadence, endpoint/infrastructure security hardening, and **SIEM/XDR operations** (including audit log integrity, threat triage, and KQL-based investigations).
* Build and maintain security automation scripts and workflows using **PowerShell** (and optionally Python or Logic Apps) to streamline bulk M365, Intune, and Purview remediations.

**4. Network Security & Firewall Administration**

* Administer, configure, and troubleshoot **Fortinet (FortiGate) firewalls** and enterprise/cloud network security controls for managed and regulated clients.
* Lead cross-client firewall patching to established quality standards and manage **wireless access point (WAP) certificate updates**.

**5. Cloud Migrations & Workspace Hardening**

* Execute end-to-end **Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace** mailbox and file migrations, including post-migration validation, final delta synchronization, and confirmation of data accessibility and completeness.
* Perform **Google Workspace security hardening**, including configuring Organizational Units (OUs), access controls, MFA enforcement, security alerts, and Gmail security protections.

**6. L3 Escalation, Incident Response, ITSM & Technical Project Delivery**

* Serve as the senior **L3 escalation and de-escalation point** across all clients, including structured on-call support for L1/L2 teams.
* Lead major security incidents (containment, eradication, and recovery), develop **incident response playbooks**, and support client tabletop drills.
* Drive **ITIL v4 Change Enablement** (ensuring rollback plans before critical changes and acting as change manager where required) and **Problem Management** (leading Post-Incident Reviews, Root Cause Analysis, and Knowledge Base linking).
* Mentor and train L1/L2 engineers on firewall standards, security best practices, and compliance execution.
* Partner with Service Delivery leadership to conduct initial client assessments, perform security architecture reviews, author technical **Statements of Work (SOWs)**, and deliver structured end-of-project reports and executive dashboards for senior leadership.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. in Any Specialization (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, or a related technical field preferred).
* **Domain Experience:** 4-6 years of overall IT/cybersecurity experience, with at least 3+ years of hands-on Cloud Security, M365/Purview, and Compliance delivery (multi-client MSP or enterprise consulting experience strongly valued).
* **Compliance & GRC:** Practical working knowledge of CMMC, HIPAA, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls, including technical remediation, periodic access reviews, and audit evidence gathering.
* **Cloud & Migrations:** Proven experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration, security hardening, and cross-platform migrations.
* **Consulting & Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to conduct security architecture reviews, author technical SOWs, produce executive reports, and de-escalate high-priority client issues.

**EXPECTED EXPERTISE (TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES)**  
**Required Expertise - Core Operational Stack**

* **Microsoft 365, Data & Endpoint Governance:** Deep hands-on expertise in **Microsoft Purview** (Sensitivity Labels, Auto-Labeling, DLP, Insider Risk, Retention/Legal Hold), **Microsoft Intune**, **Entra ID Conditional Access**, Active Directory/Entra ID hybrid identity, SharePoint/Teams permissions, and M365 Copilot governance.
* **SIEM & Querying:** Hands-on proficiency operating and investigating security events across **Microsoft Sentinel** and enterprise **SIEM platforms (Splunk / ELK)**, including writing **Kusto Query Language (KQL)** queries for log correlation, alert tuning, and threat hunting.
* **EDR / XDR:** Operational expertise in **EDR / XDR** platforms - specifically **Microsoft Defender XDR** - for endpoint and cloud threat triage, containment, and root cause analysis.
* **Privileged Access Management (PAM):** Practical experience implementing and governing **PAM** controls (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID PIM, CyberArk, or equivalent) alongside IAM/RBAC and Zero Trust enforcement.
* **Vulnerability Assessment & Management (VAM):** End-to-end **VAM** execution, covering continuous vulnerability discovery, prioritization, structured patching, and remediation verification.
* **Firewalls & Perimeter Security:** Proven hands-on experience managing **Firewalls** - specifically **Fortinet (FortiGate)** - covering VPNs, policy management, firmware patching, and certificate administration.
* **Automation:** Working proficiency in **PowerShell** scripting (with exposure to Python or Azure Logic Apps) to automate M365, Intune, Purview, and SecOps tasks.

**Preferred Expertise - Good-to-Have / Expanding Client Scope**

* **Edge, Application & Traffic Security:** Working knowledge of **Web Application Firewalls (WAF)**, **DDoS** protection controls, and **Load Balancers (LB)** across enterprise and cloud environments.
* **Secrets Management & Zero-Trust Access:** Exposure to secrets and encryption lifecycle tooling including **Vault, KMS, and HSM**, as well as Zero-Trust privileged access platforms such as **HashiCorp Boundary** (or equivalent).
* **Container & Policy-as-Code Security:** Familiarity with container **image scanners (Trivy / Clair)** and Kubernetes policy enforcement using **OPA / Gatekeeper**.

**CERTIFICATIONS**  
**Preferred Certifications (One or More Strongly Preferred)**

* Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (**SC-401**, formerly SC-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (**SC-300**) or Azure Security Engineer Associate (**AZ-500**)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (**SC-200**)
* **Fortinet NSE 4** (FortiOS Administrator) or equivalent network security certification

cdaa965c.description:
**Job Purpose:**

This role is responsible to lead portfolio-wide execution and governance across strategic product and technology programs. The role provides a single senior orchestration point across Business, Product, Engineering, QA, Production Support, Cloud / Infrastructure, InfoSec, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and partners. The incumbent must combine strong subject command with executive presence, structured problem solving and the authority to challenge commitments, resolve cross-functional conflicts and drive timely decisions.

  

**Key Responsiblities:**

  

**a) Portfolio strategy translation:** Convert approved business and product priorities into an integrated execution plan, with outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, investment needs and accountable owners.

  

**b) Executive stakeholder management:** Build trusted relationships with senior Business and Technology leaders. Frame issues clearly, align divergent viewpoints, secure decisions and maintain confidence through fact-based, proactive communication and tracking with proper timelines and RCAs as applicable.

  

**c) Integrated planning and prioritization:** Lead, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and rolling planning across product pillars. Reconcile capacity, regulatory commitments, business-critical dates, technical dependencies and vendor plans; expose trade-offs for leadership decision.

  

**d) Governance and decision architecture:** Design and chair reviews, SteerCos and escalation forums. Ensure each forum has a clear purpose, accurate inputs, decision rights, actions, owners and closure discipline.

  

**e) Delivery assurance:** Independently assess programme health beyond reported RAG status. Validate critical path, milestones, resource assumptions, quality gates, readiness and benefits dependencies.

  

**f) Cross-programme dependency management:** Identify shared services, platform, data, API, security, infrastructure and partner dependencies; assign ownership and resolve sequencing conflicts before they affect delivery.

  

**g) Risk, issue and escalation management:** Maintain an executive RAID view, drive mitigation and trigger escalation at the right point. Distinguish decisions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies; prevent silent slippage.

  

**h) Commercial and vendor governance:** Govern delivery obligations, milestones, resource commitments, change requests, SLA performance, commercials and escalations for implementation and managed-service partners.

  

**i) Financial governance:** Track approved business cases, programme budgets, forecasts, purchase dependencies, change costs and benefit assumptions in partnership with Finance and procurement owners.

  

**j) Release and operational governance:** Ensure major releases have business, QA, Engineering, security, infrastructure, support and rollback readiness. Review recurring incidents, RCA closure and stability actions without taking over functional ownership.

  

**k) Regulatory and audit readiness:** Ensure traceability of mandatory commitments, approvals, evidence, controls, risks and closure for regulatory, compliance and audit programmes.

  

**l) Capability and standards:** Establish consistent planning, status reporting, RAID, dependency, release-readiness and decision-log standards. Coach Program Managers to become outcome-led leaders rather than coordinators.

  

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Programme / project certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum or equivalent is desirable, but demonstrated delivery leadership is more important than certification alone.
* Proven leadership of multiple, concurrent, high-complexity programmes involving business, product, engineering, operations and external partners.
* Strong understanding of lending journeys and lifecycle, including acquisition, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, collections, customer channels and partner integrations.
* Working command of agile, hybrid and milestone-based delivery; ability to challenge plans, dependencies, solution assumptions and release readiness.
* Experience with executive governance, programme financials, vendor contracts, implementation partners, risk management and organisational change.
* Ability to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, environments, security, cloud / infrastructure and production support sufficiently to ask the right questions and drive accountable closure.
* Experience in regulated financial services is strongly preferred.

**Please find below Job Description:**

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned Generative AI Architect with a strong foundation in enterprise and system architecture, combined with significant depth and breadth in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI application development. This is a senior cross-cutting role responsible for architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation of Industry AI Solutions (IAIS) across multiple teams.

The Generative AI Architect will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions within their assigned teams, working alongside embedded GenAI Developers (who report to this architect for technical direction), traditional software engineers, and business stakeholders. The architect bridges the worlds of robust enterprise system design and cutting-edge AI capabilities translating business goals into scalable, secure, production-ready GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cross-team Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Architect and own the end-to-end Solution Design, working alongside a System Architect or alone for an Industry AI Solution Team, ensuring architectural consistency, pattern reuse, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Serve as the primary technical authority for GenAI and Agentic AI architecture decisions within assigned teams, providing direction to embedded GenAI Developers and guiding their implementation work.
* Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for GenAI and Agentic AI development across teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, proof-of-concept evaluations, and technical design discussions for AI features and components.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Solution Design**

* Design scalable, production-grade GenAI application architectures including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Agentic Workflows, LLM integration layers, prompt management systems, and response evaluation frameworks.
* Architect multi-agent systems and Agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration patterns, tool use, memory management, long-horizon task execution, and human-in-the-loop designs.
* Select and evaluate appropriate LLMs, embedding models, and AI frameworks (commercial and open-source) based on performance, cost, latency, and compliance requirements.
* Define LLM fine-tuning and adaptation strategies (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA, prompt tuning) where required, overseeing implementation by the developer team.
* Design LLMOps and AI observability pipelines including evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and feedback loops for deployed AI systems.

**Enterprise System Architecture**

* Apply deep system architecture expertise to ensure GenAI solutions integrate seamlessly into existing enterprise platforms including CRM, ERP, workflow automation tools, and analytics systems.
* Design robust, secure API layers, microservices, and event-driven integration patterns that connect AI components with enterprise backends.
* Ensure AI architectures meet enterprise non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, latency, security, and disaster recovery.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication**

**Mandatory Qualifications & Skills**

**Architecture & Engineering Foundation**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect (5+ years), with a track record of designing large-scale, production enterprise systems.
* Strong command of system design principles: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, cloud-native patterns.
* Experience architecting across cloud platforms, with strong preference for Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure API Management).

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Expertise**

* Deep hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI application development including RAG architecture, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and chain-of-thought design.
* Proven experience architecting Agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, and LLMOps practices including tracing tools, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring.

**Responsible AI & Governance**

**Communication & Leadership**

b6357e82.description:
**Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Cloud & Kubernetes) — Freelance / Part-Time Technical Support**

**Job Type:** Freelance / Part-Time / Contract

**Engagement:** Approximately 20–30 hours per week**Duration:** Ongoing, based on project requirements**Work Mode:** Remote (Pan-India)

**Experience Required:** 6–10 years

**Opportunity:** Suitable for experienced DevSecOps Engineers, Cloud Security Engineers, and Kubernetes Security Specialists seeking additional freelance income or part-time consulting opportunities alongside their existing employment.

We are seeking experienced professionals with strong hands-on expertise in Kubernetes Security, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Terraform, AWS Security Services, GitHub Actions, Python, and Enterprise Cloud Security Architecture.

**1. Core DevSecOps & Application Security Technologies**

* Kubernetes Security – Securing Kubernetes clusters, workloads, namespaces, service accounts, RBAC, and containerized applications.
* Trivy – Container image scanning, vulnerability detection, SBOM generation, and Infrastructure as Code security scanning.
* Snyk – Open-source dependency scanning, container security, license compliance, and vulnerability remediation.
* SonarQube – Static Application Security Testing (SAST), code quality analysis, security hotspots, and automated quality gates.
* Checkov – Infrastructure as Code security scanning, cloud misconfiguration detection, and policy enforcement.
* Terraform – Secure infrastructure provisioning, reusable modules, state management, and automated cloud resource deployment.
* AWS IAM / GuardDuty – Identity and access management, threat detection, and cloud security monitoring.
* GitHub Actions – Secure CI/CD workflows, automated security scanning, and DevSecOps pipeline integration.
* Python – Security automation, vulnerability reporting, cloud security scripting, and incident response utilities.

**2. Security Architecture, Threat Modeling & Risk Management**

* Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA) – Implementing identity-based access control, continuous verification, and least-privilege security.
* Defense-in-Depth – Designing layered security controls across applications, infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments.
* Threat Modeling – Applying STRIDE and PASTA methodologies to identify threats, attack surfaces, and mitigation strategies.
* Shift-Left DevSecOps – Integrating security testing into development workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) – Identifying cloud misconfigurations, compliance gaps, and infrastructure security risks.
* Security Architecture Reviews – Evaluating application architecture, infrastructure design, and security controls.
* Incident Command – Coordinating security incidents, incident escalation, response procedures, and stakeholder communication.
* Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) – Investigating security incidents, analyzing evidence, and supporting recovery.
* MITRE ATT&CK – Mapping adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures to enterprise security controls.
* Risk Assessment & Remediation – Prioritizing vulnerabilities based on exploitability, severity, and business impact.

**3. Security Data, SIEM & Threat Intelligence Platforms**

* Threat Hunting – Identifying suspicious activities, indicators of compromise, and potential attack patterns.

* Terraform – Secure cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration validation, and policy-based deployment.

* Docker Security – Container image hardening, secure base images, image signing, and vulnerability remediation.

* Network Security – Network policies, ingress/egress controls, service mesh security, and microsegmentation.

**5. Security Testing, Observability & Compliance Engineering**

* Burp Suite Professional / OWASP ZAP – Web application security testing, API security assessment, and vulnerability validation.

* Vulnerability Management – Vulnerability prioritization, remediation tracking, and security risk reduction.

3fc2de2d.description:
**Staff Data Platform Architect (Snowflake + dbt) — Freelance / Part-Time Technical Support**

**Job Type:** Freelance / Part-Time / Contract

**Engagement:** Approximately 20–30 hours per week**Duration:** Ongoing, based on project requirements**Work Mode:** Remote (Pan-India)

**Experience Required:** 8–12 years

**Opportunity:** Suitable for experienced Data Platform Architects, Staff Data Engineers, and Data Engineering Leads seeking additional freelance income or part-time consulting opportunities alongside their existing employment.

We are seeking experienced professionals with strong hands-on expertise in Snowflake, dbt (Data Build Tool), Apache Airflow, Fivetran, Python, SQL, Enterprise Data Architecture, DataOps, and Production Data Platform Engineering.

**1. Core Data Platform & Engineering Technologies**

* Snowflake – Cloud data warehousing, Virtual Warehouses, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and scalable analytical workloads.
* dbt (Data Build Tool) – SQL-based transformations, reusable models, incremental processing, testing, documentation, and data lineage.
* Apache Airflow – Workflow orchestration, DAG development, scheduling, dependency management, and automated pipeline monitoring.
* Fivetran – Automated data ingestion, source connectors, schema evolution, and managed ELT pipelines.
* Python – Data engineering automation, reusable transformation libraries, API integrations, and platform utilities.
* Advanced SQL – Complex queries, analytical functions, query optimization, and cross-platform SQL development.
* Snowpark – Python, SQL, and Scala-based data processing within Snowflake.
* Snowflake Cortex – Enterprise AI capabilities, LLM integration, and AI-powered data applications.

**2. Data Architecture, Modeling & Transformation Patterns**

* Medallion Architecture – Designing Landing, Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Semantic data layers.
* Enterprise Data Modeling – Dimensional modeling, Kimball Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, and Data Vault 2.0.
* dbt Project Architecture – Organizing staging, intermediate, and mart models using modular and reusable SQL transformations.
* Incremental Data Processing – Incremental models, watermarking, change data capture (CDC), and efficient data refresh strategies.
* Slowly Changing Dimensions – Implementing SCD Type 1 and Type 2 for historical data tracking.
* Data Vault 2.0 – Hubs, Links, Satellites, business keys, and historized enterprise data modeling.
* Metadata-Driven Pipelines – Parameterized ingestion frameworks, control tables, dynamic configurations, and reusable orchestration.
* Data Contracts & Schema Evolution – Managing source schema changes, backward compatibility, and data interface standards.
* Semantic Data Modeling – Building governed analytical models and business-ready datasets for downstream BI and AI workloads.

**3. Data Integration, Storage & Messaging Platforms**

* Fivetran Connectors – Integrating SaaS applications, databases, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
* Snowflake External Stages – Integrating Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Google Cloud Storage.
* Snowpipe / Snowpipe Streaming – Continuous data ingestion and low-latency data loading.
* Apache Kafka – Event streaming, data replication, and real-time data integration.
* PostgreSQL / SQL Server / Oracle – Enterprise relational database integration and source data extraction.
* REST APIs – API ingestion, pagination, authentication, throttling, and JSON data processing.
* AWS S3 / Azure Data Lake Storage / GCS – Cloud storage integration, data lake architecture, and lifecycle management.
* Spark / PySpark – Distributed data processing, large-scale transformations, and complex data engineering workloads.
* Delta Lake / Apache Iceberg – Open table formats, transactional data storage, and interoperable analytical architectures.

**4. Cloud, Infrastructure as Code & Data Orchestration**

* AWS / Microsoft Azure / GCP – Cloud architecture, networking, IAM, storage, compute, and enterprise data platform deployment.
* Snowflake Cloud Infrastructure – Warehouse sizing, resource monitoring, workload isolation, and multi-environment management.
* Apache Airflow – Production DAG management, task orchestration, retries, scheduling, and dependency handling.
* dbt Cloud / dbt Core – Transformation orchestration, job scheduling, environment management, and CI/CD integration.
* Terraform – Infrastructure as Code, Snowflake resource provisioning, cloud infrastructure automation, and environment management.
* Docker – Containerization of Python applications, data utilities, and orchestration components.
* Kubernetes – Deploying scalable data platform services, workload management, and infrastructure orchestration.
* GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps – Automated testing, deployment workflows, and data platform release management.
* GitOps / CI/CD – Version-controlled infrastructure, automated deployment, and environment promotion.
* Secrets Management – AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, and secure credential management.

**5. Data Observability, Security & Quality Engineering**

* dbt Tests – Generic tests, singular tests, custom data quality checks, and transformation validation.
* Great Expectations / Soda – Data quality validation, anomaly detection, and automated data testing.
* Elementary / Monte Carlo – Data observability, freshness monitoring, anomaly detection, and pipeline health monitoring.
* Snowflake Query Profile – Query execution analysis, warehouse utilization, and performance troubleshooting.
* Snowflake Resource Monitors – Credit consumption monitoring, workload governance, and cost control.
* Data Lineage – dbt lineage, dependency graphs, impact analysis, and enterprise data traceability.
* Snowflake RBAC – Role-based access control, least-privilege access, and secure data sharing.
* Dynamic Data Masking – Protecting sensitive data through masking policies and role-based access.
* Snowflake Row Access Policies – Row-level security and governed access to sensitive datasets.
* Snowflake Horizon / Microsoft Purview – Data governance, classification, lineage, and compliance management.
* OpenTelemetry / Prometheus / Grafana – Infrastructure observability, pipeline metrics, alerting, and operational monitoring.

**6. Advanced Data Platform Architecture, Leadership & Governance**

* System Architecture RFCs / ADRs – Technical design documentation, architecture decisions, and platform engineering standards.
* Data Platform Modernization – Migrating legacy data warehouses to Snowflake and modern cloud-native data architectures.
* Zero-Downtime Migrations – Parallel-run validation, phased cutover, backward-compatible schema changes, and rollback strategies.
* FinOps Optimization – Snowflake credit management, warehouse auto-suspend, workload optimization, and cloud cost governance.
* Capacity Planning – Workload forecasting, concurrency planning, warehouse sizing, and resource utilization optimization.
* Production Reliability – SLA management, incident response, root-cause analysis, and pipeline recovery.
* DataOps Automation – Automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and data pipeline lifecycle management.
* Technical Mentorship – Guiding data engineering teams, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering best practices.
* Cross-Squad Leadership – Providing asynchronous architectural guidance to distributed teams across India and global time zones.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Minimum 8–12 years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Data Platform Architecture, or Enterprise Data Consulting.
* Strong hands-on production experience with Snowflake, dbt, Apache Airflow, Python, and advanced SQL.
* Proven expertise designing scalable enterprise data platforms and modern cloud data warehouse architectures.
* Deep understanding of dbt project architecture, incremental models, snapshots, testing, documentation, and data lineage.
* Practical experience with Apache Airflow DAGs, production scheduling, pipeline orchestration, and failure recovery.
* Experience integrating multiple enterprise databases, SaaS applications, APIs, and cloud storage platforms using Fivetran and custom ingestion frameworks.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data modeling, dimensional modeling, Data Vault 2.0, and Medallion Architecture.
* Experience implementing metadata-driven ETL/ELT frameworks and reusable data transformation pipelines.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot Snowflake performance bottlenecks, optimize warehouse utilization, and reduce compute costs.
* Strong knowledge of data governance, security, access control, data quality, and observability.
* Experience with end-to-end data platform migrations, production cutovers, automated reconciliation, and operational support.
* Ability to explain complex data architecture and platform engineering concepts through real-world production scenarios.
* Excellent English communication and technical documentation skills.
* Experience mentoring data engineers, leading architecture reviews, and conducting technical interviews is an advantage.
* Based in India and available for approximately 20–30 hours per week of remote freelance/part-time consulting.
* Comfortable supporting multiple Snowflake, dbt, Data Engineering, and Data Platform Architecture-related job positions within their areas of expertise.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

284e5d5d.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

49db5517.title: Program Manager III, Amazon Cross Border, Amazon Cross Border
49db5517.description:
**Description**
The Amazon Cross-Border Seller Experience team is growing, and we are looking for a Program Manager III to own selection quality improvement across our global stores. In this role, you will start by building the data foundation — designing metrics, writing SQL queries, and creating dashboards that give the team clear visibility into selection throughput and item data quality. From there, you will use those insights to drive programs that remove barriers to cross-border selection growth and improve the customer shopping experience. You will partner with compliance, localization, catalog, product, and sales teams across multiple countries to align priorities and deliver measurable results. If you are someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at turning raw data into action, and excited to work on problems with global customer impact, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and build data pipelines, dashboards, and metrics using SQL, Excel, and AI tools to provide actionable visibility into selection throughput and item data quality across global stores.
* Partner with compliance, localization, catalog, and product teams across multiple countries to identify and remove barriers to selection growth, improving the speed and volume of selection onboarded.
* Drive programs to improve item data quality — titles, descriptions, attributes, and images — to directly impact product discoverability, conversion, and sales for customers worldwide.
* Coordinate with global stakeholders to align priorities, define roadmaps, and communicate progress through clear narratives and automated reporting for leadership audiences.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and introduce scalable mechanisms that improve operational efficiency across the selection and sales funnel.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning pulling up your selection quality dashboards, checking for new trends or bottlenecks in the data. By mid-morning, you are on a call with compliance and localization partners in another country, working through a plan to unblock a batch of listings. After lunch, you write a summary of program progress and trade-off recommendations for a director review. Later, you dig into SQL to investigate a data quality issue a teammate flagged, then wrap up by updating your roadmap ahead of a stakeholder sync the next day.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Amazon Cross-Border Seller Experience team helps sellers expand internationally and works to bring customers the broadest selection at the lowest price. We operate across geographies and functions to remove barriers to cross-border trade, making it easier for sellers to list, comply, and succeed in stores around the world. Our team is expanding, and this role offers global exposure — you will collaborate with teams across countries and gain visibility with leadership. As you grow, you will build strong analytical and written communication skills and take on increasingly strategic responsibilities.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

f50f7a1e.description:
**Job Description: PreSales Solution Architect, SAP Lean Manufacturing**

**Attribute**

  

**Detail**

Job title

  

PreSales Solution Architect, SAP Lean Manufacturing

Function

  

Presales / Solution Consulting, Manufacturing Industry Practice

Location

  

Bengaluru, India (hybrid). Travel to client sites in India and abroad up to 30-40%

Experience

  

12-18 years total. 8+ years in SAP manufacturing. 4+ years in presales or solution architecture

Reports to

  

Head of Presales / Practice Head, Manufacturing

Works with

  

Account Executives, Delivery Leads, SAP Alliance team, Industry Principals

Employment type

  

Full-time, permanent

Deal size supported

  

Typically USD 1M-15M transformation and rollout deals

**Role purpose**

This role wins SAP manufacturing deals by linking Lean principles to SAP solutions. You will turn plant-floor problems into clear, costed SAP solution designs. You will show clients how SAP S/4HANA and SAP Digital Manufacturing cut waste, lift OEE and shorten lead times.

You are the trusted technical voice in the sales cycle. You lead discovery, build the solution, run demos and POCs, and defend the architecture in front of CXOs, plant heads and IT leaders. You then hand over a deliverable, de-risked scope to delivery.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and solution design**

* Lead discovery workshops with plant heads, operations, quality, maintenance and IT teams.
* Map current-state processes using value stream mapping (VSM) and identify the 8 wastes (TIMWOODS).
* Translate Lean goals into SAP solution architecture across S/4HANA PP, QM, PM, MM, EWM and SAP Digital Manufacturing (DM).
* Design future-state processes for pull production, Kanban, JIT/JIS supply, takt-based scheduling and line balancing.
* Define integration architecture across SAP, MES, PLM, SCADA, historians and IIoT platforms using SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite and OPC UA / MQTT.
* Produce solution blueprints, high-level architecture diagrams, scope documents and assumptions.

**2. Demos, POCs and solution showcases**

* Build and run tailored demos of SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing, SAP DM, SAP IBP and SAP Analytics Cloud.
* Design and lead POCs and pilots with clear success criteria, such as OEE uplift, scrap reduction or WIP reduction.
* Maintain reusable demo environments, storyboards and industry scenarios for discrete and process manufacturing.

**3. RFP, RFI and proposal ownership**

* Own the solution response for RFPs and RFIs. This covers architecture, scope, approach, effort and risks.
* Build effort estimates, staffing models and phased roadmaps with the delivery team.
* Shape commercial models such as fixed price, T&M and outcome-based pricing with sales and finance.
* Write executive summaries and value narratives that tie the solution to measurable business outcomes.

**4. Business case and value engineering**

* Build ROI and TCO models showing savings in inventory, lead time, downtime, quality cost and labour.
* Quantify benefits using Lean metrics: OEE, takt time, cycle time, first pass yield, inventory turns and MTTR / MTBF.
* Present business cases to CFOs, COOs and plant leadership.

**5. Sales partnership and deal leadership**
