05713d54.title: Cloud AI Security - AWS - Senior Consultant
05713d54.description:
**Cyber**

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

**Position Summary**

**Job Title:**Senior Consultant - Cloud AI Security - AWS

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.

  

**Work you’ll do**

As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.

Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**

Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.

  

**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.

* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.

* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.

* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.

* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.

* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.

* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.

* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:

* **AWS Certified Security – Specialty**

* **Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate**

* **Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer**

* **Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate**

* **Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer**

* **AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)**

* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.

**How you’ll grow**

At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.

**Benefits**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

  

**Deloitte’s culture**

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.

  

**Corporate citizenship**

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

  

**Recruiter tips**

We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared and confident. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research: know some background about the organization and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

  

**Education:**

B.Tech / M.Tech / MS / MCA / MBA or equivalent (Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or related field)

  
  

**Location:** Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

72a729eb.title: Senior Group Technical Architect
72a729eb.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategic architecture design and hands-on technical credibility: reviewing API contracts, challenging data models, understanding event-driven and microservices patterns, and engaging directly with engineering teams, while ensuring every decision remains aligned to Ingka's company-wide architectural principles, reference models, and technology strategy.

The successful candidate will act as the primary architectural authority across all seven order flows, ensuring consistency, reusability, and coherence of the six core component parts that underpin each flow, while also acting as a trusted advisor and thought leader to senior stakeholders across the business.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Architecture Leadership**
---------------------------

* Own the end-to-end target-state architecture for all six order flows, ensuring each of the six component parts is designed consistently and re-uses shared capabilities rather than creating channel-specific silos. This must include the oversight for future configuration over development for additional future workflows .
* Translate complex business requirements from merchandising, supply chain, store operations, and digital teams into coherent, scalable architectural designs.
* Ensure every design decision is explicitly aligned to Ingka's company-wide architectural principles, reference architectures, technology radar, and enterprise data standards.
* Co-chair and contribute to architecture review boards, ensuring solution designs from delivery squads are assessed against enterprise standards before build.
* Own and maintain architectural roadmaps, capability maps, and target-state blueprints for the order management domain, keeping them current as the program evolves.

**Engineering Depth & Technical Credibility**
---------------------------------------------

* Bring genuine hands-on engineering understanding — API design, event-driven architecture, integration patterns, data modelling, cloud-native and microservices architecture — sufficient to challenge and support engineering teams directly, not just at a conceptual level.
* Review and provide technical guidance on system design documents, API contracts, data schemas, and integration specifications produced by delivery teams.
* Identify technical debt, architectural risk, and non-functional requirement gaps (performance, resilience, scalability, security) across the order flows, and drive remediation.
* Partner closely with Product teams, engineering leads, solution architects, and platform teams to ensure designs are not just theoretically sound but practically buildable and operable.

**Program & Stakeholder Engagement**
------------------------------------

* Act as the primary architectural point of contact for the Order Management Program, engaging with program leadership, product owners, and delivery teams.
* Provide clear, well-reasoned architectural trade-off analysis to senior stakeholders and steering committees, balancing speed of delivery against long-term architectural integrity.
* Ensure architecture decisions are documented, communicated, and traceable, using appropriate governance frameworks (e.g. TOGAF-aligned or equivalent Ingka standards).

**Thought Leadership & Client Guidance**
----------------------------------------

* Bring external market awareness and thought leadership on order management, unified commerce, and retail technology trends, proactively identifying where emerging approaches, platforms or architectural patterns could benefit the program.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders — going beyond "order taking" to actively shape, challenge, and improve the direction of the program based on evidence and experience.
* Represent the architecture function in front of senior client and business stakeholders, articulating complex technical concepts in business-relevant terms and building confidence in the architectural approach.
* Mentor and upskill architects and senior engineers within the program, raising the overall architectural maturity of the wider team.
* Actively contribute to Ingka's broader architecture community of practice, sharing lessons learned from the Order Management Program to influence architecture standards beyond this program alone.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Essential**
-------------

* Proven experience as an Enterprise Architect or Principal/Chief Solution Architect on large-scale, complex Order Management System (OMS) programs, ideally within retail, home furnishings, or comparable multi-channel businesses.
* Demonstrable engineering background (e.g. former senior software engineer, technical architect, or platform engineer) giving credible, hands-on technical depth alongside architectural strategy.
* Strong knowledge of order management, inventory/ATP, fulfilment orchestration, and omnichannel retail architecture patterns.
* Experience working with modern integration patterns: event-driven architecture, API-first design, microservices, and composable commerce approaches.
* Experience defining and governing architecture within a large enterprise, using recognised frameworks (e.g. TOGAF) and enterprise architecture tooling.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with proven experience presenting to senior business and technology leadership.
* Experience aligning program-level architecture to a broader, company-wide architectural strategy and standards.

**Desirable**
-------------

322b4f41.title: Cloud AI Security - GCP - Manager
322b4f41.description:
**Cyber**

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

**Job Title:** Manager - Cloud AI Security - GCP

  

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.

  

**Work you’ll do**

As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.

Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.
* Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security.

**The team**

Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.

  

**Required:**

* 9+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.

* Demonstrated experience leading client-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI-related programs.

* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.

* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.

* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.

* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.

* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.

* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non-technical stakeholders.

* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.

**Preferred:**

* Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, AI runtime monitoring, and agent security for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, documentation standards, and audit support.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, go-to-market offerings, and practice-building activities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Azure security certifications, or comparable senior-level cloud and security credentials.

**How you’ll grow**

At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.

**Benefits**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

  

**Deloitte’s culture**

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.

  

**Corporate citizenship**

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

  

**Recruiter tips**

To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research: know some background about the organization and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. The architect will be responsible for designing future-state reference architectures, guiding implementation teams, and ensuring alignment with EY’s data modernization strategy. Sales and Business Development

0669a5d2.description:
About the job

**Program Manager, Strategy & Ops**

**SPIRE Lab, Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru**
· Full-time, project position · 3 to 4 years of experience

**About the project**

SPIRE Lab at IISc is hiring a Program Manager to run day-to-day operations, partner coordination and oversee the project for a new two-year, philanthropy-funded research program in rural Bihar.

The programme asks a simple question: can voice AI help a state government genuinely listen to rural women? Millions of women in self-help groups have views on livelihoods, nutrition and local services, but little of it reaches decision makers in a usable form.

We will build and field-test voice AI that holds conversations with these women in Hindi and local languages, and turns what they say into insights a government can act on. Alongside it, we will build an open evaluation sandbox that tests how voice AI actually performs in the field, with rural accents and real phone lines, rather than in the lab.

The work brings together an academic AI lab, a state government livelihoods mission, a community media organisation, a policy and data governance institute, and a global philanthropic funder.

**Why this role**

This is a rare chance for someone from public policy or the development sector to work inside an AI research lab.

You will sit with speech and AI researchers at IISc every day. You will see how AI systems are built, evaluated and deployed for public good, and you will shape how that work meets the field. If you want a career at the meeting point of government, development and technology, this role gives you a front-row seat.

**What you will do**

You will own operations and partner coordination for the programme. A separate programme manager leads technical delivery, and you will work closely with them.

* **Run the timeline.**
  Plan and own the project plan, milestones and dependencies across all partners, and keep them current.
* **Coordinate partners.**
  Be the day-to-day point of contact for all stakeholder.
* **Get ahead of delays.**
  Spot bottlenecks early, follow up before things slip, and escalate with options, not just problems.
* **Documentation.**
  Ensure agreements with right clauses are in place, data-sharing documents, approvals, vendor processes and project administration through to closure.
* **Report and document.**
  Ensure meeting logs, progress reports and funder updates that are accurate and ready to send.
* **Track the numbers.**
  Monitor budget use, field targets and project metrics, and flag gaps early.
* **Support the field.**
  Plan and join visits to Bihar, and help coordinate work with community cadres and field teams.

This is not a role for moving files from one inbox to another. We want someone who holds the full context of the project and goes deep into it.

**What success looks like**

**By 6 months**

* You own the end-to-end project timeline.
* You anticipate bottlenecks and reach out to partners before delays happen.
* The team relies on you as the anchor for project context.

**By 12 months**

* The project runs on schedule.
* You hold the full context of the project and have trusted relationships with every partner.
* Your documentation and reports are precise and reliable enough to send out without review.
* You also own and track the budgets for the project

**Must have**

* 3-5 years of work experience in either public policy, government programmes, the development sector or program management in startups/industry.
* Strong quantitative aptitude. You are comfortable with numbers, budgets, targets and tracking data.
* A track record of building working relationships with government officials and multiple partners is a plus.
* Strong operations skills: planning, follow-through and attention to detail.
* Fluent spoken and written Hindi and English, and comfort working in rural Bihar.
* Proficiency with Google suite.
* Proficiency with Claude/Assistant in your daily work. Please share your GitHub profile, examples of AI workflows or example account of how you use AI tools.
* Willingness to be based at IISc Bengaluru, with regular travel to Bihar.
* Experience in managing budgets.

**Good to have**

* Preparation for the UPSC Civil Services or a state civil services examination, or an ambition to pursue public service.
* Ex-entrepreneur, shows you can own problems and solutions, you take decisions.
* An academic or research orientation, such as a master's degree, policy writing or published work, it shows you go deep into problems.
* Bhojpuri, Magahi or Maithili, or prior fieldwork in Bihar or Uttar Pradesh.
* Experience with self-help groups, rural livelihoods missions or community institutions.
* Experience managing grant-funded projects, including funder reporting.

**Position details**

Location

SPIRE Lab, IISc Bengaluru

Type

Full-time project position, tied to the program's duration (about two years).

Compensation

Up to ₹18 lakh per annum, based on experience

Reports to

Head of Program at SPIRE Lab

Apply to this Google form. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

dotSolved drives digital transformations for enterprises by defining, automating, and optimizing complex business processes for the digital era and engineering modern, data & analytic driven, applications that deliver intended business value. With hundreds of successful implementations and experience in Big Data, ERP, and Supply Chain, dotSolved can guarantee the creation of measurable business value from project engagements leading to accelerated business growth and profitability for customers.
  
  
**Job Description**
Position - Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
  
  
Exp – 5+ Years
  
  
Location – Chennai/Hyderabad/Pune/Gurgaon/Bangalore - Hybrid
  
  
Shift timing - 2.00PM to 11.00PM IST
  
  
About the role: We are seeking an accomplished Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) – Incident to Resolve Functional Consultant for a support engagement. The ideal candidate will have over 5 years of functional experience specifically in EAM and Incident to Resolve processes within the Oracle Fusion Cloud environment. The focus will be on providing business-as-usual (BAU) support, system troubleshooting, ongoing improvements, and user enablement for the EAM suite and related modules across global operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Application Support & Troubleshooting:
  
  
Provide comprehensive functional support for Oracle Fusion Cloud EAM, focusing on Incident to Resolve processes, including maintenance requests, work order management, asset tracking, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis.
  
  
Analyze and resolve user-raised incidents, system issues, and service requests in line with agreed SLAs.
  
  
Conduct root cause analysis for recurring issues and work with technical teams and Oracle Support for complex/systemic challenges.
  
  
Support asset lifecycle management, from incident creation and assessment through resolution and closure.
  
  
**System Enhancements & Change Management**
Assess and implement minor enhancements and configuration updates in line with evolving business requirements.
  
  
Participate in testing activities (unit, integration, regression, UAT) for Oracle quarterly releases, upgrades, and new feature roll-outs.
  
  
Support interfaces/integrations with related modules, such as Inventory, Procurement, Projects, and Supply Chain applications.
  
  
**Documentation & User Training**
Create and maintain user manuals, functional specifications, process documentation, and quick reference guides for Incident to Resolve processes.
  
  
Lead training sessions and knowledge transfer workshops for business users and support staff.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**
Act as the primary contact for business users seeking EAM functional support, ensuring effective communication and follow-up for incident resolution, enhancements, and process queries.
  
  
Collaborate closely with business process owners, IT, operations, and vendor/partner teams to address issues and ensure end-to-end process efficiency.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Best Practices**
Proactively identify process gaps and system improvement opportunities, leveraging best practices and the latest Oracle Cloud EAM enhancements.
  
  
Recommend process optimizations for asset reliability, maintenance scheduling, and data quality within the EAM suite.
  
  
Stay current on Oracle Fusion Cloud updates and their impact on EAM and cross-functional processes.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
  
  
Minimum of 5 years’ hands-on functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud EAM, including direct exposure to Incident to Resolve processes.
  
  
Comprehensive understanding of asset management, maintenance planning & execution, incident management, preventive maintenance, and work order processes.
  
  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills.
  
  
Experience working in support engagements or managed services, including incident, problem, and change management.
  
  
Excellent communication skills for user support, stakeholder management, and cross-team collaboration.
  
  
Oracle Cloud EAM certification (preferred, not mandatory).
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
Experience with related Oracle Fusion Cloud modules (Inventory, Procurement, Projects, Supply Chain).
  
  
Familiarity with enterprise support tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and ITIL best practices.
  
  
Exposure to process reengineering, integration points, and reporting/dashboard solutions.
  
  
Managed services or Application Maintenance & Support (AMS) background.

4db8e3c5.description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking a highly motivated Product Support Engineer - Cloud Security with expertise in Cloud Security, SASE, Zero Trust, and Enterprise Networking technologies. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical support expert and escalation engineer responsible for resolving complex customer issues involving networking, cloud infrastructure, and modern security platforms. This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, customer engagement capabilities, and hands-on experience with cloud security technologies such as Netskope, SASE, ZTNA, CASB, and Zero Trust frameworks. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to drive issue resolution, improve platform stability, and enhance customer experience.
  
  

* Role: Product Support Engineer - Cloud Security
* Location: All Persistent Locations
* Experience: 2 to 8 Years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Act as the primary technical escalation engineer for critical and high-priority customer issues.
* Troubleshoot advanced networking, cloud security, and infrastructure-related problems including connectivity, latency, authentication, policy enforcement, and access control issues.
* Communicate directly with customers through video calls, phone calls, emails, and case management systems.
* Provide timely customer updates, resolution plans, and technical guidance throughout the support lifecycle.
* Support and troubleshoot Cloud Security, SASE, Zero Trust, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, and related security platforms.
* Perform detailed analysis of network traffic using tools such as Wireshark, TCPDump, Netmon, and packet capture utilities.
* Diagnose issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, Switching, VPNs, Firewalls, Load Balancers, and Proxy technologies.
* Support cloud-delivered security solutions including Netskope and similar Secure Service Edge platforms.
* Troubleshoot SSL/TLS decryption, authentication, SSO, policy enforcement, and secure access issues.
* Work closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams to identify product defects and drive issue resolution.
* Participate in root cause analysis and contribute to platform improvements.
* Support Linux, Unix, Windows, Active Directory, and LDAP environments.
* Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.
* Drive proactive customer success initiatives by identifying potential risks and recommending best practices.
* Manage support cases and collaborate across teams using Salesforce, Jira, Slack, and other operational tools.
* Contribute to continuous service improvement and customer experience enhancement initiatives.
* Stay updated on emerging cloud security threats, technologies, and best practices.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 2 to 8 years of experience in Product Support, Technical Support, Cloud Security, Network Security, or Infrastructure Support roles.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing & Switching, VPNs, Firewalls, and Load Balancing.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting enterprise networking and cloud connectivity issues.
* Strong knowledge of Cloud Security architectures and security best practices.
* Experience working with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) platforms and architectures.
* Good understanding of Zero Trust and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts.
* Hands-on exposure to Netskope or similar cloud security platforms.
* Working knowledge of CASB, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), SSL/TLS Decryption, DLP, and Cloud Security technologies.
* Experience supporting network security solutions including NGFW, SSL VPN, IPSec VPN, Proxy Servers, SSO, and Encryption Gateways.
* Strong experience with Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of Active Directory, LDAP, and Identity & Access Management concepts.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills using Wireshark, TCPDump, Netmon, Ping, Traceroute, and related diagnostic tools.
* Experience handling customer escalations and managing critical support cases.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent customer-facing communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience collaborating with Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Customer Success teams.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Jira, Slack, and support workflow management platforms.
* Strong documentation and technical writing skills.
* Customer-first mindset with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure support environment.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
  
  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -**
**persistent.com/careers**
***“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”***

* Build observability and operational intelligence solutions spanning metrics, logs, traces, events, topology, service dependencies, incidents, deployments, and configuration changes to support anomaly detection, event correlation, service-impact analysis, and AI-driven RCA

* Connect AIOps platforms with ITSM/CMDB, observability, CI/CD, cloud-management, knowledge, security, automation platforms, and enterprise APIs, including ServiceNow or similar tools

* Drive RFP/RFI/RFQ and pre-sales solutioning efforts, covering technical discovery, solution architecture, transformation approach, estimations, staffing models, implementation roadmaps, assumptions, risks, dependencies, TCO considerations, and technical proposal development
* Partner with senior customer and executive stakeholders, lead architecture workshops and solution defenses, and work alongside Sales, Pre-Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Practice, and Commercial teams to craft technically sound and competitive solutions

* Deep experience building large-scale AIOps and intelligent operations platforms, covering observability, anomaly detection, event correlation, noise reduction, service-impact analysis, AI-assisted RCA, remediation, and operational automation
* Strong command of at least one major cloud platform – AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud – including enterprise cloud architecture, security, identity, networking, governance, resilience, and scalability

* Knowledge of LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Strands Agents, Google ADK, MCP, A2A, RAG, vector databases, or knowledge graphs

73f7c232.title: Presales Manager - Lending
73f7c232.description:
**The Opportunity**

As Presales Manager, you will own the solutioning agenda across complex, high-value deal

pursuits—bringing together deep banking domain expertise, strategic thinking, consultative selling, and genuine individual and integrated product mastery to drive measurable customer value and win business that matters.

You will be leading efforts to drive new sales, cross sell, and upsell at Intellect’s key relationships engaging at the CXO level and solution with authority, and build the presales capability that turns market opportunities into signed engagements.

You will engage with business leaders across Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Transaction Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, and Wealth Management to understand strategic objectives, diagnose business challenges, and translate them into differentiated transformation opportunities.

The role requires the ability to ask the right questions, challenge conventional thinking, bring external market perspectives, and guide customers from problem identification to solution vision.

You should be comfortable in working in a networked org design and in taking ownership of the

outcome therefore to pool the best resources and solution that OneIntellect has to offer to its

customers.

This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a boardroom solutioning session as they are shaping product strategy conversations with internal roadmap teams.

**Responsibilities**

**Prospect Understanding**

* Engage with banking executives, business heads, product owners, and operations leaders to understand strategic priorities.
* Analyse banking business models, revenue drivers, operational challenges, and competitive pressures.
* Translate market trends into actionable transformation opportunities.
* Actively validate critical deal qualifiers—including Need/Problem, Decision Makers, Customer’s Timeline, Customer’s Budget runway, and Proposal intent to successfully graduate opportunities.

**Consultative Value Selling**

* Create Business Value to shape opportunities, influence decisions and improve win probability.
* Ability to articulate measurable business outcomes, ROI, and value propositions aligned to customer objectives.
* Help banks rethink customer journeys, operating models, and product strategies.

**Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops**

* Conduct high-quality product demonstrations, discovery workshops, proof-of-concept sessions, technical presentations, and solution walk through for prospective clients aligned to their business needs.
* Ensure demo is aligned to use cases to prospect’s requirements and perform Demo Diagnostic.

**RFP/RFI and Bid Support**

* Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, and proposal documents.
* Ensure that responses are accurate, complete, compelling, and aligned with the customer’s stated requirements.

**Solutioning and Proposal Development**

* Design tailored high quality solution propositions using the company’s product capabilities, platform strengths, implementation approach, and domain expertise.
* Support the creation of scope documents, solution architecture inputs, effort estimates, implementation plans, timelines, assumptions, exclusions, and commercial inputs.
* Ensure that the proposed solution is practical, differentiated, and aligned to the customer’s needs.

**Coordination with Product, Engineering and Delivery Teams**

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Delivery, Implementation, and Support teams to validate solution feasibility, effort assumptions, customisation needs, integration approach, dependencies, and delivery risks.

**Sales Enablement**

* Equip the Sales team with product collateral, demo scripts, solution notes, competitive insights, objection-handling points, customer-specific messaging, and proof points to support effective selling.

**Market and Customer Feedback Loop**

* Capture feedback from prospects, clients, partners, competitive situations, demonstrations, and RFPs, and share structured insights with Product teams for roadmap, positioning, and solution improvement.

**Deal Conversion Support**

* Actively drive the early-stage sales cycle by shaping and graduating qualified opportunities.
* Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure that the proposed solution is credible, client-specific, implementable, and capable of supporting successful deal closure.

**Knowledge Management**

* Maintain updated value proposition product decks, reusable proposal content, case studies, standard responses, FAQs, and solution artefacts to improve pre-sales productivity and consistency.

**Transition to Delivery**

* Support the handover from Sales to Delivery after deal closure by ensuring that the agreed scope, solution commitments, assumptions, risks, and client expectations are clearly documented and communicated.

**Qualifications**

* Extensive experience in the BFSI industry, with a strong track record in Presales, Solution Consulting, Product Consulting, or other customer-facing roles within banking, financial services, or fintech organizations.
* Deep domain expertise in one or more banking business areas, with the ability to understand customer needs, analyse business challenges, and design differentiated, practical, and commercially viable solution propositions.
* Proven experience leading complex sales pursuits, including customer discovery, executive workshops, product demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to articulate product value, competitive differentiation, implementation strategy, and business outcomes, translating product capabilities into compelling customer-specific solutions.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience preparing solution proposals, scope documents, effort estimates, implementation plans, commercial inputs, and customer-facing collateral to support strategic business opportunities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence CXOs, business leaders, technical teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders across the sales lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to capture customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and emerging industry insights, leveraging them to strengthen product positioning, solution offerings, and continuous improvement.
* Proven success in enabling high-performing sales organizations through reusable solution assets, demo environments, knowledge repositories, and best practices, while ensuring a seamless transition from Sales to Delivery and consistently driving successful customer outcomes.

f9969632.title: Senior Solution Consultant (CPG Experience)
f9969632.description:
**Growth Consultant**

**About Bizom**

Bizom is the retail intelligence platform of choice for more than 750+ global brands helping them improve their channel, manpower and process efficiency.

Every day, our systems run the heartbeat of modern distribution, including salesforce automation, distributor management, retail execution, trade marketing, and AI-driven insights, reaching millions of retail outlets and field users across emerging markets.

Excited to know more about us? Learn more about
Bizom
here and discover what makes our culture truly people-first:
Algorithmic Jugaad
.

**The Role**

The blood stream of any organization is sales which helps the cash register go Ka-ching! Have you ever wondered how you can make the sales team more empowered? How can we tailor make selling to adapt to a client's needs? How can we impact the customer experience positively for their entire journey?

If you have, then this role is for you. We can make you into a kickass Solution Consultant by helping us scale the revolution we have begun in SaaS Mobility with Bizom. You will get to work with the biggest brands in CPG, crack multi company and multi million dollar deals!

**Responsibilities**

● Lead Engagement before closure: Build a relation with the end customer to help establish trust.

● Hand hold clients, and help create value by understanding their route to market and shape their RTM strategies for the next decade.

● Lead engagements and activities to understand the client eco-system and requirements better.

● Be the bridge between the client and the Internal team, Maintain and expand client relationships.

● Requirement Gathering and Documentation: Understand, analyze and gather client requirements. Prepare RFI, RFP and BRD’s.

● Pitch Deck: Conceptualize & craft sales decks according to the client requirements.

● Product Demos: Deliver product presentations and demonstrations that are tailored to the client's business requirements.

● Cross-Functional Communication: works closely with the product team, forwarding requests, feedback on the experience and tweaks to existing features.

**Skills and Requirements**

● Lead customer discovery sessions and workshops to understand business challenges, technical environments, and success criteria and ability to translate business problems into structured solutions and compelling narratives

● Deliver compelling, persona- and value-based product demonstrations

● Translate business vision into structured execution by breaking down strategy into clear goals, initiatives, and measurable outcomes

● Confident in CXO-level conversations, with the ability to build credibility and long-term relationships

● Skilled in developing high-quality presentations, case studies, and business cases articulating value, ROI, and strategic impact

● Align business and technology teams to co-create solutions, build consensus, and ensure seamless translation of strategy into on-ground execution

● Hands-on involvement in SOW creation, RFP/RFI responses, and value proposition development

● Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure a smooth transition from pre-sales to post-sales by documenting requirements and facilitating a clean handoff to Customer Success teams.

● Provide continuous feedback to Product Management on customer needs, competitive insights, and market trends to help influence product direction and strategy.

● Contribute to team excellence by sharing best practices, reusable assets, and continuously improving demos, presentations, and sales processes to be more scalable and impactful.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong documentation abilities.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and execution.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and work collaboratively across teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Curious about technology, AI, and how modern SaaS products are transforming businesses.
* Comfortable working with MS Excel.
* Good understanding of FMCG/CPG business operations and distribution models will be an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Delivering quick and effective customer support with high SLA adherence.
* Ensuring smooth go-lives within committed timelines for both mid-market and enterprise customers.
* Driving strong customer adoption and engagement post implementation.
* Building strong customer relationships through responsiveness, ownership, and problem-solving.
* Understanding customer challenges deeply through regular market visits and on-ground exposure.

**The League You will Grow With:**

* Get the opportunity to work with highly ambitious, sharp, and result-oriented people from across the globe.
* Bring your FMCG/CPG industry knowledge into the world of technology, AI, and SaaS, while solving large-scale business problems for leading brands.
* Work closely with some of the biggest CPG brands and understand how technology is transforming route-to-market operations.
* Own your ideas, strategies, and execution and see your impact directly on customer growth and business outcomes.
* Gain hands-on exposure to technology, AI-driven solutions, data-led decision making, and modern SaaS business models.
* Work on real business challenges that directly influence sales execution, distribution, retail visibility, and market growth for customers.
* Accelerate your learning curve and career growth by working at the intersection of business and technology.
* Be part of a culture where leaders are built from within through ownership, hustle, and consistent impact - not just hierarchy or tenure.
* Drive meaningful business outcomes by helping customers adopt mobile-first and AI-led technologies that impact millions of retailers and users on the ground.

**Why Bizom?**

* We are happy Souls, working together and having each other’s back! People, Product and Profit is our motto.
* Fly beyond your imagination as we believe in giving wings to your passion.
* No Kinder-garden, We fall, We learn and we stick together like a chewing-gum.
* We trust in our association and allow free rein to our employees. To act and explore themselves while delivering the best and sustainable results.
* We celebrate success hard and failures harder, It's always a collective success or collective failure. We enjoy our learnings more with a sip of our poison;)
* Have Buddies, Mentors But be your own boss. It goes hand in hand.

477050e2.title: Technical Solutions Engineer - AI Security
477050e2.description:
**Title: Technical Solutions Engineer - AI Security**

**Location: Base location Mumbai**

**Work mode: remote (required travelling)**

**Experience: atleast 4+ years Technical Presales experience in cybersecurity and AI security products**

**\*Only immediate joiners or maximum 30 days NP candidates preferred\***

**ABOUT KAPALINS:**

Kapalins builds an AI-native security and governance platform for enterprises adopting generative AI: managing AI risk, model and data exposure, governance and compliance across LLMs, copilots and agentic systems.

Enterprises in India are deploying GenAI far faster than they are governing it. Security and risk teams are being asked to sign off on systems they cannot see. That gap is our market, and it is opening now.

**THE ROLE:**

We're looking for a Pre-Sales Engineer who can translate the technical depth of our platform into a compelling, credible story for CISOs, CTOs, and security architects — and prove it live. You'll be the technical voice in the room alongside our sales team: running demos, answering the hard architecture and threat-model questions, and helping prospects see exactly how Kapālins secures their AI estate.

This is not a scripted-demo role. You need to genuinely understand LLM security, agentic AI risk, and enterprise compliance well enough to improvise under technical questioning from senior security buyers.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN:**

* Deliver technical product demonstrations of the Kapālins platform — AI Trust Index, Proxy/Probe/Connector observation modes, LLM Hardening, Policy Shield, and Compliance Shield — tailored to each prospect's AI estate and threat model
* Partner with Sales on discovery calls to understand a prospect's AI/LLM footprint (models, copilots, agents) and map it to relevant platform capabilities
* Respond to technical questions on prompt injection, jailbreak defense, model integrity, data leakage, and agentic AI runtime risk in real time, with credibility
* Own technical responses for RFPs/RFIs, security questionnaires, and architecture reviews
* Map customer compliance requirements (APRA CPS 234/230, DPDP Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS) to platform features and evidence output
* Run and support proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments, including connecting a prospect's AI providers and interpreting resulting risk scores
* Act as the technical bridge between prospects, Sales, and Product — feeding real buyer objections and gaps back into the roadmap
* Build and maintain demo environments, sandbox scenarios (e.g., simulated attack/injection scenarios), and reusable technical collateral

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* Atleast 4+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity and/or AI/LLM security — pre-sales, sales engineering, security engineering, or a security-adjacent technical role
* Working understanding of LLM/AI-specific threat vectors: prompt injection, jailbreaking, model poisoning, adversarial ML, data leakage, agentic AI risk
* Familiarity with security frameworks relevant to AI: OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF — and ideally exposure to regulatory frameworks like DPDP, APRA CPS 234/230, or ISO 42001
* Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts to a non-technical or executive audience, and to hold your own with a highly technical one (CISO/security architect level)
* Comfort running live product demonstrations and improvising through unscripted technical questions

**STRONGLY PREFERRED:**

* Prior pre-sales/sales engineering experience at a cybersecurity or AI security product company
* Hands-on familiarity with LLM APIs and platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI) or enterprise copilots (Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot)
* Experience with API integrations, gateways/proxies, or SIEM/XDR ecosystems
* Prior experience supporting RFPs, security questionnaires, or compliance evidence packages
* Startup or fast-scaling product-company experience, comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-evolving product

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**

* Prospects leave every demo with a clear, credible understanding of how Kapālins governs their specific AI estate.
* Technical objections in the sales cycle get resolved fast and accurately, shortening deal cycles.
* PoCs convert at a high rate because the technical story lands cleanly with security buyers.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Apply through LinkedIn OR you can also write to
**swati.maheshwari@kapalins.com**
with the subject line: Senior Technical Sales Engineer | [Your Name]

Know more: www.kapalins.com

Kapalins is an equal opportunity employer.

Best Regards,

Kapalins

99fb1dfa.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. 8ae42068.description:
At Westernacher Consulting, we are looking for an experienced
**SAP Platform Solution Architect**
to join our global Platform Engineering CoE. This role is ideal for a hands-on architect with strong expertise across SAP BASIS, Security, BTP, integration, and AI-enabled platform solutions.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Target architectures: on-prem / RISE / GROW, S/4HANA, BTP subaccounts, destinations, connectivity.
* Network topology & secure landscape: SAP Web Dispatcher, Cloud Connector, reverse proxy, firewall zones / DMZ, load balancing, SNC / TLS, port mapping.
* Identity & access: IAS, IPS, XSUAA, IAG, corporate IdP federation, role governance.
* SAP Security: Understand and estimate efforts required security subjects and address
* SAP Business AI platform: AI Core, AI Launchpad, Generative AI Hub, Joule / Joule Studio, AI Agent Hub; agent identity & zero-trust.

* Reusable CoE assets: reference architectures, accelerators, PoVs.

**Your Experience And Skills**
**Must-Have**

* 8+ yrs SAP BASIS + SAP Security, hands-on architecture.
* RISE / GROW with SAP, S/4HANA conversion.
* Must have experience working on brownfield - greenfield conversion
* Network topology: Web Dispatcher, Cloud Connector, reverse proxy, DMZ / firewall design, SNC, TLS.
* SAP BTP: subaccounts, destinations, XSUAA, Cloud Foundry.
* Identity: IAS / IPS, SAML / OIDC federation.
* Core BASIS: SUM, STMS, system copy / refresh, HANA admin.
* Authorization design (roles, profiles, SoD).
* Integration requirements analysis: SAP-to-SAP, SAP-to-third-party; interface patterns, Cloud Connector, Integration Suite / Edge Integration Cell.
* SAP Business AI familiarity: AI Core / Gen AI Hub / Joule / Agent Hub.
* Presales exposure: RFP responses, solution sizing, or technical demos.
* Client-facing English; global time-zone flexibility.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Cloud ALM, SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG), Enterprise Threat Detection (ETD), vulnerability management.
* Hyperscaler (AWS / Azure / GCP) SAP workloads, security groups.
* RAG / prompt patterns, Document Information Extraction on BTP.
* SAP certifications (BTP, Security, HANA).

**Why Westernacher?**

* Opportunity to work on large-scale SAP RISE transformation programs.
* Exposure to global clients and modern SAP cloud technologies.
* Collaborative and innovation-driven work environment.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

**This Is WE**
Committed to innovation, since 1969 Westernacher Consulting has operated worldwide, with more than 1200 consultants in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. Headquartered in Heidelberg, Germany, Westernacher Consulting is the global leader in business process and technology innovation.
  
  
Living, working, and operating in partnership. We are inquisitive, creative thinkers with a strong entrepreneurial spirit. We question new ways of working, think differently, and are willing to try out new approaches to create value and innovation for our customers. All of this makes us pioneers in our field and keeps us responsive, quality-focused, and results-oriented.
  
  
Westernacher is a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Westernacher is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
  
  
Life@Westernacher

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
